arXiv:2608.31016v1 [cs.CL] 2026 年 8 月 31 日arXiv:2608.31016v1 [cs.CL] 31 Aug 2026

法学硕士法官验证存在，而不是缺席：人工智能临床记录中的遗漏盲症以及如何恢复它LLM Judges Verify Presence, Not Absence: Omission Blindness in AI Clinical Notes and What Recovers It

Sebastian Fox ††thanks: Lead and corresponding author: seb@composo.ai, ORCID 0000-0001-9839-6952.    Luke Markham    Ryan Lail    Michael Karotsieris
摘要Abstract

Ambient AI 抄写员大规模起草临床记录，并在已发布的审计中发现遗漏（该记录未能记录的信息），这是他们的主要错误类别。标准检查是法学硕士法官，这是读取成绩单和注释并标记问题的第二个模型，我们衡量这些法官是否能够发现遗漏。公共语料库无法提供答案（临床医生的参考笔记与他们自己的笔录存在重大差异），因此我们发布了由 500 个单错误笔记对组成的基准，这些单错误笔记对是根据笔录派生的、经过审计的情况说明书构建的：其中 298 个指定事实的主要陈述肯定被删除，并按严重程度以及笔记中其他地方的保留程度进行评分，与 202 个添加或更改的控制相比。在八个评判设计中，配对歧视（有缺陷的纸币的得分低于干净的纸币，即抛硬币 0.5 分），添加或更改内容的得分为 0.79-0.94，遗漏的得分为 0.50-0.63，而在单张纸币上，没有哪个设计比完美的纸币更能可靠地标记有遗漏的纸币。 GEPA 的措辞更改、投票和提示优化可在不创建可用检测的情况下移动操作点。恢复检测的方法是重组任务：列出记录所确定的事实，然后对照注释验证每一项，作为封闭的存在检查。有两种方法可以独立地进行重组——一个基于事实的管道，以及一个在一次调用中执行相同过程的 GEPA 演进的提示——并且它们可以进行权衡。管道的标志指出了缺失的事实及其严重性（误报率为 2.7%）。单次调用以 6.2% 的误报检测到更多注释（在评估集上，分别为 36.9% 和 24.6%，以咨询为单位，p=0.002），并且大约是每次咨询一个注释时每个注释测量成本的十分之一（摊销每次咨询阶段后为三分之一）。人类验证贯穿整个研究。一位医师作者在涵盖六个阶段的会议中验证了 70 个项目，其中三个阶段是结构性盲法，并且在十个注释上，管道和最佳整体法官在所有十个阶段都得出了与管道相反的结论（p = 0.002）。此后，严重程度的评分标准由一位独立临床医生（不是作者，也没有参与该研究）进行了盲分级，并且在两次同伴人口普查结果的会议上，两位临床医生在一个等级内达成了一致。在来自同伴普查的真实供应商记录中，没有基准阈值转移，但重新校准的单次调用仍然以一半的误报率检测到了八个呼叫中最好的一个，并且在带有经过验证的遗漏的普查记录中，四分之三的记录中，管道标志指出了普查小组验证的事实。遗漏的事实作为注释中其他地方的重述而得以保留，这两条路线都失败了。我们发布基准、提示和所有判断。Ambient AI scribes draft clinical notes at scale, and published audits find omission - information the encounter established that the note fails to record - their dominant error class. The standard check is an LLM judge, a second model that reads the transcript and the note and flags problems, and we measure whether these judges can detect omissions. Public corpora cannot supply the answer key (clinician reference notes are materially discrepant with their own transcripts), so we release a benchmark of 500 single-error note pairs built from transcript-derived, audited fact sheets: 298 in which a named fact’s primary statement is certainly removed, graded by severity and by how much of it survives elsewhere in the note, against 202 added-or-altered controls. Across eight judge designs, paired discrimination - the flawed note scored below its clean twin, 0.5 a coin flip - reads 0.79-0.94 on added or altered content against 0.50-0.63 on omissions, and on single notes no design flags notes with omissions reliably more often than perfect ones. Wording changes, voting, and prompt optimisation with GEPA move the operating point without creating usable detection. What recovers detection is restructuring the task: list the facts the transcript establishes, then verify each one against the note as a closed presence check. Two methods arrive at that restructuring independently - a per-fact pipeline, and a GEPA-evolved prompt carrying out the same procedure inside one call - and they trade off. The pipeline’s flags name the missing fact and its severity at 2.7% false alarms. The single call detects more notes (36.9% against 24.6%, p=0.002 with consultations as the unit, on the evaluation set) at 6.2% false alarms and roughly a tenth of the measured cost per note at one note per consultation (a third once the per-consultation stages are amortised). Human validation runs through the study. A physician author validated 70 items in a sitting that covered six stages, three of them structurally blinded, and on the ten notes where the pipeline and the best monolithic judge reach opposite conclusions sided with the pipeline on all ten (p=0.002). The severity rubric has since been graded blind by an independent clinician, not an author and with no involvement in the study, and across two sittings on the companion census’s findings the two clinicians agree with it to within a grade. On real vendor notes from the companion census no benchmark threshold transfers, but the single call re-calibrated still detects more than the best of the eight at half its false-alarm rate, and on the census notes carrying a verified omission three quarters of the notes the pipeline flags name the very fact the census’s panel verified. Omissions whose fact survives as a restatement elsewhere in the note defeat both routes. We release the benchmark, prompts, and all judgements.

1 简介Introduction

电话咨询不包含体检。尽管如此，我们在一项同伴人口普查中审计的三名商业环境抄写员中，仍有两人制作了电话咨询记录，记录了其中之一：历史被改写为进行的检查，在记录的一部分中，临床医生签字，后来的读者将其视为观察到的事实。那次普查（“三分之一：对三名部署的人工智能抄写员进行了验证的普查，以及计算它的工具”，同时发布）对三款部署的产品进行了同样的 142 次咨询。在其 565 个注释中（282、141 和 142，因为一种产品写有两种注释样式），31.3% [27.0, 35.6] 至少有一个经过验证的失败，最大的一组是缺失或错误记录的过敏和药物信息。人口普查还报告称，一旦患者记录预先填写的两个失败类别、发明的身份详细信息和日期被搁置（其附录 A.7），该比率就会降至 24.8% [20.8, 29.0]。已发布的人工审核发现，遗漏是主要错误类别，占三项审核中所有错误的 54% 至 86.3%A telephone consultation contains no physical examination. Two of the three commercial ambient scribes we audited in a companion census nonetheless produced notes for telephone consultations that document one: history rewritten as performed examination, in the part of the note a clinician signs and a later reader treats as observed fact. That census (“One note in three: a verified census of three deployed AI scribes, and the instrument that counted it”, released concurrently) put three deployed products through the same 142 consultations. Of its 565 notes (282, 141 and 142, since one product writes two note styles), 31.3% [27.0, 35.6] carry at least one verified failure, and the largest single group is allergy and medication information that is missing or wrongly recorded. The census also reports that the rate falls to 24.8% [20.8, 29.0] once the two failure classes a patient record would have prefilled, invented identity details and dates, are set aside (its Appendix A.7). Published human audits find omission the dominant error class outright, at 54% to 86.3% of all errors across three audits(Biro et al., 2025a; Anderson et al., 2025; Kernberg et al., 2024)。本文探讨了人口普查留下的问题：自动化质量层是否能够看到这些故障。图. This paper takes up the question the census leaves open: whether the automated quality layer can see these failures at all. Figure1通过本文自己的基准，从笔录到每位法官的判决，找到了一个缺失的发现。takes one missing finding through this paper’s own benchmark, from the transcript to each judge’s verdict.

该质量层是LLM的评判者：第二个模型，提示阅读成绩单以及注释和标记问题。法官使得评估能够以抄写员的运作规模进行，也是供应商、买家和监管机构越来越需要信任的因素。该论文的论点分为四个步骤。我们观察到，在八个设计的消融中，除了第 5 节名称之外，我们运行的每个参考法官，法官都会验证注释包含的内容，并对其省略的内容进行接近概率，最近记录的一般语言模型的缺席失盲性That quality layer is the LLM judge: a second model, prompted to read the transcript and the note and flag problems. Judges are what makes evaluation affordable at the scale scribes operate at, and what vendors, buyers and regulators are increasingly asked to trust. The paper’s argument runs in four steps. We observe that across an eight-design ablation and, with the single exception Section 5 names, every reference judge we ran, judges verify what a note contains and sit near chance on what it omits, the absence-blindness recently documented for language models in general(Fu et al., 2025)完好无损地到达医疗保健实际运行的评估层。我们假设悬而未决的问题“有什么遗漏吗？”模型无需检查，因为遗漏不会留下任何文本可指出。这预示着两件事：仅改变法官询问方式（措辞、标准、答案格式、投票、自动提示优化）的补救措施应该在不创建可用检测的情况下移动其操作点，而为法官提供具体指向的修复应该恢复它。arriving intact at the evaluation layer healthcare actually runs. We hypothesise that the open question “is anything missing?” gives the model nothing to check, because an omission leaves no text to point at. That predicts two things: remedies that change only how the judge is asked (wording, criteria, answer format, votes, automated prompt optimisation) should move its operating point without creating usable detection, and a fix that gives the judge something concrete to point at should recover it.

测试证实了两半的结果。我们尝试的每一种传统补救措施都会移动工作点，但不会创建可用的检测。恢复检测的部分原因是，由于没有测试的方法能够接近解决该类问题，因此将缺席问题转换为存在检查：首先列出记录所确定的事实，然后根据注释验证每个事实。这里有两种方法进行这种转换并分别实现它，我们围绕它设计了一个管道，以及优化器 GEPA 发展的提示，在一次调用中指示相同的过程。两个实现独立地聚合在同一重组上，这证明恢复来自重组，而不是来自任何特定的提示或管道设计。The test bears both halves out. Every conventional remedy we tried moved the operating point without creating usable detection. What recovers detection - partially, since no method tested comes close to solving the class - is converting the absence question into presence checks: first list the facts the transcript establishes, then verify each one against the note. Two methods here make that conversion and arrived at it separately, a pipeline we designed around it and a prompt the optimiser GEPA evolved that instructs the same procedure inside one call. Two implementations converging independently on the same restructuring is evidence that the recovery comes from the restructuring rather than from any particular prompt or pipeline design.

已发表的审计发现，错误类别在抄写员输出中占主导地位（我们自己的更严格的工具也可能低估了这一类别），而这正是法学硕士法官几乎偶然发现的类别。The error class published audits find dominant in scribe output - a class our own stricter instrument likely undercounts as well - is precisely the class LLM judges sit near chance on.

贡献。Contributions.(i) 已发布的基准，其中缺席是确定的，并根据严重性以及被删除的事实在注释中其他地方幸存的程度进行分级。 (ii) 存在/不存在的不对称性，通过消融来隔离，而不是从一个法官的设计中推断出来。 (iii) 五个补救措施系列中的零值，每个补救措施系列都会移动法官的操作点，而不会创建可用的单音符检测，并测量每个转变的大小；机制的本地化，其中要检查的具体事实清单约占恢复的三分之一，其余部分则根据事实进行封闭式判决。 (iv) 实现该转换的两个工作检测器，进行头对头比较：一个事实枚举管道，其每个标志都命名了缺失的事实及其严重性，以及一次 GEPA 演进的调用，其成本大约是每个注释测量成本的十分之一，每次咨询一个注释（三分之一摊销）。通过它们，我们给出了一个基于事实的决策规则，一个盲法医生裁决，以及击败这两种方法的案例，称为开放问题。(i) A released benchmark where absence is certain and graded, by severity and by how much of the removed fact survives elsewhere in the note. (ii) The presence/absence asymmetry, isolated by ablation rather than inferred from one judge design. (iii) A null across five remedy families, each moving the judge’s operating point without creating usable single-note detection, with the size of each shift measured; and a localisation of the mechanism, in which a list of concrete facts to check accounts for about a third of the recovery and closed per-fact verdicts for the rest. (iv) Two working detectors implementing that conversion, compared head to head: a fact-enumeration pipeline whose every flag names the missing fact and its severity, and a single GEPA-evolved call at roughly a tenth of the measured cost per note at one note per consultation (a third amortised). With them we give a per-fact decision rule, a blinded physician adjudication, and the case that defeats both methods, named as an open problem.

2 相关工作Related work

四种文学在这里相遇。Four literatures meet here.语言模型中的缺席检测。Absence detection in language models.缺勤凳AbsenceBench(Fu et al., 2025)确定了医学之外的能力差距：将原始文档和编辑后的文档放在一起，模型在 F1 上捕获插入的概率为 86.2% 到 99.5%，具体取决于领域，而遗漏的概率平均下降 56.9%。它命名了一个架构原因 - 变压器注意力无法轻易关注间隙，因为缺席不提供任何密钥 - 以及在该设置中起作用的修复，在内容被删除的位置插入占位符标记。我们的限制名称是未经测试的，预计会更难：语义而不是表面缺席，部署时没有并排原始内容，医疗领域，法官而不是差异引擎。他们在这里无法修复，因为评估人员不知道漏洞在哪里。并行工作在非临床答案键的审阅角色中发现了同样的不对称性，其中审阅者只能询问其可以命名的候选者established the capability gap outside medicine: given the original and edited documents side by side, models catch insertions at 86.2 to 99.5% F1 depending on domain and drop by an average of 56.9% on omissions. It names an architectural cause - transformer attention cannot easily attend to gaps, because an absence supplies no keys - and a repair that works in that setting, inserting placeholder markers where content was removed. Ours is the setting their limitations name as untested and expected to be harder: semantic rather than surface absence, no side-by-side original at deployment, the medical domain, judges rather than diff engines. Their repair is unavailable here, because an evaluator does not know where the hole is. Concurrent work finds the same asymmetry in the reviewing role on non-clinical answer keys, where a reviewer can interrogate only candidates it can name(Chen et al., 2026);完整的比较见附录 I。; the full comparison is Appendix I.

临床文本中法学硕士作为法官的可靠性。LLM-as-judge reliability in clinical text.医疗设备电子工程中心MEDEC(Ben Abacha et al., 2025)措施法官对医生标记的犯错、镜像类进行遗漏。并发工作measures judges on physician-labelled commission errors, the mirror class to omission. Concurrent work(DeLucia et al., 2026)独立地发现临床完整性判断的机会略高于 AUC，其标题和提示收益反映了阈值变化而不是分离 - 本文第 5 节和第 6 节发现，在不同的任务上独立实现且没有委托条件。判断可靠性的另外三个角度与此相关，包括一个指向相反方向的结果；附录一依次介绍了每一项independently finds clinical completeness judges at chance-to-slightly-above AUC, with rubric and prompting gains that reflect threshold shifts rather than separation - what this paper’s Sections 5 and 6 find, reached independently on a different task and without a commission condition. Three further angles on judge reliability bear on this, including the one result pointing the other way; Appendix I takes each in turn(Dahlberg et al., 2026; Hussain et al., 2026; Bergman et al., 2026a; Vachhani et al., 2026).

抄写员审核和临床记录评估。Scribe audits and clinical note evaluation.审计确定错误类别和遗漏的主导地位The audits establish the error classes and omission’s dominance(Biro et al., 2025a; Anderson et al., 2025; Kernberg et al., 2024; Taylor et al., 2026)。配套的人口普查读取了这些审计相对于生成它们的工具的不同计数，同时进行的五个国家配对研究衡量了该工具在已发布比率中所占的份额. The companion census reads those audits’ divergent counts against the instruments that produced them, and a concurrent five-country paired study measures the instrument’s own share of a published rate(Bergman et al., 2026b)。在一项单独的植入错误研究中. In a separate planted-error study(Biro et al., 2025b)，审查医生发现遗漏的比率与客观错误的比率大致相同，因此这里测量的不对称性似乎是机器法官的特征，而不是审查本身的特征（第 5.5 节）。, reviewing physicians caught omissions at roughly the same rate as objective errors, so the asymmetry measured here appears characteristic of machine judges rather than of review as such (Section 5.5).

总结真实性Summarisation factuality我们的修复所属的文献是：原子事实分解is the literature our fix belongs to: atomic-fact decomposition(Min et al., 2023)、基于 QA 和蕴含的指标, QA- and entailment-based metrics(Scialom et al., 2021; Laban et al., 2022)，RAGAS 谱系的真实覆盖，广泛使用的开源评估库, per-fact coverage in the lineage of RAGAS, a widely used open-source evaluation library(Es et al., 2024)。中省略. MED-OMIT(Schumacher et al., 2023)是修复的直接祖先 - 用于遗漏测量的事实枚举，重要性加权，与我们的阶层之一在同一公共语料库上 - 和 CAREis the fix’s direct ancestor - fact enumeration for omission measurement, importance-weighted, on the same public corpus as one of our strata - and CARE(Bedi et al., 2026)工程师一起校准了幻觉和遗漏的标志，通过设计得出第 7 节通过测量得出的结论：存在和不存在需要单独的探测器。engineers calibrated flags for hallucination and omission together, arriving by design at the conclusion Section 7 reaches by measurement: presence and absence need separate detectors.

差距。The gap.这些工作都没有同时测试免费临床记录中的语义遗漏，评估者没有可用的答案，对严重性和幸存痕迹进行分级，并且基准构建与法官表现分开报告。本文所提供的就是这种结合。None of these lines of work simultaneously tests semantic omissions in free clinical notes, with no answer key available to the evaluator, with severity and surviving trace graded, and with benchmark construction reported separately from judge performance. That conjunction is what this paper supplies.

测试法官是否能够发现遗漏需要注意其中肯定不存在指定事实，并且我们检查的公共语料库没有提供这一事实。Testing whether a judge can find an omission needs notes in which a named fact is certainly absent, and no public corpus we examined supplies one.

3 基准：确定缺勤并进行评分The benchmark: absence made certain and graded

我们开始制作带有已知漏洞的笔记，并根据该漏洞的重要性以及事实在其他地方幸存的程度来分级。图We set out to build notes with a known hole in them, graded by how much the hole matters and by how much of the fact survives elsewhere. Figure2列出了整个构建、每个阶段及其生成的内容以及每个检查及其拒绝的内容，因此本节仅说明该工具所保证的内容。协议、账本和标题是附录 A。一个范围决策高于其他决策：基准衡量转录所确定的事实是否保留在注释中，这是比临床文件充分性更严格、更可衡量的标准，因为简洁的注释可以合法地将转录事实排除在外（我们的情况说明书与人类作者手写的情况说明书的大小，如下所示，是衡量这一差距的标准）。lays out the whole build, every stage with what it produced and every check with what it rejected, so this section states only what the instrument guarantees. The protocol, the ledgers and the rubric are Appendix A. One scope decision sits above the rest: the benchmark measures whether facts the transcript establishes survive into the note, a stricter and more measurable standard than clinical documentation adequacy, since a concise note can legitimately leave transcript facts out (the size of our fact sheets against the fact sheets human authors wrote by hand, below, is the measure of that gap).

3.1 公共语料库的参考笔记不是答案The public corpora’s reference notes are not an answer key

建立基准的明显方法是借用答案键：公共语料库与临床医生编写的参考注释进行配对咨询，并根据参考对生成的注释进行评分是标准配方The obvious way to build the benchmark is to borrow the answer key: public corpora pair consultations with clinician-written reference notes, and scoring a generated note against the reference is the standard recipe(Papadopoulos Korfiatis et al., 2022; Yim et al., 2023)。将参考注释视为事实假设它是真实的，因此我们根据其自己的记录审核了语料库的两个公共层中的每个可用参考注释，指示不要惩罚有效的释义，并进行一个修复周期（PriMock57 的 57 次咨询中的 53 次和 ACI-Bench 的 48 次咨询中的 45 次在语料库检查中幸存下来；附录 A 记录了下降情况）。所有 53 个 PriMock 注释（100%，95% 区间 [93.2, 100]）和所有 45 个 ACI-Bench 注释（100%，[92.1, 100]）与其自己的记录至少存在一处重大差异，平均每条注释有 10.7 和 7.1 处重大差异。计算每一个严重程度时，缺失的事实占主导地位（56%，即 PriMock 所有等级的 1,030 个差异中的 574 个），然后是彻底的错误，然后是强化的不确定性，其中“我认为你有一点挫伤”成为明确的诊断。关于这 100% 的警告见附录 A。重要的是密度及其严重程度划分，1,030 个等级中有 345 个等级为严重。根据这些参考文献来判断抄写员会将每个注释 7 到 11 个重大错误导入到答案本身中。. Treating a reference note as truth assumes it is true, so we audited every usable reference note in our corpus’s two public strata against its own transcript, instructed not to penalise valid paraphrase, with one repair cycle (53 of PriMock57’s 57 consultations and 45 of ACI-Bench’s 48 survive the corpus checks; Appendix A records the drops). All 53 PriMock notes (100%, 95% interval [93.2, 100]) and all 45 ACI-Bench notes (100%, [92.1, 100]) carry at least one material discrepancy with their own transcript, at means of 10.7 and 7.1 material discrepancies per note. Counting every severity, missing facts dominate (56%, or 574 of PriMock’s 1,030 discrepancies of all grades), then outright errors, then hardened uncertainty, where “i think you’ve got a little contusion” becomes a definite diagnosis. The caveats on that 100% are in Appendix A. What matters is the density and its severity split, with 345 of the 1,030 graded critical. Judging a scribe against these references imports 7 to 11 material errors per note into the answer key itself.

3.2 从成绩单中构建关键点，并对重要内容进行评分Building the key from the transcript, and grading what matters

如果参考笔记不可能是真实的，那么抄本就必须是真实的。对于每次咨询，我们通过从记录中盲提取来构建一份情况说明书，与三个模型批评家一起对其进行审核，并用它来修复和验证参考注释，这成为每对构建的干净注释（图If reference notes cannot be truth, the transcript has to be. For each consultation we build a fact sheet by blind extraction from the transcript, audit it with three model critics, and use it to repair and verify the reference note, which becomes the clean note every pair is built from (Figure2）。修复后的笔记是完整的，与事实说明书相符，而不是与记录中包含的所有内容相反：98 份修复笔记中的 17 份仍未通过最严格的残留检查，并被保存和记录（附录 A）。关于该仪器的两个事实在这里很重要。它的准确性是根据我们自己编写的咨询进行盲测的，在通过评论小组的 30 个盲重提取中的 27 个中，恢复了 650 个编写事实中的 646 个事实（99.4%，95% 区间 [98.8, 99.9]，通过对整个咨询进行重新采样计算）。而且它比人类作者写的表格更长，因此整合过程对每个项目进行核心或上下文分类，并仅从核心项目构建配对 - 每层平均值为 24.8 到 32.6，而作者的平均值为 24.1，比临床医生写入的完整性更高。). The repaired note is complete against its fact sheet, not against everything the transcript contains: 17 of the 98 repaired notes still fail the strictest residual check and are kept and logged (Appendix A). Two facts about the instrument matter here. Its accuracy was measured blind against consultations we had written ourselves, recovering 646 of 650 authored facts (99.4%, 95% interval [98.8, 99.9], computed by resampling whole consultations) on the 27 of 30 blind re-extractions that passed the critic panel. And it writes longer sheets than the human authors, so a consolidation pass classes each item core or contextual and builds pairs from core items only - per-stratum means of 24.8 to 32.6 against the authors’ 24.1, a completeness bar above what a clinician would write to.

按重要性对遗漏进行分级需要重要性保持稳定，但本质上并非如此：对相同细节进行分级的两个前沿模型的 Cohen kappa 一致为 0.177 [0.04, 0.31]，仅略高于巧合。书面的标题可以解决大部分问题。在其下，两个跨家庭评分者的评分在语料库的 683 个评分陷阱上达到 kappa 0.662 [0.59, 0.73]，这个区间不与非锚定运行重叠（该运行是 171 个匹配陷阱上的连续代的同族对，因此对比度会移动评分器对和项目集以及标题；同一家庭的与自己的非锚定运行相比，以标题为锚定的评分为 kappa 0.39，附录 A），如果他们仍然不同意，则基准会采用较低的评分。 （683 个陷阱是稳定性运行分级的总体，涵盖编写和提取的工作表；图中的 613 个事实Grading omissions by importance needs importance to be stable, and natively it is not: two frontier models grading the same details agree at a Cohen’s kappa of 0.177 [0.04, 0.31], barely above coincidence. A written rubric fixes most of it. Under it the two cross-family graders whose grades the benchmark ships reach kappa 0.662 [0.59, 0.73] on the corpus’s 683 graded traps, an interval that does not overlap the unanchored run’s (that run is a same-family pair of successive generations on 171 matched traps, so the contrast moves the grader pair and the item set as well as the rubric; the same family’s rubric-anchored grades against its own unanchored run read kappa 0.39, Appendix A), and where they still disagree the benchmark takes the lower grade. (The 683 traps are the population that stability run graded, spanning authored and extracted sheets; the 613 facts in Figure2是对的实际评分的评估分割。）两个评分标准都比任一模型本身的评分更严格，只要结果以严重性为条件，我们都会披露这一点。该标准是附录 A，是一位医师作者对附录 E 进行的盲法重新评分。此后，相同的书面标准已被盲法应用are the evaluation split of the per-fact grading the pairs carry.) Both rubric runs grade more severely than either model does natively, which we disclose wherever a result is conditioned on severity. The rubric is Appendix A, a physician author’s blinded re-grade of it Appendix E. The same written rubric has since been applied blind by an独立临床医生independent clinician到配套人口普查中的最新调查结果样本，12 个等级中的 9 个等级准确，3 个等级相差 1 个等级（附录 A 总结了两次人口普查会议；人口普查自己的附录包含协议和项目级别等级）。独立，无论在本文中还是在任何地方出现这个词，都意味着不是本研究的作者，并且在任何阶段都没有参与其中。在两次对其进行评分的人口普查会议中，这位临床医生的 12 项评分和一位医师作者对 20 项经验证的发现的重新评分，32 个等级中的 25 个是准确的，并且任何地方的分歧均不超过一个等级，因此该标题在两位对不相交材料进行评分的临床医生的等级范围内重现。但这并不能确定该评分标准本身的方向：两个评分者的倾向相反，因此这里没有任何主张基于该评分标准的评分倾向某一方向。 （一级精益第 7.5 节报告是一种不同的衡量标准，针对单个评估者对管道自身的审计阶段等级进行衡量。）to a fresh sample of findings in the companion census, with 9 of 12 grades exact and 3 one grade apart (Appendix A summarises both census sittings; the census’s own appendix carries the protocol and the item-level grades). Independent, here and wherever the word appears in this paper, means not an author of this study and with no involvement in it at any stage. Across the two census sittings that graded against it, this clinician’s twelve and a physician author’s regrade of twenty verified findings, 25 of 32 grades are exact and no disagreement anywhere exceeds a single grade, so the rubric reproduces to within a grade under two clinicians who graded disjoint material. What that does not establish is a direction for the rubric itself: the two raters lean opposite ways, so no claim here rests on the rubric’s grades leaning one way. (The one-grade lean Section 7.5 reports is a different measurement, of the pipeline’s own audit-stage grades against a single rater.)

在对表格进行评分后，删除事实应该是机械的，但事实并非如此，因为真正的临床记录会重复出现。绘制干净笔记中陈述每个候选事实的每个位置，显示 1,791 条事实中的 574 条 (32.0%) 在多个地方陈述。这种冗余达到了临床上重要的事实：在每张纸上标记为抄写员可能出错的时刻、严重程度等级所附加的条目中，51.6% 的关键条目和 61.2% 的支持条目被多次提及。验证就是发现所在。跨家庭小组验证了 126 次完全删除尝试中的 71 次 (56.3%)，因此 44% 失败了 - 主要是因为事实并非真正不存在，或者注释不再自然地阅读 - 151 次中的 114 次 (75.5%) 是按设计留下痕迹的部分删除，记录了每次编辑并排除了 92 个被拒绝的对，没有一个被修补（附录 A）。该领域的后果是直接的：仅从完全省略中建立的基准测试了现象的不具代表性的部分，因为在实际记录中，完整的案例是幸存下来的少数。With the sheets graded, removing a fact should be mechanical, and it is not, because real clinical notes repeat themselves. Mapping every place each candidate fact is stated in the clean note shows 574 of the 1,791 present (32.0%) stated in more than one place. The redundancy reaches the facts that matter clinically: among the moments each sheet marks as ones a scribe could plausibly get wrong, the entries the severity grades attach to, 51.6% of critical and 61.2% of supporting entries are stated more than once. Verification is where the finding is. A cross-family panel verified 71 of 126 complete-removal attempts (56.3%), so 44% failed - mostly because the fact was not truly absent after all, or the note no longer read naturally - against 114 of 151 (75.5%) for partial removals that leave a trace by design, with every edit logged and the 92 rejected pairs excluded, none of them patched (Appendix A). The consequence for the field is direct: a benchmark built only from complete omissions tests an unrepresentative slice of the phenomenon, because in real notes the complete case is the minority that survives construction.

3.3 发布的集合包含什么What the released set holds

该集合有 500 对，评估集中有 495 对，超过 117 个咨询（评估集外的 5 对参与探索性优化器的开发池使用的咨询，并被排除在每个法官之外，留下 112 个评估咨询），有 45 对匹配对，90 对，其中相同的事实在两个不同的跟踪级别被删除。在整个过程中，一个The set is 500 pairs, 495 in the evaluation set, over 117 consultations (the five pairs outside the evaluation set sit on consultations the exploratory optimiser’s development pool used and are excluded for every judge, leaving 112 evaluation consultations), with 45 matched couples, 90 pairs, in which the same fact is removed at two different trace levels. Throughout, an遗漏omissionpair 从注释中删除一个事实和一个pair removes a fact from the note and a佣金commission一对添加或更改一个。评估集的遗漏一半是 293 对 - 150 个完全删除，86 个事实片段保留下来，57 个事实的完整重述保留下来 - 相对于 202 个委员会（95 个添加，107 个更改）和 112 个干净的双胞胎，每个双胞胎都是相同的音符，事实完好无损。我们根据幸存的内容来命名部分级别：apair adds or alters one. The evaluation set’s omission half is 293 pairs - 150 complete removals, 86 where a fragment of the fact survives, 57 where a full restatement of it survives - against 202 commissions (95 additions, 107 alterations) and 112 clean twins, each twin being the same note with the fact intact. We name the partial levels by what survives: a碎片痕迹fragment trace留下被删除语句或其直接邻居的片段，以及leaves a fragment of the removed statement or its immediate neighbour, and a重述痕迹restatement trace对同一事实留下了第二次独立陈述的提及，它几乎总是位于不同的标题下（第 7 节）。公布的数据划分了三个级别leaves a second, independently stated mention of the same fact, which almost always sits under a different heading (Section 7). The released data labels the three levels完成complete, 部分弱partial-weak（片段）和(fragment) and部分强partial-strong（重述）和表(restatement), and Table1是按严重性跟踪的布局。is the trace-by-severity layout.

出处是每对上的一个字段，附录 A 列出了集合池的四个来源。这里会产生一个结果：所有 202 个佣金控制都是从早期建筑中继承下来的，而大多数遗漏对都是新建的，因此在不同建筑群之间进行比较的总体不对称性。这种差距使我们可以衡量的任何队列差异相形见绌：佣金方面在外部锚定于医生策划的错误（第 5 节），并且稳健性切片仅限于统一构建的遗漏对Provenance is a field on every pair, and Appendix A tabulates the four sources the set pools. One consequence belongs here: all 202 commission controls are carried over from an earlier build while most omission pairs are newly built, so the headline asymmetry compares across construction cohorts. The gap dwarfs any cohort difference we can measure: the commission side is anchored externally on physician-curated errors (Section 5), and a robustness slice restricted to the uniformly built omission pairs扩大widens最佳设计的不对称性从 0.305 到 0.329（附录 A）。the asymmetry, from 0.305 to 0.329 on the best design (Appendix A).

保留有两层。探索性优化器的开发池是完全从语料库中切出的 22 个咨询，第 6 节的验证活动然后通过对其中 65 个咨询、学习和接受来划分评估集；其余 47 个子集中的 151 对子集是这里每个保留声明的基础，是在搜索开始之前提交的，并且从未被任何优化器看到。The holdout has two layers. The exploratory optimiser’s development pool is 22 consultations carved out of the corpus entirely, and the confirmatory campaign of Section 6 then partitioned the evaluation set by consultation, learning and accepting on 65 of them; the 151-pair subset over the remaining 47, the basis of every held-out claim here, was committed before that search began and never seen by any optimiser.

4 接受测试的法官以及如何对检测进行评分The judges under test, and how detection is scored

4.1 两种记分方式，生产环境中仅存在一种Two ways to keep score, and only one of them exists in production

图Figure3绘制本节开始的实验程序。接下来的所有内容都以两种方式评分，本文的大部分内容都基于这种区别。maps the experimental programme this section begins. Everything that follows is scored two ways, and much of the paper rests on the distinction.配对歧视Paired discrimination询问法官是否对有缺陷的纸币进行评分，严格低于其经过验证的干净纸币。它是法官正确排序的配对的比例，加上所有平局的一半（配对获胜率，与 AUC 属于同一衡量标准），其中 0.500 是硬币翻转。这只是能力上限，仅此而已，因为生产从来没有双胞胎。asks whether the judge scores the flawed note strictly below its own verified-clean twin. It is the share of pairs the judge orders correctly, plus half of any ties (a paired win rate, in the same family of measure as AUC), where 0.500 is a coin flip. It is a capability ceiling and nothing more, because production never has the twin.单钞检测Single-note detection是部署措施：一张纸条到达，法官对其进行标记或不标记，并且标记率除了同一法官对干净纸条的误报率之外没有任何意义。每个设计都带有一个is the deployment measure: one note arrives, the judge flags it or does not, and that flag rate means nothing except beside the same judge’s false-alarm rate on clean notes. Each design carries a标志规则flag rule，将其输出转换为标志的固定阈值或判决，下面的“按照其自己的规则”意味着根据该规则进行测量。一名法官的, the fixed threshold or verdict that turns its output into a flag, and “at its own rule” below means measured under that rule. A judge’s工作点operating point是这两个速率的总和，下面的每一个补救措施都是根据它是沿着曲线滑动点还是提升曲线来判断的。我们称之为检测is those two rates together, and every remedy below is judged by whether it slides the point along a curve or lifts the curve.
