4.3 分析约定Analysis conventions

在任何显着性测试之前，重复运行会崩溃到每个音符的多数。引导重采样是在咨询时进行的，而不是在注释中进行的，因为一次咨询中的配对共享一份记录、一份干净的双胞胎和一份事实列表；出于同样的原因，两种方法标志之间的比较被折叠到测试前的咨询中。配对标志比较使用精确的 McNemar 检验，并在每个比较系列中进行 Holm 校正，两个小比率的不配对比较使用 Boschloo 的精确无条件检验；比例带有威尔逊 95% 区间和一致性系数簇引导区间，因此下面任何地方的裸括号区间都是 95% 水平的这两个区间之一。结果部分引用 p 值并在此处留下测试名称。当我们声称某些东西没有差异时，我们会说明我们可以检测到多大的差异，而不是报告高于 0.05 的 p 值。Repeat runs collapse to a per-note majority before any significance test. Bootstrap resampling is at the consultation, not the note, because pairs from one consultation share a transcript, a clean twin and a fact list; for the same reason, comparisons between two methods’ flags are collapsed to the consultation before testing. Paired flag comparisons use an exact McNemar test with a Holm correction across each family of comparisons, and the one unpaired comparison of two small rates uses Boschloo’s exact unconditional test; proportions carry Wilson 95% intervals and agreement coefficients cluster-bootstrap ones, so a bare bracketed interval anywhere below is one of those two at the 95% level. The results sections quote the p-value and leave the test’s name here. Where we claim something made no difference, we state how large a difference we could have detected rather than reporting a p-value above 0.05.

5 调查结果：法官核实的是在场，而不是缺席The finding: judges verify presence, not absence

5.1 强烈地检测到存在，接近偶然地检测到不存在Presence is detected strongly, absence at close to chance

在所有八种消融设计中，法官将佣金与干净的双胞胎分开，并且不将遗漏分开。在添加或更改内容时，八个运行在 0.792 至 0.944 配对，其中六个运行在 0.87 或以上（表Across all eight ablation designs, judges separate commissions from their clean twins and do not separate omissions. On added or altered content the eight run at 0.792 to 0.944 paired, six of them at 0.87 or above (Table4, 图, Figure4）。对于省略的部分，相同的八个读数为 0.500 至 0.634。仅忠实性法官回答“是”或“否”与手中的干净双胞胎完全一样，即使所有三种设计选择都处于最佳值（忠实性加完整性、评分、八个样本 - 整篇论文中最好的整体法官），分数也仅达到 0.634（三个重复的 0.601 到 0.655）。在最好的设计中，剩下的信号集中在最没有帮助的地方。按事实存续的程度：完全删除 0.690，碎片痕迹 0.607，重述痕迹 0.526，就像一枚硬币翻转一样——重述案例是故意构建的少数案例，在第 7 节中作为命名的开放案例。按严重性：关键 0.683，支持 0.586，外围 0.568。严重程度梯度是真实的、适度的，并且只出现在最好的设计中；痕迹梯度的影响更大，因为一个事实被陈述了两次半，无论其严重程度如何，都会彻底击败法官。同一事实的完全删除和部分删除之间的标记率的匹配事实对比未经校正时为 p=0.022，并且无法在第 4 部分组的系列校正中幸存（24 个匹配对比，每个设计 3 个：针对每个部分痕迹水平和针对两个合并的完全对比；调整后的 p=0.54），因此这是数据表明的模式，而不是他们建立的效果。). On omissions the same eight read 0.500 to 0.634. The faithfulness-only judge answering yes or no is at exactly a coin flip with the clean twin in hand, and even with all three design choices at their best values (faithfulness plus completeness, scored, eight samples - the best monolithic judge throughout this paper) the score reaches only 0.634 (0.601 to 0.655 across the three replicates). Inside that best design, what signal remains concentrates where it helps least. By how much of the fact survives: complete removals 0.690, fragment traces 0.607, and restatement traces 0.526, a coin flip - the restatement case is a deliberately built minority, taken up as a named open case in Section 7. By severity: critical 0.683, supporting 0.586, peripheral 0.568. The severity gradient is real, modest, and present only in the best design; the trace gradient is the larger effect, because a fact stated twice and half-removed defeats the judge outright whatever its severity. The matched-fact contrast in flag rate between complete and partial removals of the same fact is p=0.022 uncorrected and does not survive the family-wise correction Section 4 sets (24 matched contrasts, three per design: complete against each partial trace level and against the two pooled; adjusted p=0.54), so it is a pattern the data suggest rather than an effect they establish.

5.2 总而言之，这八种设计没有留下任何有用的东西On a single note, nothing usable survives from the eight designs

这些是用可供比较的双胞胎测量的上限，因此部署问题是分开的。八个单独的注释中没有一个设计在部署可能带来的误报率上与完美的注释有遗漏。在评分设计中，检测和误报之间的最大差距是 1.02 个标准误差，这是噪声（八个中的两个甚至略微为负，标记干净的音符比错误的音符稍多一些）；两种是/否完整性设计显示出更大的差距，标记了 40-42% 的遗漏音符与 32% 的干净音符，但一旦重复运行崩溃到每个音符占大多数，差距就是 1.2 到 1.7 个标准错误，并且标记三分之一完美音符的法官无论如何都不是一个可用的检测器。这也不是旗帜线绘制位置的人工制品。无阈值，检测曲线下面积在 8 条曲线上运行 0.503 至 0.575，并扫至 10% 误报上限，最佳得分设计在 6.5% 误报时达到 8.3% 检测率，这一差距无法清除其自身的噪声（表Those are ceilings measured with the twin available for comparison, so the deployment question is separate. No design among the eight separates notes with omissions from perfect ones at a false-alarm rate a deployment could carry. Among the scored designs the largest gap between detection and false alarms is 1.02 standard errors, which is noise (two of the eight even run marginally negative, flagging clean notes slightly more often than errored ones); the two yes/no completeness designs show larger gaps, flagging 40–42% of omission notes against 32% of clean ones, but once repeat runs collapse to a per-note majority that gap is 1.2 to 1.7 standard errors, and a judge that flags a third of perfect notes is not a usable detector either way. Nor is that an artefact of where the flag line was drawn. Threshold-free, the area under the detection curve runs 0.503 to 0.575 across the eight, and swept to a 10% false-alarm ceiling the best scored design reaches 8.3% detection at 6.5% false alarms, a gap that does not clear its own noise (Table4）。缺少的是可分离性，而不是校准。). What is missing is separability, not calibration.

5.3 参考法官和第二个模型系列中存在相同的不对称性The same asymmetry in the reference judges and a second model family

参考评委们复制了它，但第 7.8 节提到的一个例外是 RAGAS 风格的配方，它颠倒了它。部署的忠诚度法官在遗漏方面得分为 0.518，在佣金方面得分为 0.886，G-Eval 为 0.568，在佣金方面得分为 0.890，清单法官（由大约 25 个项目生成的清单，逐项回答）为 0.647，在 0.744 上得分，设计法官为 0.639，在佣金方面为 0.754，第一个优化活动的获胜提示为 0.549。 0.861。该活动开发池中的所有 21 个候选提示对添加和更改内容的检测效果均优于遗漏内容，高出 14.6 至 49.3 个百分点（附录 B）。这种不对称性在法官模型家族的变化中也得以幸存：与双子家族法官一起重新运行八个设计中的两个，对角色的提示不变，佣金为 0.951 和 0.961，而遗漏为 0.551 和 0.683，每次重复都有机会出现重述跟踪情况。家庭之间的差异是真实存在的。第二个系列的完整性评分设计在所有三个重复中清除了单个音符上的噪音（检测率为 19.1% 到 20.5%，误报率为 0.9% 到 3.6%），而第一个系列中的设计没有做到这一点。因此，单音符检测取决于判断，并且上述单音符声明的范围仅限于所测量的家庭；复制的是不对称性及其条件。需要注意的是：第二个家庭的端点拒绝无推理设置，因此家庭和推理预算在此检查中一起移动（第 8 节）。只有重组的设计才能打破这种模式（第 7 节）。The reference judges reproduce it, with one exception that Section 7.8 takes up, the RAGAS-style recipe, which inverts it. The deployed faithfulness judge scores 0.518 paired on omissions against 0.886 on commissions, G-Eval 0.568 against 0.890, the checklist judge (a transcript-generated checklist of roughly 25 items, answered item by item) 0.647 against 0.744, the engineered judge 0.639 against 0.754, and the first optimisation campaign’s winning prompt 0.549 against 0.861. All 21 candidate prompts in that campaign’s development pool detect added and altered content better than omissions, by 14.6 to 49.3 percentage points (Appendix B). The asymmetry also survives a change of judge model family: re-running two of the eight designs with a Gemini-family judge, prompts unchanged to the character, commissions sit at 0.951 and 0.961 against omissions at 0.551 and 0.683, with the restatement-trace case at chance in every replicate. One difference between the families is genuine. The second family’s completeness-scored design clears its own noise on single notes in all three replicates (19.1 to 20.5% detection at 0.9 to 3.6% false alarms), which no design in the primary family did. So single-note detection is judge-dependent and the single-note claims above are scoped to the family measured; what replicates is the asymmetry and its conditioning. One caveat: the second family’s endpoint refuses a no-reasoning setting, so family and reasoning budget move together in this check (Section 8). Only restructured designs break the pattern (Section 7).

5.4 该委员会持有医生标记的数据The commission arm holds on physician-labelled data

不对称的一侧可以根据独立标签进行检查，这些标签是由与本研究无关的医生编写的。 MEDEC 是医生标记的临床文本，每个项目要么没有错误，要么只包含一个错误，并提供其更正版本；它的五种错误类型都是替换，因此它不包含要检测的遗漏，并且它没有源文档，因此提示的转录槽带有无源占位符。在判断前冻结的 300 个文本分层样本（156 个错误文本和 144 个无错误文本，每个错误文本与其自己的校正版本配对）上重新运行 8 个文本中最好的一个，得到配对 0.827 和 AUC 0.811，其中 156 个错误文本中的 51.3% 在 144 个无错误文本上以 10% 的误报率检测到。与我们遗漏的相同设计的匹配对比是 AUC 对，0.811 对比 0.575（8.3% 检测率，6.5% 误报），因此佣金方是外部锚定的。 MEDEC 所强调的是法官有能力发现临床上错误的陈述，而没有来源进行检查——这是委员会类别可用的最接近的外部检查，而不是与成绩单验证相同的任务。相同的标签预先测试了第 6 节中最广泛的补救措施。两个提示相同，只是一个添加了“ANDcomplete”，并且省略子句产生了真实的活动，在 156 和 144 条文本中，检测率从 87.8% 上升到 96.8% (p=1.2e-4)，误报率从 52.8% 上升到 72.9% (p=4.9e-6)。下面，没有什么比这更好的了：AUC 0.800 与 0.811，并且检测结果与 10% 的误报率相同，精确到小数点后三位。省略臂没有这样的外部锚，原因我们在第 8 节中给出。One arm of the asymmetry can be checked against independent labels, written by physicians with no connection to this study. MEDEC is physician-labelled clinical text, each item either error-free or carrying exactly one error with its corrected version supplied; its five error types are all substitutions, so it contains no omissions to detect, and it has no source document, so the prompt’s transcript slot carries a no-source placeholder. Re-running the best of the eight on a 300-text stratified sample frozen before judging (156 errored texts and 144 error-free, each errored text paired with its own corrected version) gives paired 0.827 and AUC 0.811, with 51.3% of the 156 errored texts detected at a 10% false-alarm rate on the 144 error-free ones. The matched contrast with the same design on our omissions is the AUC pair, 0.811 against 0.575 (8.3% detection at 6.5% false alarms), so the commission side is externally anchored. What MEDEC anchors is the judge’s ability to spot a clinically wrong statement with no source to check it against - the closest external check available for the commission class, and not the same task as transcript verification. The same labels test the widest remedy of Section 6 in advance. Two prompts identical except that one adds ” AND complete” and the omission clause produce real-looking activity, with detection rising from 87.8% to 96.8% (p=1.2e-4) and false alarms from 52.8% to 72.9% (p=4.9e-6) over the 156 and 144 texts. Underneath, nothing separates better: AUC 0.800 against 0.811, and detection at a matched 10% false-alarm rate identical to three decimal places. The omission arm has no such external anchor, for a reason we give in Section 8.

5.5 人类评审员并不认同这种不对称性Human reviewers do not share the asymmetry

文献提供的比较器指向相反的方向。在一项针对人工智能起草的患者信息的植入错误研究中，审查医生发现遗漏的比率与客观错误大致相同，分别约为四分之一到三分之一。The comparator the literature supplies points the other way. In a planted-error study of AI-drafted patient messages, reviewing physicians caught omissions at roughly the same rate as objective errors, about a quarter to a third of each(Biro et al., 2025b)。我们没有运行我们自己的人类基线，并且该研究是在不同语料库上进行的不同任务，因此比较仅供参考（附录 I 收集了我们可以找到的每个已发布的人体模型）。谨慎阅读，这种不对称似乎是机器评审设置的特征，而不是评审的不可避免的属性：人类评审员也会漏掉遗漏，但不是有选择性的。. We did not run a human baseline of our own, and that study is a different task on a different corpus, so the comparison is indicative only (Appendix I collects every published human figure we could find). Read with that caution, the asymmetry appears to be characteristic of the machine-judge setting rather than an unavoidable property of review: human reviewers miss omissions too, but not selectively.

6 尝试的修复：五种补救措施移动工作点，没有恢复可用的检测Attempted fixes: five remedies move the operating point, none restores usable detection

我们测试了五种补救措施——法官检查什么、如何回答、获得多少票、提示的措辞方式以及让优化器重写提示。每个人都沿着相同的弱曲线移动法官的操作点，但没有产生可用的单音符分离；接下来报告了每次转变的大小，说明了所搜索的补救措施中数据无法排除的最大保留收益，并且没有说没有其他补救措施有效。所有五个都是在计算设置第 4 节记录中测量的，优化器在同一预算内进行搜索。另外两个杠杆位于它们之外：第 5 节显示的法官模型系列在保留不对称性的同时改变了绝对水平，以及第 7 节报告的推理预算。We tested five families of remedy - what the judge checks, how it answers, how many votes it gets, how the prompt is worded, and letting an optimiser rewrite the prompt. Every one shifted the judge’s operating point along the same weak curve without producing usable single-note separation; what follows reports the size of each shift, states for the searched remedy the largest held-out gain the data cannot exclude, and does not say that no other remedy would work. All five are measured at the compute settings Section 4 records, and the optimiser searched inside that same budget. Two further levers sit outside them: the judge model family, which Section 5 showed shifts absolute levels while leaving the asymmetry in place, and the reasoning budget, which Section 7 reports.

6.1 范围、格式和投票推动的是重点，而不是曲线Scope, format and voting move the point, not the curve

第 4 节的三个选择是前三个杠杆，它们的效果是适度的和累加的（表The three choices of Section 4 are the first three levers, and their effects are modest and additive (Table5, 图, Figure5）。标准范围具有最宽的每个设计增量跨度，+0.036 到 +0.082 配对，输出格式与平均值没有区别，询问八次而不是一次是最小且最不可靠的杠杆（表). Criterion scope has the widest span of per-design deltas, +0.036 to +0.082 paired, output format is indistinguishable from it on the mean, and asking eight times instead of once is the smallest and least reliable lever (Table5有每个跨度）。三者一起对遗漏进行配对歧视，从 0.500 到 0.634，而部署措施始终保持在噪音状态。has each span). Together the three take paired discrimination on omissions from 0.500 to 0.634 while the deployment measure stays at noise throughout.

6.2 一个措辞的改变是有帮助的，这是一条指示，而不是删除One wording change helps, and it is an instruction rather than a deletion

一个自然的实验可以回答措辞是否可以做得更好的问题。第 4 节（附录 H）部署的忠实法官包括“遗漏不是错误”这句话。三个版本的不同之处仅在于处理遗漏的方式——发货时、删除排除项以及添加报告遗漏的肯定指令——得分分别为 0.518、0.505 和 0.556，单音符检测率为 16.4%、13.1% 和 25.6%。删除排除项没有任何帮助，甚至会造成伤害。整个效果属于一个肯定指令，价值+0.051，与删除排除的版本配对，与上面最宽杠杆的顺序相同。所有三个标志 224 个干净音符判断中的 27 个，虽然音符不同，但比率相同，因此这是研究中措辞变化移动检测的地方，而没有测量误报成本 - 尽管在 12.1% 的误报率下，这三个措辞都不是可用的检测器。它仍然是 0.556，更接近于抛硬币，而不是同一位评委对现有内容得出的 0.89。A natural experiment answers whether wording can do better. The deployed faithfulness judge of Section 4 (Appendix H) includes the line “omissions are NOT errors”. Three versions differing only in how they treat omissions - as shipped, with the exclusion deleted, and with an affirmative instruction to report omissions added - score paired 0.518, 0.505 and 0.556, with single-note detection 16.4%, 13.1% and 25.6%. Deleting the exclusion does not help, and if anything hurts. The whole effect belongs to the one affirmative instruction, worth +0.051 paired over the version with the exclusion deleted, the same order as the widest lever above. All three flag 27 of 224 clean-note judgements, the same rate though not the same notes, so this is the one place in the study where a wording change moved detection at no measured cost in false alarms - though at a 12.1% false-alarm rate none of the three wordings is a usable detector. It is still a 0.556, closer to a coin flip than to the 0.89 the same judge reaches on content that is present.

6.3 及时优化有帮助吗？Does prompt optimisation help?

如果手动措辞是极限，下一步就是让优化器进行搜索。我们使用反射快速进化（GEPA）If hand-wording is the limit, the next step is to let an optimiser search. We used reflective prompt evolution (GEPA)(Agrawal et al., 2026)，它对训练示例运行判断提示，读取错误的自然语言痕迹，重写提示，并在得分更高时保留重写。我们进行了三个活动：探索性的第一关，其获胜者是提示第 5 部分的分数 0.549；第二个针对八个设计中最好的一个，它接受了一个得分低于其种子的突变，并且没有产生任何可用的东西；以及我们所依赖的确认运动。该活动通过协商分割其数据，其中 45 个可供学习，20 个作为候选人被保留或拒绝的接受集，47 个在搜索开始之前进行最终测试，并在最后触及一次（附录 B 包含全部三个）。, which runs a judge prompt over training examples, reads natural-language traces of what it got wrong, rewrites the prompt, and keeps a rewrite when it scores better. We ran three campaigns: an exploratory first pass, whose winner is the prompt Section 5 scores at 0.549; a second, aimed at the best of the eight designs, which accepted one mutation that scored below its own seed and produced nothing usable; and the confirmatory campaign we rest on. That campaign split its data by consultation, 45 to learn from, 20 as the acceptance set on which candidates were kept or rejected, and 47 held out for a final test committed before the search began and touched once, at the end (Appendix B carries all three in full).

没有任何增益能够通过持续的测试。针对管道的事实检查器，其中增益看起来最合理，获胜者在接受集上获得了 5.2 分的配对歧视，然后比未优化的基线差 2.3 分，区间为 [-7.4，+2.7]，不包括大于约 2.7 分的保留增益。针对最佳整体判断，获胜者清除了运行前固定的决策规则，并且保留的确认返回 +0.004 配对，这是单个基线运行在这些配对上产生的大约 ±0.06 噪声的十五分之一。对于使用优化器的任何人来说最重要的细节是：即使在其自己的接受集上，第一个目标的接受集增益也不显着，8 胜 3，p=0.23。保留的测试并没有推翻真实的效果；它拒绝证实在接受它的样本上无法与噪音区分开来的差异。这里，经过 20 次咨询的验证者向我们提供了 47 次咨询的验证集所没有看到的改进。No gain survived the held-out test. Aimed at the pipeline’s per-fact checker, where a gain looked most plausible, the winner gained 5.2 points of paired discrimination on the acceptance set, then came back 2.3 points worse than the unoptimised baseline held out, on an interval, [-7.4, +2.7], that excludes held-out gains larger than about 2.7 points. Aimed at the best monolithic judge, the winner cleared a decision rule fixed before the run and the held-out confirmation returned +0.004 paired, a fifteenth of the roughly ±0.06 of noise a single baseline run carries on these pairs. The detail that matters most for anyone who uses an optimiser: the first target’s acceptance-set gain was not significant even on its own acceptance set, at 8 wins against 3, p=0.23. The held-out test did not overturn a real effect; it declined to confirm a difference never distinguishable from noise on the very sample used to accept it. Here a 20-consultation validator handed us an improvement a 47-consultation held-out set did not see.

一种设置是所有三个活动的基础，并限制了它们的无效范围。候选提示是在第4部分的判断设置下执行的，只有编写重写的模型才有思考的空间。这很重要，因为探索性竞选活动的获胜提示的核心指令是首先列举文字记录的事实，然后逐一检查它们，这一过程需要空间来执行，而在这三项搜索中，没有任何候选人拥有这个空间。在具有推理预算的保留子集上重新运行不变，这会提示从该子集上的 0.546 移动到配对遗漏上的 0.669，并获得可用的标志规则。第 7 节将其视为该研究的两个工作探测器之一，即进化提示。因此，空值与仅限于预算的搜索是一致的，在预算中，它一直提出的策略无法运行，就像单一判断的任何限制一样。关于如何进行评估的决定，在搜索报告的所有内容中不可见，决定了它似乎发现了什么。有两个界限：措辞 null 保留在搜索评分的设置下，并且将预算恢复到已选择的提示与按该预算进行搜索不同，我们没有运行该实验。One setting underlies all three campaigns and bounds how far their null reaches. Candidate prompts were executed at the judge settings of Section 4, and only the model writing the rewrites was given room to think. That matters because the exploratory campaign’s winning prompt has as its central instruction to enumerate the transcript’s facts first and then check them one by one, a procedure that takes room to carry out, and no candidate in any of the three searches ever had that room. Re-run unchanged on the held-out subset with a reasoning budget, that prompt moves from 0.546 on that subset to 0.669 paired on omissions and acquires a usable flag rule. Section 7 takes it up as one of the study’s two working detectors, the evolved prompt. So the nulls are consistent with a search confined to a budget in which the strategy it kept proposing could not run, as much as with any limit of monolithic judging. A decision about how the evaluation was run, invisible in everything the search reported, determined what it appeared to find. Two bounds stand: the wording null holds at the settings the searches scored under, and restoring the budget to an already-selected prompt is not the same experiment as searching at that budget, which we did not run.

6.4 原因：遗漏没有什么可指出的Why: an omission leaves nothing to point at

这种模式背后有一个机制，它不仅仅是我们的推论。 AbsenceBench 在一般语言模型中识别了这一点 - 变压器注意力无法轻易关注间隙，因为缺席没有提供需要关注的键 - 并通过插入占位符标记来确认它，使每个间隙在输入中可见，从而恢复大部分损失The pattern has a mechanism behind it, and it is not our inference alone. AbsenceBench identified it for language models in general - transformer attention cannot easily attend to gaps, because an absence supplies no keys to attend to - and confirmed it by inserting placeholder markers that make each gap visible in the input, recovering much of the loss(Fu et al., 2025)。注释中的遗漏在评估层面也存在同样的问题：寻求证据的法官无法引用任何内容，而委员会则将有问题的文本留在手中。上述每一种补救措施都会改变法官的态度或报告的方式；没有人创建它要查看的东西，并且评估者无法进行占位符修复，因为知道差距在哪里就已经是答案了。与此相一致的是，在人口普查验证小组中，候选调查结果的存续性追踪了一项主张的客观可核查程度（错误剂量 32.2%，捏造 24.6%，遗漏 6.1%）。优化活动从另一方面提出了同样的观点：搜索被要求修复判断并可以自由编写任何内容，将枚举写入其获胜提示中 - 同样将缺席转换为存在检查，是发现的而不是设计的。. An omission in a note is the same problem at the evaluation layer: nothing for an evidence-seeking judge to cite, where a commission leaves the offending text in hand. Every remedy above changes how hard the judge looks or how it reports; none creates the thing it would look at, and the placeholder repair is unavailable to an evaluator, because knowing where the gap is would already be the answer. Consistent with this, in the census’s verification panel the survival of candidate findings tracks how objectively checkable a claim is (wrong dose 32.2%, fabrication 24.6%, omission 6.1%). The optimisation campaigns make the same point from the other side: the search, asked to fix the judge and free to write anything, wrote enumeration into its winning prompt - the same conversion of absence into presence checks, found rather than designed.

7 有效方法：将缺勤问题转化为在场检查What works: convert the absence question into presence checks

本节报告恢复检测的内容，首先说明其大小：这里最好的方法以可用的误报率捕获了略高于三分之一的遗漏音符，这是一种改进，而不是解决方案。补救扫描中的一项测量指向不同的地方。标准评估工具已经包含一个基于事实的配方：一次提取源文档的事实，对照评估中的文本检查每个事实，标记任何未完全覆盖的内容。第 4 节的 RAGAS 风格配方，我们自己在该谱系中故意天真的实现，在交付时无法使用，每次咨询检查大约 62 个未经审计的事实，没有真正的注释，因此标记了 98.7% 的干净注释。下面的分数是另一回事：扫到校准阈值后，它在 10.0% 的误报率下达到 20.9% 的检测率，而八个设计中最好的设计则达到 8.3% 和 6.5% 的检测率，并且其覆盖率组件在遗漏配对上的读数为 0.817，超过了同一对的所有整体判断。一旦法官有了要检查的具体事实列表，遗漏信号就会出现，而聚合到注释级标志会破坏它，因此该问题有两个可分离的瓶颈：生成足够好的事实列表，并一直保留每个事实的证据直至做出判决。This section reports what recovers detection, with its size stated first: the best method here catches a little over a third of notes with an omission at a usable false-alarm rate, an improvement rather than a solution. One measurement in the remedy sweep points somewhere different. Standard evaluation tooling already contains a per-fact recipe: extract the source document’s facts once, check each one against the text under evaluation, flag anything not fully covered. The RAGAS-style recipe of Section 4, our own deliberately naive implementation in that lineage, is unusable as shipped, checking roughly 62 unaudited facts per consultation that no real note carries and so flagging 98.7% of clean notes. The score underneath is another matter: swept to a calibrated threshold it reaches 20.9% detection at 10.0% false alarms against 8.3% at 6.5% for the best of the eight designs, and its coverage component alone reads 0.817 paired on omissions, past every monolithic judge on the same pairs. The omission signal appears as soon as the judge has a list of concrete facts to check, and the aggregation into a note-level flag destroys it, so the problem has two separable bottlenecks: producing a good enough fact list, and preserving the per-fact evidence all the way to the decision.

两种方法将缺勤问题转化为在场检查，并独立得出（图Two methods convert the absence question into presence checks, and arrived at it independently (Figure6两者都绘制；发布的数据将它们标记为路线一和路线二）。draws both; the released data labels them route one and route two).枚举然后检查管道The enumerate-then-check pipeline，简称管道，将其构建到架构中，具有永远看不到注释的提取调用、严重性分级审计以及每个事实的封闭的存在或不存在判决。, the pipeline for short, builds it into the architecture, with an extraction call that never sees the note, a severity-graded audit, and a closed present-or-absent verdict per fact.进化后的提示The evolved prompt在一次通话中执行此操作。这是第 6 节中探索性活动的获胜提示，一旦给出执行其自己的枚举然后检查指令的预算，它就会成为一个工作探测器。does it inside one call. It is the exploratory campaign’s winning prompt from Section 6, which becomes a working detector once given the budget to execute its own enumerate-then-check instruction.

7.1 管道：在判断时间时做什么施工The pipeline: do at judging time what construction did

第三部分的施工面对法官的问题，从来没有问过“有什么遗漏吗？”。它列举了笔录所证实的事实并检查了每一项。用于遗漏测量的事实枚举并不是什么新鲜事 - MED-OMIT 在 2023 年为医疗摘要构建了它Construction in Section 3 faced the judge’s problem and never asked “is anything missing?”. It enumerated the facts the transcript establishes and checked each one. Fact enumeration for omission measurement is not new - MED-OMIT built it for medical summaries in 2023(Schumacher et al., 2023)- 但尚未显示的是，它可以在每种单一补救措施失败的情况下恢复法官检测，以及如何处理判决。在推理时执行此操作提供了一条管道：仅从记录中提取临床重要事实，而不是从注释中提取，因此盲目性是结构性的而不是承诺的，然后作为封闭式查找对照注释验证每个事实。- but what has not been shown is that it recovers judge detection where every monolithic remedy fails, and what to do with the verdicts. Doing it at inference time gives a pipeline: extract the clinically material facts from the transcript alone, never from the note, so blindness is structural rather than promised, then verify each fact against the note as a closed lookup.两级管道The two-stage pipeline（已发布数据和本文表格中的 B2）到此为止，对每个音符进行一次键控的存在或缺席呼叫。(B2 in the released data and in this paper’s tables) stops there, making one keyed present-or-absent call per note.三级管道The three-stage pipeline(B3) 增加了批评家审计，删除不受支持或重复的事实，根据第 3 节的标题对每个幸存者的严重程度进行评分，并对任何标记为缺席的内容进行经过引用验证的第二次审查。这两层都没有提前确定标志阈值。下面的每个工作点均经过扫描并引用其各自的误报率（附录 C）。(B3) adds a critic audit that drops unsupported or duplicated facts, grades each survivor’s severity against the rubric of Section 3, and runs a quote-verified second look over anything flagged absent. Neither tier fixes a flag threshold in advance. Every operating point below is swept and quoted with its own false-alarm rate (Appendix C).

7.2 坚持认为，枚举有效，并且盲人医生也同意Held out, enumeration works, and a blinded physician agrees

在 47 次咨询中的 151 个保留对中（131 个遗漏和 20 个委托，针对 47 个干净双胞胎），两阶段管道的遗漏配对歧视率达到 0.786，作为跨越 0.771 至 0.801 的三轮运行的平均值，而最佳整体法官对同一对的三轮运行的平均值为 0.531 至 0.649。管道的最差运行与基线的最佳运行相差 0.12，均值相差 +0.19，重复的差异 +0.20 的 95% 区间为 [0.14, 0.27]，每次咨询均算作一次观察；在 47 次协商中，有 25 次管道比单一法官正确排序的配对较多，而在 7 次协商中正确排序的配对较少 (p=0.002)。这三轮运行还衡量稳定性。两阶段层的跨度为 0.031，三阶段层的跨度为 0.015，而对于相同对的整体判断，跨度为 0.118，因此被测臂显示了其测量基准的运行间跨度的四分之一。On 151 held-out pairs over 47 consultations (131 omissions and 20 commissions, against 47 clean twins), the two-stage pipeline reaches 0.786 paired discrimination on omissions as a mean of three runs spanning 0.771 to 0.801, against 0.531 to 0.649 for the best monolithic judge’s three runs on those same pairs. The pipeline’s worst run clears the baseline’s best by 0.12, the means differ by +0.19, and replicate one’s difference of +0.20 has a 95% interval of [0.14, 0.27] with each consultation counted as one observation; the pipeline orders more of its pairs correctly than the monolithic judge on 25 of the 47 consultations and fewer on 7 (p=0.002). The three runs also measure stability. The two-stage tier’s span is 0.031 and the three-stage tier’s 0.015, against 0.118 for the monolithic judge on the identical pairs, so the arm under test shows a quarter of the run-to-run spread of the baseline it is measured against.

配对数字从探索性通道复制而来，从 0.828 到 0.786；单音符数字却没有，从误报率 9.4% 的 31.2% 减半到误报率 8.5% 的 16.0%，而 16.0% 就是我们报告的数字。在这些相同的对上，RAGAS 风格的配方（不与管道共享提示文本）通过其覆盖组件达到 0.801 - 与管道自己的三运行范围的顶部相匹配 - 尽管它在其自然规则下没有可用的操作点，也没有严重性等级。The paired figure replicated from the exploratory pass, 0.828 to 0.786; the single-note figure did not, halving from 31.2% at 9.4% false alarms to 16.0% at 8.5%, and 16.0% is the figure we report. On those same pairs the RAGAS-style recipe, sharing no prompt text with the pipeline, reaches 0.801 through its coverage component - matching the top of the pipeline’s own three-run range - though it has no usable operating point under its natural rule and no severity grades.

最强烈的反对意见是循环性：管道类似于基准测试自己的构建，两者都从记录中枚举事实，因此它的胜利可能是构建和判断之间的一致性，而不是任务的属性。反对意见也有模型级形式，因为管道的提取阶段在构建情况说明书的固定模型上运行，并在验证对的模型上进行审核（附录 D）。三行证据回答了这两种形式。 RAGAS 式的配方落在管道自己的运行范围内，有自己的提示，其事实是由判断模型提取的，而不是由构建答案键的模型（附录 D）提取的，并且另一个机构的并发工作在不同的临床任务上报告了相同的整体零值和阈值偏移模式The strongest objection is circularity: the pipeline resembles the benchmark’s own construction, both enumerating facts from the transcript, so its win could be alignment between construction and judging rather than a property of the task. The objection has a model-level form too, since the pipeline’s extraction stage runs on the pinned model that built the fact sheets and its audit on the model that verified the pairs (Appendix D). Three lines of evidence answer both forms. The RAGAS-style recipe lands inside the pipeline’s own run-to-run range with prompts of its own and with its facts extracted by the judge model, not by the model that built the answer key (Appendix D), and concurrent work at another institution reports the same monolithic null and threshold-shift pattern on a different clinical task(DeLucia et al., 2026)。提取仪器在盲目运行的情况下，在其自己的评论小组保存的表格上恢复了 99.4% 在任何管道存在之前由人类编写的事实。一位盲目的医生裁定了三级管道和最佳整体法官之间的真正分歧（表. The extraction instrument, run blind, recovers 99.4% of facts authored by humans before any pipeline existed, on the sheets its own critic panel kept. And a blinded physician adjudicated real disagreements between the three-stage pipeline and the best monolithic judge (Table6).

两者得出相反结论的十个注释被交给一位医生作者，这些注释是根据种子确定性地从确认运行的 35 个分歧注释中抽取的，每次咨询一个，并根据覆盖范围而不是预期结果进行分层。评分者不知道哪位法官说了什么或该注释是否经过编辑，并且弃权被视为真正的答案。他们零次投了弃权票，并在 10 次中的 10 次（[72.2, 100]，p=0.002）中站在了管道一边，在单一法官的旗帜归因于他们面前的事实的子集上，他们以 8-0 的票数站在了管道一边。在十个中的六个中，管道将事实建筑拆除，因此这六个被解读为单一法官错过了经过验证的缺席，而不是公开竞赛；另外四个是整体法官标记的三个和规则的一个干净音符标记。十人中的六人在整个咨询记录中向临床医生提出了本文的主张 - 缺少克林霉素过敏，缺少墨菲氏征阳性 - 以及图Ten notes where the two reach opposite conclusions went to a physician author, drawn deterministically by seed, one per consultation, from the confirmation run’s 35 disagreement notes and stratified for coverage rather than by expected outcome. The rater was not told which judge said what or whether the note had been edited, and abstention was offered as a real answer. They abstained zero times and sided with the pipeline on 10 of 10 ([72.2, 100], p=0.002), and 8–0 on the subset where the monolithic judge’s flag is attributable to the fact in front of them. In six of the ten the pipeline had named the fact construction removed, so those six read as the monolithic judge missing a verified absence rather than as an open contest; the other four are the three the monolithic judge flagged and the rule’s one clean-note flag. Six of the ten put this paper’s claim in front of a clinician on a whole consultation note - a missing clindamycin allergy, a missing positive Murphy’s sign - and Figure1步行其中一个从头到尾。这是对选定的分歧的有条件结果，评估者是作者；阅读这本书时要考虑到这两个事实。这是 70 项测试中的三个结构盲阶段之一（附录 E）。walks one of them end to end. This is a conditional result on selected disagreements and the rater is an author; read it with both facts in view. It was one of three structurally blinded stages in a 70-item sitting (Appendix E).

7.3 产生信号的因素：列表占其中的三分之一，其余部分为封闭式判决What creates the signal: the list is a third of it, the closed verdicts the rest

两个控制装置定位该机制，将两个听起来相似的想法分开。 G-评估Two controls locate the mechanism, separating two ideas that sound alike. G-Eval分解判断decomposes the judgement，将评分分为抽象标准，但仍将每个评分作为整个笔记的开放性问题进行询问，其表现就像整体法官一样，遗漏为 0.568，佣金为 0.890。检查清单法官进行到一半, splitting scoring into abstract criteria but still asking each as an open question over the whole note, and it performs like the monolithic judges, 0.568 on omissions against 0.890 on commissions. The checklist judge goes halfway to列举事实enumerating the facts，从记录中生成大约 25 项清单并回答每个项目，在评估集上，它落在 0.647 之间，相对于单一最佳值 0.634 和约 62 个事实的 RAGAS 式食谱的覆盖率部分 0.817。产生信号的是列出要检查的具体事实，而不是将判断分成标准，更完整的列表只能在一定程度上有所帮助：在同一评估集上，约 25 项清单的读数为 0.647，而约 62 项事实配方的读数为 0.817，而在相同的保留对上，配方的约 62 个事实落在两级管道约 39 的运行范围内（第 7.2 节），因此超出了一个相当完整的列表，其长度不再重要。, generating a roughly 25-item checklist from the transcript and answering each item, and on the evaluation set it falls between at 0.647, against the monolithic best of 0.634 and the ~62-fact RAGAS-style recipe’s coverage component at 0.817. What creates the signal is listing the concrete facts to check rather than splitting the judgement into criteria, and a fuller list helps only up to a point: the ~25-item checklist reads 0.647 against the ~62-fact recipe’s 0.817 on the same evaluation set, while on identical held-out pairs the recipe’s ~62 facts land inside the run-to-run range of the two-stage pipeline’s ~39 (Section 7.2), so beyond a reasonably complete list its length stops mattering.

将两者分开的控制：在其提示中给出相同的整体判断管道自己的审核事实列表，但保留单个开放分数。在这些保留的对上，将列表交给法官，在一次运行中将配对遗漏从 0.570 移动到 0.634，而对照其自己的三轮运行跨度为 0.508 到 0.603 - 这一增益清除了该控制，并且仍然停止在最好的整体法官自己对这些对的三轮分布（0.531 到 0.649）内。 （0.634 是一个保留的数字，并且巧合地与第 5 节的最佳评估集共享其数字。）通读同类列表The control that separates the two: give the same monolithic judge the pipeline’s own audited fact list in its prompt, but keep the single open score. On these held-out pairs, handing the judge the list moves paired omissions from 0.570 to 0.634 in one run, against a control whose own three runs span 0.508 to 0.603 - a gain that clears that control and still stops inside the best monolithic judge’s own three-run spread on these pairs, 0.531 to 0.649. (That 0.634 is a held-out figure and shares its digits, by coincidence, with the evaluation-set best of Section 5.) A list of the same kind read through封闭的事实输出结构a closed per-fact output structure（针对每个事实的在场或缺席判决，而不是在注释上加一分）达到 0.786； 7.4 节给出了两种列表大小。在普通法官与管道之间的差距中，名单约占三分之一，其余的则为封闭式判决。事实块是一个真正的即时更改，因此该收益的一部分可能是块本身的措辞；两个提示之间的标准和答案格式保持相同，这限制了在不排除它的情况下可以解释的措辞数量。即使拿着列表，法官也会将所有 198 个保留的音符压缩到四个不同的分值上：列表不会停止压缩，它只会改变压缩的内容。 AbsenceBench 的占位符修复修复了输入表示，这里的输入是修复的较小部分。此次重组在法官家族的更迭后仍然存在，规则在几乎相同的操作点上进行了转移，并进行了一级逆转，完整内容见附录 G。(a present-or-absent verdict keyed to each fact, rather than one score over the note) reaches 0.786; Section 7.4 gives the two list sizes. Of the gap between a plain monolithic judge and the pipeline, having the list accounts for roughly a third and the closed verdicts for the rest. The fact block is a real prompt change, so part of that gain could be the wording of the block itself; the criterion and the answer format were held identical between the two prompts, which limits how much wording could account for without excluding it. Even holding the list, the judge compresses all 198 held-out notes onto four distinct score values: a list does not stop the compression, it only changes what is compressed. Where AbsenceBench’s placeholder repair fixes the input representation, here the input is the smaller part of the fix. The restructuring survives the change of judge family, with the rule transferring at almost the same operating point and one tier reversal, in full in Appendix G.

7.4 深思熟虑是一个真正的杠杆，而不是机制Deliberation is a real lever, and it is not the mechanism

到目前为止，每个控制都保持法官的计算固定，留下一个替代解读：管道为每个事实花费一次调用，而整体设计花费一个简短的答案，因此差异可能是思考时间而不是任务结构。我们在相同的 151 个保留对上进行了测试，方法是为整体提示提供推理预算并且不改变任何其他内容（表Every control so far holds the judge’s compute fixed, leaving one alternative reading: the pipeline spends a call per fact where a monolithic design spends one short answer, so the difference could be thinking time rather than task structure. We tested it on the same 151 held-out pairs by giving the monolithic prompts a reasoning budget and changing nothing else (Table7).

计算是一个真正的杠杆，它的价值取决于提示。将简单的完整性评分法官从没有推理努力提高到高提升，对遗漏的配对歧视从 0.570 提高到 0.670，+0.101 [+0.048，+0.153]，并且剂量单调；它根本没有给工程法官带来任何好处，+0.013 [-0.047，+0.071]，而进化的提示最多，+0.123 [+0.059，+0.189]。Compute is a real lever, and what it is worth depends on the prompt. Raising the plain completeness-scored judge from no reasoning effort to high lifts paired discrimination on omissions from 0.570 to 0.670, +0.101 [+0.048, +0.153] and monotonic in dose; it gives the engineered judge nothing at all, +0.013 [-0.047, +0.071], and the evolved prompt the most, +0.123 [+0.059, +0.189].

我们可以同时集结两种优势的最强大的整体法官 - 管道在提示中自己审计的事实列表和高推理预算 - 达到 0.699，仍然比两阶段管道在同一对上的 0.786 低约 0.09，来自相同类型的列表：已审计的 37.6 事实列表与两阶段层的 39.2 未经审计的事实。每个音符的成本大约是管道检查阶段的三倍。因此，预算本身缩小了普通完整性评分法官与管道之间距离的大约一半（0.570 到 0.670，而管道为 0.786），然后停止，并且其价值在提示之间存在一个数量级的差异，因此它是一个真正的杠杆，而不是重组任务的替代品。The strongest monolithic judge we can assemble with both advantages at once - the pipeline’s own audited fact list in the prompt and a high reasoning budget - reaches 0.699, still about 0.09 below the two-stage pipeline’s 0.786 on the same pairs, from a list of the same kind: the audited 37.6-fact list against the two-stage tier’s 39.2 unaudited facts. It costs about three times as much per note as the pipeline’s checking stage. So the budget on its own closes roughly half the distance between the plain completeness-scored judge and the pipeline (0.570 to 0.670, against the pipeline’s 0.786) and then stops, and what it is worth varies by an order of magnitude across prompts, so it is a real lever rather than a substitute for restructuring the task.

添加计算后，有两件事并没有改善，其中一件事变得更糟。对添加和更改的内容的成对歧视随着给定的每个提示的预算而增加，在此子集中的 20 个佣金对上（足以解读为方向，而不是大小），因此存在与不存在的不对称性随着计算而扩大而不是缩小。在其他地方重述的遗漏始终是偶然的，在四个提示表中配对为 0.495 到 0.546Two things do not improve when compute is added, and one of them gets worse. Paired discrimination on added and altered content rises with the budget for every prompt given one, on the 20 commission pairs in this subset (enough to read as a direction, not a size), so the presence-versus-absence asymmetry widens with compute instead of closing. And the omission whose restatement survives elsewhere stays at chance throughout, 0.495 to 0.546 paired across the four prompts Table7报告。reports.

7.5 根据判决而不是分数采取行动Act on the verdicts, not a score

三阶段管道根据事实产生分级判决，但仍然必须做出注释级决策，而传统的做法是将判决平均化为覆盖分数并对其进行阈值化，这是使用它们的较弱方法。干净的笔记平均覆盖率是 0.953，遗漏的笔记平均覆盖率是 0.929，因此每个阈值都在 2.4 分以内，因为大约 38 个缺失的事实几乎没有改变平均值。可用对象是The three-stage pipeline produces a graded verdict per fact and still has to make a note-level decision, and the conventional move, averaging the verdicts into a coverage score and thresholding it, is the weak way to use them. Clean notes average 0.953 coverage and notes with omissions 0.929, so every threshold cuts inside a 2.4-point sliver, because one missing fact among about 38 barely moves an average. The usable object is事实规则the per-fact rule，对单个判决的规则：, a rule over the individual verdicts:如果判断不存在任何评级为关键的事实，则标记注释flag the note if any fact graded critical is judged absent.

坚持下去，该规则捕获了 20.6% 的包含遗漏的音符（131 个中的 27 个，[13.8, 28.2]；重复两个和三个读数分别为 22.9% 和 21.4%，三块土地中的绝对多数为 21.4% [15.2, 29.2]，因此我们报告的数字是三者中最低的）以及带有遗漏的 32.8%。严重程度的遗漏（58 次中的 19 次；另外两次运行中分别为 37.9% 和 34.5%），误报率为 2.1%（47 次中的 1 次，[0.4, 11.1]）——所有三次运行中都有相同的单一干净音符，因此规则的安静属于规则而不是一颗种子。以咨询作为推理单位 (p=2e-06)，与其自身噪声的分离非常显着，并且仅适用于统一构建的遗漏子集（16.7%，90 中的 15，p=0.008）。Held out, the rule catches 20.6% of notes containing an omission (27 of 131, [13.8, 28.2]; replicates two and three read 22.9% and 21.4%, and a strict majority of the three lands at 21.4% [15.2, 29.2], so the figure we report is the lowest of the three) and 32.8% of those carrying a critical-severity omission (19 of 58; 37.9% and 34.5% in the other two runs), at a false-alarm rate of 2.1% (1 of 47, [0.4, 11.1]) - the same single clean note in all three runs, so the rule’s quietness belongs to the rule and not to one seed. The separation from its own noise is significant with the consultation as the unit of inference (p=2e-06) and holds on the uniformly built omission subset alone (16.7%, 15 of 90, p=0.008).

在相同的噪声水平下，这些的最佳阈值At that same noise level the best threshold on these同样的判决”same verdicts’总分控制在7.6%（图aggregate score manages 7.6% (Figure7）。该规则的检测率是相同证据的 2.7 倍，并且法官没有添加任何内容，仅添加了读取其输出的方式。它是在确认运行后通过重新分析已记录的判决而制定的，然后对照之前的探索性通行证（其判决早于该通行证）进行检查，并保持在 25.0% 和 6.2% 之间。它的一个干净的标志自始至终都是一场虚惊，因为医生作者将其重新评级为支持而不是批评（附录E）。). The rule delivers 2.7 times the detection from identical evidence, and nothing was added to the judge, only the way its output is read. It was formulated after the confirmation run by re-analysing verdicts already recorded, then checked against the earlier exploratory pass, whose verdicts predate it, and held at 25.0% at 6.2%. Its one clean-note flag stands as a false alarm throughout, on a fact the physician author re-graded supporting rather than critical (Appendix E).

该规则也是可扩展的。在完整的 495 对评估集中，其提示是手写的，从未对任何内容进行过优化，尽管 112 次咨询中的 47 次是制定规则的保留子集，它以 2.7% 的误报率捕获了 24.6% 的包含遗漏的注释（293 次中的 72 次，[20.0, 29.8]）（112 次干净双胞胎中的 3 次，[0.9， 7.6]），39.7% 的遗漏被评为严重（151 项中的 60 项）；未制定规则的 162 个遗漏对本身占 27.8%，因此制定子集不包含合并率。表The rule also scales. Over the full 495-pair evaluation set - whose prompts are hand-written and were never optimised on anything, though 47 of its 112 consultations are the held-out subset the rule was formulated on - it catches 24.6% of notes containing an omission (72 of 293, [20.0, 29.8]) at a 2.7% false-alarm rate (3 of 112 clean twins, [0.9, 7.6]), and 39.7% of the omissions graded critical (60 of 151); the 162 omission pairs the rule was not formulated on read 27.8% on their own, so the pooled rate is not carried by the formulation subset. Table8列出了该余量背后的每个设计的比较。误报率低于 5% 时，主要家庭中的一个总阈值将其检测率与其自身的误报率区分开来，而工程法官的误报率为 8.4%，而误报率为 2.7% (z = 2.88)，而该规则在相同的速率下检测到的误报率是其检测率的 2.9 倍。sets out the per-design comparison behind that margin. Below 5% false alarms exactly one aggregate threshold in the primary family separates its detection from its own false-alarm rate by more than chance, the engineered judge’s 8.4% at the same 2.7% (z = 2.88), and the rule detects 2.9 times as much at an identical rate.

该规则需要一种较便宜的管道无法提供的成分：每个事实都附有严重程度等级The rule needs one ingredient the cheaper pipeline cannot supply: a severity grade attached to every fact在评判任何音符之前before any note is judged，两阶段层永远不会产生，因此根本无法在其输出上说明该规则。三阶段层的审计根据第 3 节的标题对每个事实进行评分，这就是该阶段的目的：审计最初是围绕其全部/部分/缺席判决建立的，这是一个无法在样本外复制的诊断（附录 C），其严重性等级被证明是重要的输出。, which the two-stage tier never produces, so the rule cannot be stated on its output at all. The three-stage tier’s audit grades every fact against the rubric of Section 3, and that turns out to be what the stage is for: the audit was originally built around its full/partial/absent verdict, a diagnostic that did not replicate out of sample (Appendix C), and its severity grades proved to be the output that matters.

然后，级别之间的选择将按成本计算，而不是排名。两阶段等级的配对得分较高 - 0.786，而三轮平均得分为 0.762，并且在每次单独运行中 - 成本只有五分之一。三阶段层赢得了部署措施，其中较便宜的层读数为零：在相同的 10% 误报预算内作为覆盖分数进行扫描，它捕获了 12.1% 的重述跟踪遗漏，而两阶段层的零则为 31.0%，而关键遗漏为 20.7%。这些是各个级别的横扫分数。事实规则本身根本没有捕获任何重述痕迹（第 7.8 节）。只有三级层才能表达这个规则。The choice between tiers is then costed rather than ranked. The two-stage tier has the higher paired score - 0.786 against 0.762 as three-run means, and in every individual run - at one fifth of the cost. The three-stage tier wins the deployment measure where the cheaper tier reads zero: swept as a coverage score inside the same 10% false-alarm budget, it catches 12.1% of restatement-trace omissions held out against the two-stage tier’s zero, and 31.0% of critical omissions against 20.7%. Those are the tiers’ swept scores. The per-fact rule itself catches no restatement traces at all (Section 7.8). Only the three-stage tier can express that rule.

第 7.2 节的医师作者对规则触发的 10 个事实进行了重新评级，确认了盲通中 10 个事实中的 1 个（[1.8, 40.4]）和非盲协调后 10 个事实中的 6 个（[31.3, 83.2]）的关键性——一半的差距是快速盲通未权衡的背景——并对所有 10 个临床材料进行了评分。这并没有改变规则的评分，因为它们是根据人为缺勤来衡量的，但这确实意味着旗帜的“关键”程度比本研究中一位临床医生评分者在常规内容上的评分高出大约一级（附录 E）；第 8 节将精益视为评估者的属性，而不是评分标准的属性。规则的安静也基于同样的事情。其低误报率是审计阶段关键阈值的一个属性，从临床医生等级重新设置的阈值会改变它：设置在评估者自己的临界线上，它会在更少的事实上触发，并设置在临床材料上，这十个都是更多的。对存储的判决进行重新评分是本研究中最便宜的下一个实验（第 9 节）。The physician author of Section 7.2 re-graded ten of the facts the rule fired on, confirming critical on 1 of the 10 in the blind pass ([1.8, 40.4]) and on 6 of 10 ([31.3, 83.2]) after unblinded reconciliation - half the gap being context the fast blind pass had not weighed - and grading all ten clinically material. That does not move the rule’s rates, measured as they are against constructed absence, but it does mean a flag’s “critical” sat about one grade above this study’s one clinician rater’s own on routine content (Appendix E); Section 8 reads that lean as a property of the rater rather than of the rubric. The rule’s quietness rests on the same thing. Its low false-alarm rate is a property of the audit stage’s critical threshold, and a threshold re-set from clinician grades would move it: set at the rater’s own critical line it would fire on fewer facts, and set at clinically material, which all ten were, on more. Re-scoring the stored verdicts under either is the cheapest next experiment in the study (Section 9).

7.6 进化后的提示：一次调用内相同的转换The evolved prompt: the same conversion inside one call

第二种方法不需要管道机械。进化的提示是探索性活动的第 6 节的 GEPA 进化提示（The second method needs no pipeline machinery. The evolved prompt is the exploratory campaign’s GEPA-evolved prompt of Section 6 (gepa-04发布中的路线，以及发布的数据和图表中的路线二），其中心指令是首先枚举成绩单的事实，然后检查每个事实，在 12,000 代币上限下以高推理努力不变地重新运行，使用不同的种子运行 3 次。如果没有预算，相同的提示就没有可比的工作点，在 9.6% 的误报率下达到 10.3% 的检测率，扫到了 10% 的上限，因此下面的“改进的提示”始终意味着这种预算配置。由于有执行自己指令的空间，它做了一些主要家庭中的整体设计在其固定规则中没有做过的事情：它在音阶的顶部得分干净的音符。 （第二个家庭的简单完整性评分法官也做了同样的事情，附录 G 报告了给出它的操作点。）在 47 个被保留的干净双胞胎中，三个运行得分为 45、46 和 45，其中 10 分正好是 10 分，这将“标记任何低于 10 的东西”变成了从业者可以陈述的规则。根据该规则，三张中的严格多数捕获了 131 张保留票据中的 32.1% [24.7, 40.5]，其中包含遗漏，误报率为 2.1%。in the release, and route two in the released data and the figures), whose central instruction is to enumerate the transcript’s facts first and then check each one, re-run unchanged at high reasoning effort under a 12,000-token cap, three times with different seeds. Without the budget the same prompt has no comparable operating point, reaching 10.3% detection at 9.6% false alarms held out, swept to a 10% ceiling, so “the evolved prompt” below always means this budgeted configuration. With room to execute its own instruction it does something no monolithic design in the primary family did at its fixed rule: it scores clean notes at the top of the scale. (The second family’s plain completeness-scored judge does the same, and Appendix G reports the operating point that gives it.) On the 47 held-out clean twins the three runs score 45, 46 and 45 of them at exactly 10 out of 10, which turns “flag anything below 10” into a rule a practitioner can state. Under it the strict majority of three catches 32.1% [24.7, 40.5] of the 131 held-out notes containing an omission at a 2.1% false-alarm rate.

完整的评估集对于这个提示也是一个公平的测试，因为它的开发池完全是从语料库中划分出来的，并且在 2.4 倍的样本下，规则仍然有效，在一个更吵闹的点。与按事实规则相比，三多数规则以 6.2% 的误报率（112 个干净双胞胎中的 7 个，[3.1, 12.3]）捕获了 293 个包含遗漏的注释中的 36.9%（[31.5, 42.5]），并捕获了 58.9% 的严重严重遗漏（151 个中的 89 个）。 39.7% 的笔记相同。按痕迹级别，标记遵循研究的梯度：完全去除的 53.3%（150 个中的 80 个）、碎片痕迹的 27.9%（86 个中的 24 个）和重述的 7.0%（57 个中的 4 个）——这种情况击败了这里的所有可部署方法（第 7.8 节）。The full evaluation set is a fair test for this prompt too, since its development pool was carved out of the corpus entirely, and at 2.4x the sample the rule still works, at a noisier point. The majority-of-three rule catches 36.9% of the 293 notes containing an omission ([31.5, 42.5]) at a 6.2% false-alarm rate (7 of 112 clean twins, [3.1, 12.3]), and 58.9% of the critical-severity omissions (89 of 151), against the per-fact rule’s 39.7% on the same notes. By trace level the flags follow the study’s gradient: 53.3% of complete removals (80 of 150), 27.9% of fragment traces (24 of 86), and 7.0% of restatements (4 of 57) - the case that defeats every deployable method here (Section 7.8).

该方法的两个属性是测量的而不是假设的。首先，阈值是校准而非设计保证。它是从第一个重复的分数分布中读出的，然后在其他两个种子和完整的评估集中保持不变。它之所以有效，是因为干净音符的得分正好为 10，并且在整个集合中得分有所减弱 - 96% 到 98% 的保留双胞胎得分为 10，而评估集双胞胎的得分为 90% 到 94%，这就是为什么误报分别为 2.1% 和 6.2% - 因此部署必须在自己的干净音符上重新建立它。在同伴普查的真实供应商记录中，校准完全失败，55.8% 的面板清除记录得分为 10，并且仅在重新建立阈值后才存在可用点（附录 K）。其次，校准在法官家庭之间转移：在第二个家庭中，相同的提示将 47 个被保留的双胞胎中的 43 到 45 分打为 10，并读取 34.4% 的检测率和 6.4% 的误报。该方法买不到的是歧视或解释。其对遗漏的配对得分为 0.669，远低于管道在相同配对上的 0.786 的得分，以及根据公约表设置的完整评估的 0.670 的得分Two properties of the method are measured rather than assumed. First, the threshold is a calibration and not a design guarantee. It was read off the first replicate’s score distribution and then held unchanged across the other two seeds and the full evaluation set. It works only because clean notes score exactly 10, and that softens on the full set - 96 to 98% of the held-out twins sat at 10 against 90 to 94% of the evaluation-set twins, which is why the false alarms read 2.1% and 6.2% - so a deployment would have to re-establish it on its own clean notes. On the companion census’s real vendor notes the calibration fails outright, with 55.8% of panel-cleared notes scoring 10, and a usable point exists only after the threshold is re-established there (Appendix K). Second, the calibration transfers across judge families: on the second family the same prompt scores 43 to 45 of the 47 held-out twins at 10 and reads 34.4% detection at 6.4% false alarms. What the method does not buy is discrimination or explanation. Its paired score on omissions is 0.669 held out, well short of the pipeline’s 0.786 on the same pairs, and 0.670 on the full evaluation set by the convention Table8贯穿始终，其标志是小于 10 的数字，不附加任何内容。uses throughout, and its flag is a number below 10 with nothing attached.

7.7 面对面，每个价格购买什么，以及真实票据上的相同方法The head-to-head, what each price buys, and the same methods on real notes

在相同的 495 个评估对中，保留子集无法解析的比较变得可判定。按照第 4 节的惯例要求折叠到协商，进化的提示会在 25 个协商上触发，而 per-fact 规则则不会，而 7 个协商则相反（都在 52 上触发，而在 28 上都不触发），并且该对比给出 p=0.002，因此在其自身的操作点，进化的提示检测到的遗漏音符明显多于 per-fact 规则。 （同样的对比读数为10比3，p=0.09：方向相同，协商太少无法解决。）Over the same 495 evaluation pairs, the comparison the held-out subset could not resolve becomes decidable. Collapsed to consultations as Section 4’s convention requires, the evolved prompt fires on 25 consultations where the per-fact rule does not, against 7 the other way (both fire on 52 and neither on 28), and that contrast gives p=0.002, so at its own operating point the evolved prompt detects significantly more notes with omissions than the per-fact rule. (Held out the same contrast read 10 to 3, p=0.09: the same direction, too few consultations to resolve it.)

该测试将进化提示读取为三轮运行中的大多数与规则的一次运行相反，并且消除估计器不匹配可以增强结果。大多数仅当三分之二运行时才会触发，因此它是更保守的估计器，并且在同一咨询中一次读取一次运行，进化提示的三个抽奖给出 p=2.2e-05、3.1e-04 和 1.2e-04。均衡读取成本是操作点（单次抽取检测到 38.6% 到 41.0%，误报率为 6.2% 到 9.8%，而大多数误报率为 36.9%，误报率是 6.2%），因此上面的部署规则比较是部署所处的情况，并且是对比的较弱形式。That test reads the evolved prompt as a majority of three runs against the rule’s one run, and removing that estimator mismatch strengthens the result. A majority fires only when two of three runs fire, so it is the more conservative estimator, and read one run at a time the evolved prompt’s three draws give p=2.2e-05, 3.1e-04 and 1.2e-04 on the same consultations. What the equalised reading costs is the operating point (single draws detect 38.6 to 41.0% at 6.2 to 9.8% false alarms, against the majority’s 36.9% at 6.2%), so the deployed-rule comparison above is the one a deployment would live at, and it is the weaker form of the contrast.

两个工作点都不占主导地位。进化后的提示以 6.2% 的误报率购买其检测，而规则为 2.7%，并且它无法调低以满足规则，因为它的大部分检测都位于得分为 9 的音符上，因此下一个更安静的阈值在 0.9% 误报时下降到 14.3% 的检测，低于规则。另一个方向的调整也失败了。将规则的触发范围扩大到支持严重性事实将检测率提高到 59.0%，但会在 35.7% 的干净笔记上触发，因为合法笔记通常只会留下未说明的支持性事实，因此每种方法都有一个可用的操作点，而且它们是不同的。这些标记也是不同的对象：低于 10 分且没有任何附加内容，与缺失的事实名称及其严重程度及其后面的抄本引用相对应 - “根据其抄本重新阅读此注释”和“检查注释是否记录了克林霉素过敏”之间的区别。更昂贵的方法，即管道，购买精度和标记内容而不是数量，并且它还在两组对的能力测量上保持领先。两者捕捉到了截然不同的信息：他们一起启动了 112 次咨询中的 84 次，而仅针对进化提示就启动了 77 次咨询，这使得运行这两个咨询显然都是下一个实验。Neither operating point dominates. The evolved prompt buys its detection at 6.2% false alarms against the rule’s 2.7%, and it cannot be tuned down to meet the rule, because most of its detection sits on notes scored exactly 9, so the next quieter threshold collapses to 14.3% detection at 0.9% false alarms, below the rule. The tuning fails in the other direction too. Widening the rule’s trigger to supporting-severity facts lifts detection to 59.0% but fires on 35.7% of clean notes, because legitimate notes routinely leave merely-supporting facts unstated, so each method has exactly one usable operating point, and they are different ones. The flags are different objects too: a score below 10 with nothing attached, against the missing fact by name with its severity grade and the transcript quote behind it - the difference between “re-read this note against its transcript” and “check whether the note records the clindamycin allergy”. The dearer method, the pipeline, buys precision and flag content rather than volume, and it also stays ahead on the capability measure on both sets of pairs. The two catch substantially different notes: together they fire on 84 of the 112 consultations against 77 for the evolved prompt alone, which makes running both the obvious next experiment.

结果形成阶梯：性能见表The results form a ladder: performance in Table8、价格以及表中每个标志包含的内容, prices and what each flag contains in Table9，以附录 D 中测量日期的固定信用利率。可用误报率的检测在进化提示时达到峰值，每张票据 0.046 美元，每次咨询一张票据的管道价格的十分之一，一旦管道的每次咨询阶段分摊到多个票据，则为管道价格的十分之一。上面的钱买了一个更安静的标志，指出了缺失的事实：带有规则的完整三级管道是每张纸币 0.45 美元，其中严重性审计占 71%，提取占 19%。两个未经测试的更改针对这两行：将严重性分级折叠到提取调用中，这将删除审计份额，以及更便宜的提取模型（第 8 节）。精心设计的法官自己的自由文本关键遗漏列表是命名事实家族中廉价的一端（表, at the pinned credit rates with measurement dates in Appendix D. Detection at a usable false-alarm rate peaks at the evolved prompt, $0.046 a note, a tenth of the pipeline’s price at one note per consultation and a third once the pipeline’s per-consultation stages are amortised across several notes. The money above it buys a quieter flag that names the missing fact: the full three-stage pipeline with the rule is $0.45 a note, of which the severity audit is 71% and the extraction 19%. Two untested changes target those two lines: folding severity grading into the extraction call, which would remove the audit’s share, and a cheaper extraction model (Section 8). The engineered judge’s own free-text critical-omission list is the cheap end of the named-fact family (Table8’s last row).在半美分的情况下，它保持安静，检测率为 9.6%，误报率为 0.9%，而规则的误报率为 24.6%，误报率为 2.7%，并提供自由文本，其中规则提供带有经过审计的严重性等级的键控判决。’s last row). At half a cent it stays quiet, 9.6% detection at 0.9% false alarms against the rule’s 24.6% at 2.7%, and hands over free text where the rule hands a keyed verdict with an audited severity grade.

在一个更强的法官家族中，排序从下开始压缩：第二个家族的整体完整性评分法官在一次调用中清除了自己的噪音，并且该规则的边缘有+5.6个检测点（22.1％相对于该法官的16.5％，两者的误报率都是匹配的2.1％；附录G）加上其标志包含的内容。在不同的家庭中，没有改变的是成对的差距、两种方法的互补优势，以及这里没有任何方法可以接近解决这个问题的事实。On a stronger judge family the ordering compresses from below: the second family’s monolithic completeness-scored judge clears its own noise in one call, and the rule’s edge there is +5.6 points of detection (22.1% against that judge’s 16.5%, both at a matched 2.1% false-alarm rate; Appendix G) plus what its flag contains. What does not change across families is the paired gap, the two methods’ complementary strengths, and the fact that nothing here comes close to solving the class.

这些价格和阈值都来自构建的对，并且一次运行测量与真实抄写员输出接触后幸存下来的内容。八种设计和两种方法中最好的，每种都有自己发布的标志规则，针对来自同伴人口普查的 261 个注释：所有 87 个注释都经过专家组验证的遗漏，其中 174 个注释由专家组清除（附录 K）。每个工作点都会移动。两种方法的检测率大致翻倍（管道为 51.7%，进化提示为 85.1%），误报率分别上升 8.3 倍和 7.1 倍（分别为 22.4% 和 44.2%），因为真实的纸币不如在任何地方（而不是在一个种植地点）构建的纸币完整。该管道在两个语料库上检查每个注释的相同数量的审计事实，并判断真实注释中缺失的事实数量是真实注释中的两倍，即每个注释 2.0 与 1.1。Those prices and thresholds all come from constructed pairs, and one run measures what survives contact with real scribe output. The best of the eight designs and both methods, each at its own published flag rule, were pointed at 261 notes from the companion census: all 87 carrying a panel-verified omission, and 174 of the notes its panel cleared (Appendix K). Every operating point moves. Detection roughly doubles on both methods (the pipeline 51.7%, the evolved prompt 85.1%) and false alarms rise 8.3-fold and 7.1-fold (to 22.4% and 44.2%), because a real note is less complete than a constructed pair everywhere rather than at one planted site. The pipeline checks the same number of audited facts per note on both corpora and judges twice as many of them absent on the real notes, 2.0 per note against 1.1.

构建的干净双胞胎上没有设置任何阈值，可以在移动后幸存下来，并且进化提示的低于 10 的标记校准完全失败，正如第 7.6 节所预测的那样。一旦在真实音符上重新建立阈值，进化后的提示仍然比单一法官检测到的错误率高出一半，即 5.2% 的误报率为 32.2%，而按照自己的规则，单一法官的误报率为 9.8%，为 29.9%；整体判断没有重新设定阈值，但其自身的阈值没有达到 5% 误报范围内的检测（附录 K）。事实规则也没有重新设定阈值，因此，实际情况是，管道在本文使用的 10% 条线内没有显示出工作点，并且重新设置其审计阶段的关键阈值，有一个实验可以提供这一点。管道的标记将其内容保留在那里：在它标记的 87 个经验证遗漏的 45 个注释中，有 34 个（75.6% [61.3, 85.8]）指出了人口普查小组验证的事实，这个数字没有注入的基准可以提供，因为通过构造得出的协议是真实的。该匹配是通过词汇包含来评分的，因此将其视为指示性屏幕而不是裁决的精度。完整的设计、费率和注意事项见附录 K。No threshold set on constructed clean twins survives the move, and the evolved prompt’s flag-below-10 calibration fails exactly as Section 7.6 predicts. Once thresholds are re-established on the real notes, the evolved prompt still detects more than the monolithic judge at half its false-alarm rate, 32.2% at 5.2% against the monolithic judge’s 29.9% at 9.8% at its own rule; the monolithic judge was not re-thresholded, but no threshold of its own reaches that detection inside a 5% false-alarm band (Appendix K). The per-fact rule was not re-thresholded either, so on real notes the pipeline has no demonstrated operating point inside the 10% bar this paper uses, and re-setting its audit stage’s critical threshold there is the experiment that would supply one. And the pipeline’s flags keep their content there: of the 45 notes it flagged among the 87 carrying a verified omission, 34 (75.6% [61.3, 85.8]) name the very fact the census’s panel verified, a figure no injected benchmark can supply, because agreement there is true by construction. That match is scored by lexical containment, so read it as an indicative screen rather than an adjudicated precision. The full design, rates and caveats are Appendix K.

7.8 佣金成本和悬而未决的问题The cost on commissions, and the open problem

本节报告的恢复有两个成本。第一个是佣金成本，它属于管道成本。在评估集上，枚举设计位于配对委员会研究的底部 - 检查表判断为 0.744，RAGAS 式配方为 0.712，三阶段管道的覆盖分数为 0.661（保留子集为 0.617） - 低于八个设计中的每一个，同时占据省略排序的顶部，并且倒置在第二个判断系列上至少同样广泛。从机械角度来说，这就是覆盖率分数应该做的事情，因为制造不会降低覆盖率。一个案例限制了该机制：工程法官是一个单一的整体调用，而不是枚举设计，并且在同一范围内的配对佣金上仍然得分 0.754，因此看起来枚举成本的一部分可能是注意力 - 它的提示和所有八个工作示例都与遗漏有关。进化后的提示不会付出这个代价，在检测遗漏的同时将 202 个佣金对的配对佣金保持在 0.978，但其自身的成本是每次部署校准。因此，建立在覆盖率评分管道基础上的生产评估需要一位忠诚度法官并肩作战。The recovery this section reports has two costs. The first is a cost on commissions, and it belongs to the pipeline. On the evaluation set the enumerating designs sit at the bottom of the study on paired commissions - the checklist judge at 0.744, the RAGAS-style recipe at 0.712, and the three-stage pipeline’s coverage score at 0.661 (0.617 on the held-out subset) - below every one of the eight designs while occupying the top of the omission ordering, and the inversion is at least as wide on the second judge family. That is mechanically what a coverage score should do, since a fabrication does not reduce coverage. One case bounds the mechanism: the engineered judge is a single monolithic call rather than an enumerating design and still scores 0.754 on paired commissions, in the same band, so part of what looks like a cost of enumeration may be attention - its prompt and all eight of its worked examples are about omissions. The evolved prompt does not pay this price, holding paired commissions at 0.978 across 202 commission pairs while detecting omissions, but its own cost is the per-deployment calibration. Production evaluation built on a coverage-scored pipeline therefore needs a faithfulness judge running alongside.

第二个成本是共享的：即使是最好的方法，在可用的误报率下，也只能捕捉到超过三分之一的包含遗漏的笔记，这是一种改进，而不是解决方案，而且它们错过的笔记集中在一个类别中。该案例击败了本研究中所有可部署的方法。重述追踪遗漏——主要的陈述消失了，而明确的或密切解释的重述在其他地方仍然存在——是这里 293 个遗漏中的 57 个，我们构建了足够多的少数类别来衡量，并且实际上丢失的信息最少；将其集中到标题数字中会使他们变得保守。在类中，我们在主要判断系列中测量的每种方法都位于或低于其自身的本底噪声 - 八种设计、参考判断、两个管道层以及在其他地方都是该研究的最佳检测器的进化提示。图The second cost is shared: even the best method catches barely more than a third of notes containing an omission at a usable false-alarm rate, an improvement rather than a solution, and the notes they miss are concentrated in one class. That case defeats every deployable method in this study. Restatement-trace omissions - the primary statement gone while an explicit or closely paraphrased restatement survives elsewhere - are 57 of the 293 omissions here, a minority class we built enough of to measure, and the kind in which the least information is actually lost; pooling it into the headline numbers makes them conservative. Within the class every method we measured in the primary judge family sits at or below its own noise floor - the eight designs, the reference judges, both pipeline tiers, and the evolved prompt that is the study’s best detector everywhere else. Figure8将每个图与测量集和 95% 间隔一起绘制，其中已发布的工件带有 1 个（五行中的两行没有），并且实际规则标记 57 中的 0。第二个系列检查器将问题一分为二：它区分重述轨迹远高于机会（0.636 配对），而规则仍然没有捕获任何信号，因此信号存在于事实级别，决策层无法对其采取行动。plots each with the set it was measured on and a 95% interval where the released artefacts carry one (two of the five lines do not), and the per-fact rule flags 0 of 57. The second-family checker splits the problem in two: it discriminates restatement traces well above chance (0.636 paired) while the rule still catches none, so signal exists at the fact level and the decision layer cannot act on it.

明显的临床反对意见是，一张纸条仍然在某处写着这件事并不存在缺陷，因此保持沉默的法官是正确的，而不是盲目的。通过幸存者所在的位置拆分相同的存储判决可以回答这个问题：在全语料库范围内的 61 个重述对中的 55 个中（61 个重述对中的 57 个位于评估集中；90.2% [80.2, 95.4]），幸存的重述位于与已删除实例不同的标题下，并且在 6 个相同标题对中，有 2 个是根本没有标题的注释。与片段痕迹的对比是其机制：片段属于同一个句子或其邻居并保持原样（56.3％同段），而完整陈述两次的事实几乎总是在历史中陈述一次，在推理中陈述一次。因此，只有通过从头到尾阅读注释才能恢复幸存下来的信息——人口普查中的文本错误错误占其已验证结果的 7.4%。此时，问题不再看起来像遗漏检测，而是开始看起来像结构一致性：事实存在于笔记中，但不在笔记声称记录它的地方。The obvious clinical objection is that a note still saying the thing somewhere is not deficient, so a judge that stays quiet is right rather than blind. Splitting the same stored verdicts by where the survivor sits answers it: in 55 of 61 restatement pairs corpus-wide (57 of the 61 sit in the evaluation set; 90.2% [80.2, 95.4]) the surviving restatement sits under a different heading from the removed instance, and of the six same-heading pairs two are notes with no headings at all. The contrast with fragment traces is the mechanism: a fragment belongs to the same sentence or its neighbour and stays put (56.3% same-section), while a fact stated twice in full is almost always stated once in the history and once in the reasoning. So what survives is recoverable only by reading the note end to end - the misplaced-text failure the census counts at 7.4% of its verified findings. At this point the problem stops looking like omission detection and starts looking like structural consistency: the fact survives in the note, but not where the note claims to record it.

除此之外还有两个资格。在 61 对中的 37 对中，幸存者位于评估和计划区域的某个位置，因此在典型的对中，读完整个笔记的读者仍然可以找到事实。并且分割显示没有检测梯度，在这些计数中它不可能有：每个对比度都不显着，并且同一部分组拥有五个评估对（其六个中的五个位于评估集中），其中零检测与高达约 43% 的比率兼容。自然攻击是结构性的，而不是更好的判断：对每个部分而不是每个音符的分数覆盖，这将横截面幸存者从不可检测的缺席变成可检测的错位，并且发布的站点地图提供了部分标签。导致第 3 部分中的缺席难以构建的冗余，使得最后的遗漏在这里无法检测到，通过四种方式进行衡量：32.0% 的记录记录了不止一次的事实，44% 的完整删除未通过验证，人口普查 40 个抽样遗漏拒绝中的四分之一（小组拒绝验证的候选结果）在其他地方进行重述（随样本移动的份额 - 同一项目的 15 次拒绝试点）审计读到它为 0%），而 90.2% 的幸存重述位于另一个标题下。我们将其视为该领域的开放问题，而不仅仅是我们自己的问题，并发布分级基准作为攻击它的工具。Two qualifications belong beside that. In 37 of 61 pairs the survivor sits somewhere in the assessment-and-plan block, so on the typical pair a reader who works through the whole note can still find the fact. And the split shows no detection gradient, which at these counts it could not have: every contrast is non-significant, and the same-section group holds five evaluated pairs (five of its six sit in the evaluation set), on which zero detections are compatible with rates up to about 43%. The natural attack is structural rather than a better judge: score coverage per section instead of per note, which turns the cross-section survivor from an undetectable absence into a detectable misplacement, and the released site map supplies the section labels. The redundancy that made absence hard to construct in Section 3 is what makes the last omissions undetectable here, measured four ways: 32.0% of the facts a note records stated more than once, 44% of complete removals failing verification, a quarter of the census’s 40 sampled omission refusals (candidate findings its panel declined to verify) turning on a restatement elsewhere (a share that moves with the sample - a 15-refusal pilot of the same audit read it at 0%), and 90.2% of surviving restatements sitting under another heading. We state it as the field’s open problem rather than ours alone, and release the graded benchmark as the instrument for attacking it.

8 局限性Limitations

省略的一半没有外部锚。No external anchor for the omission half.主要的未解决的有效性问题是转录本衍生的遗漏标签是否符合独立临床医生对记录失败的判断。该委员会在 MEDEC 设有外部锚点；省略组没有，因为唯一的外部医生标记的基准，其任务与我们的任务相匹配，完全来自我们自己的阶层之一的语料库。在这样的锚点存在之前，遗漏结果是本文构建的仪器内部的：构建、验证和临床医生检查，但没有独立标记。建立这种对应关系是未来工作要做的第一件事。The principal unresolved validity question is whether the transcript-derived omission labels correspond to independent clinician judgements of documentation failure. The commission arm has an external anchor in MEDEC; the omission arm has none, because the only external physician-labelled benchmark whose task matches ours is drawn entirely from a corpus that is one of our own strata. Until such an anchor exists, the omission results are internal to the instrument this paper builds: constructed, verified and clinician-checked, but not independently labelled. Establishing that correspondence is the first thing future work has to do.

一位评判模范家庭的标题结果。One judge model family for the headline results.第 5 节至第 7 节中的每个标题判决都来自一个法官模型系列。第二系列检查再现了不对称性、重述跟踪崩溃（与第 7.8 节的细微差别：转移的检查器区分了类，而规则仍然没有捕获任何内容）和管道的领先（附录 G）；进化提示的校准也会转移（第 7.6 节）。单音符检测证明依赖于判断，因此单音符声明的范围仅限于所测量的家庭。披露了一个令人困惑的问题：在第 5 节检查中，两个系列的推理工作并未逐层匹配，因为第二个系列的端点拒绝无推理设置；进化后的提示传输不会带来这种混乱，因为两个家庭都在努力工作。Every headline judgement in Sections 5 to 7 comes from one judge model family. The second-family checks reproduce the asymmetry, the restatement-trace collapse (with Section 7.8’s nuance: the transferred checker discriminates the class while the rule still catches none) and the pipeline’s lead (Appendix G); the evolved prompt’s calibration transfers too (Section 7.6). Single-note detection proves judge-dependent, so single-note claims are scoped to the family measured. One confound is disclosed: reasoning effort is not matched tier-for-tier across the two families in the Section 5 checks, because the second family’s endpoint refuses a no-reasoning setting; the evolved prompt’s transfer does not carry that confound, since both families run at high effort.

计算设置所绑定的内容。What the compute settings bound.第 5 部分和第 6 部分是在法官在 1,024 个令牌上限内不进行任何推理工作的情况下进行测量的，并且所有三个提示搜索都以相同的方式执行其候选者，因此搜索探索了部署不需要的计算机制。第 7 部分测量了推理预算对这些提示的作用，但仅限于已选择的提示；以更大的预算重新运行搜索是一个不同的实验，我们没有运行它。同一子集上缺少一个控制：在匹配计算时，简单的完整性评分提示与配对歧视上的进化提示相匹配（0.670 对 0.669），因此进化提示的测量优势是干净音符校准和它承认的操作点，以及给定相同预算的简单提示是否会在 10 处得分干净音符，因此承认它自己的标志规则没有被测试。这些重新运行增加了它们自己的一个限制：进化提示的干净音符校准是该语料库和判断的一种行为，而不是设计的属性。Sections 5 and 6 are measured with the judge given no reasoning effort inside a 1,024-token cap, and all three prompt searches executed their candidates the same way, so the search explored a compute regime a deployment need not live in. Section 7 measures what a reasoning budget does to those prompts, but only to prompts already selected; a search re-run at a larger budget is a different experiment and we did not run it. One control is missing on the same subset: at matched compute the plain completeness-scored prompt matches the evolved prompt on paired discrimination (0.670 against 0.669), so the evolved prompt’s measured advantage is the clean-note calibration and the operating point it admits, and whether a plain prompt given the same budget would score clean notes at 10 and so admit a flag rule of its own was not tested. Those re-runs add one limit of their own: the evolved prompt’s clean-note calibration is a behaviour of this corpus and judge, not a property of the design.

面对面可以说什么，不能说什么。What the head-to-head can and cannot say.第 7 节的比较是在每种方法自己的部署阈值下进行的，而不是在匹配的误报率下进行的。它的估计量不对称性在第 7.7 节中测量，删除它可以增强对比度。评估集扩展是在没有预先确定分析计划的情况下运行的：报告的测试是在保留的样本上建立的测试，未作更改，在看到数据后没有选择新的测试。管道在评估集上仍然有一个复制（只有保留的子集携带三个），因此均衡向下读取进化的提示而不是向上复制规则。The Section 7 comparison is at each method’s own deployment threshold, not at matched false-alarm rates. Its estimator asymmetry is measured in Section 7.7, and removing it strengthens the contrast. The evaluation-set extension was run without an analysis plan fixed in advance: the tests reported are the ones established on the held-out sample, applied unchanged, with no new test chosen after seeing the data. The pipeline still has one replicate on the evaluation set (only the held-out subset carries three), so the equalisation reads the evolved prompt down rather than replicating the rule up.

一位临床医生介绍了本文自己的项目，以及认可和盲法之间的区别。One clinician on this paper’s own items, and the difference between endorsement and blinding.一位医生作者在两次会议中验证了本文自己的 94 项 - 一次会议中验证了 70 项，涵盖了基准和管道的六个阶段，另外 24 项则涉及审计阶段本身的严重性等级。项目本身必须说明正在审核的结论的阶段是A physician author validated 94 of this paper’s own items across two sittings - 70 in a sitting that covered six stages of the benchmark and pipeline, and 24 more on the audit stage’s own severity grades. Stages where the item itself had to state the verdict being audited are代言endorsements- 临床医生检查并无异议；只有面板切割、严重性和法官分歧阶段是结构性盲的，并且只有这些才是测量结果。他们是一位设计了他们评分的乐器的作者，并且两次会议都有一名评估者，没有重复的项目，因此不存在评估者内部的数据。每个阶段包含 6 到 20 个项目，因此四个阶段的读数为 100%，下限为 61-72%，排除了严重失败，没有什么更好的了：间隔是结果，点估计不是。严重性条件的结果使用基准的等级；事实规则在审计阶段自行触发。现在已经从外部检查了一件事：严重程度。一位独立临床医生在同伴普查中对其进行了盲评（第 3 节）。这是评分标准在一个等级内重现的外部证据，这也是为什么第 7 节中报告的一级精益现在被解读为评估者而不是评分标准的属性 - 两位临床医生的倾向相反。这不是对本文本身的内容的二读：作者组之外没有人对这里的法官输出做出裁决，而这一差距就是这一限制所指出的。- a clinician checked and did not object; only the panel-cut, severity and judge-disagreement stages were structurally blinded, and only those are measurements. They are an author who designed the instruments they graded, and there was one rater across both sittings with no repeated item, so no within-rater figure exists. Every stage holds 6 to 20 items, so four stages reading 100% with lower bounds of 61–72% rule out gross failure and nothing finer: the intervals are the result, the point estimates are not. Severity-conditioned results use the benchmark’s grades; the per-fact rule fires on the audit stage’s own. One thing has now been checked from outside: the severity rubric. An independent clinician graded against it, blind, in the companion census (Section 3). That is external evidence the rubric reproduces to within a grade, and it is also why the one-grade lean reported in Section 7 is now read as a property of the rater rather than of the rubric - the two clinicians lean opposite ways. It is not a second reading of this paper’s own items: nobody outside the author group has adjudicated a judge output here, and that gap is the one this limitation names.

注入的错误，而非自然发生的错误。Injected, not naturally occurring, errors.同伴普查显示这些类别是真实的，但注入的配对比生产故障更干净，并且我们测量了两只手臂上的差距。在佣金方面，同一位法官在 MEDEC 医生策划的错误上得分为 0.827，在我们构建的错误上得分为 0.939。关于遗漏，第 7.7 节针对真实供应商注释的运行显示每个操作点都在移动 - 检测和误报都按照基准测试自己的规则急剧上升 - 因此基准的操作点不会转移到生产流量，尽管一旦在那里重新建立阈值，进化的提示仍然检测到比单片判断更多的误报率（附录 K）。误报显示的是上限，而不是估计值：人口普查的清除记录仅在其发现的严格程度内是干净的，而其自己的标准实验将携带可报告内容的记录比例从 27.8% 提高到 96.5%。所有佣金对也都来自较早的构建，因此构建队列稳健性切片仅针对遗漏而存在，并且不能通过切片排除同时作用于两个类的构建效果。每对还恰好携带一个植入错误，而真实音符携带多个错误（管道将每个真实音符缺少 2.0 个事实与基准对上的 1.1 个事实进行判断），因此这里没有任何内容可以衡量当故障相互作用时法官的行为方式。构建方面还存在一个进一步的界限：干净双胞胎是根据已审计的情况说明书而不是笔录进行完整验证的，因此本文为枚举法官报告的每个干净票据误报率都是完整票据错误标记的上限，同时也是对生产票据所绘制内容的乐观解读，因为没有生产票据相对于任何票据都是完整的（第 7.7 节）。The companion census shows the classes are real, but injected pairs are cleaner than production failures, and we measured the gap on both arms. On commissions, the same judge scores paired 0.827 on MEDEC’s physician-curated errors against 0.939 on our constructed ones. On omissions, Section 7.7’s run against real vendor notes shows every operating point moving - detection and false alarms both rise steeply at the benchmark’s own rules - so the benchmark’s operating points do not transfer to production traffic, though once thresholds are re-established there the evolved prompt still detects more than the monolithic judge at half its false-alarm rate (Appendix K). The false-alarm reads there are upper bounds, not estimates: the census’s cleared notes are clean only to the strictness of its discovery, and its own standards experiment moves the share of notes carrying something reportable from 27.8% to 96.5%. All commission pairs also come from the earlier build, so the construction-cohort robustness slice exists only for omissions, and a build effect acting on both classes at once cannot be excluded by slicing. Each pair also carries exactly one planted error where a real note carries several (the pipeline judges 2.0 facts absent per real note against 1.1 on the benchmark’s pairs), so nothing here measures how a judge behaves when failures interact. One further bound runs through the constructed side: the clean twins are verified complete against the audited fact sheet rather than against the transcript, so every clean-note false-alarm rate this paper reports for an enumerating judge is an upper bound on wrongful flags of a complete note, and at the same time an optimistic reading of what a production note would draw, since no production note is complete against any sheet (Section 7.7).

保留的子集是从什么中保留的，而不是从什么中保留的。What the held-out subset is, and is not, held out from.确认的 47 次咨询中有 10 次也出现在探索性通道中，并且重复使用了提取缓存，因此这是对判断的完全保留测试，而只是提取的部分测试。管道层的配对分数和事实规则各进行三次运行，其分布是整体基线的四分之一到八分之一（第 7.2 节）；扫过的单音符数字和每条轨迹的分割仍然是单次运行。该子集是针对优化而保留的，而不是针对对其进行的分析数量 - 预算重新运行、事实列表消融和家庭转移都读取相同的 151 对，没有多重性校正 - 并且每事实规则本身是事后制定的，然后在早期的探索性过程中进行检查；进化提示的标记低于 10 阈值同样是从第一个重复的分数中读取的，然后保持不变。Ten of the confirmation’s 47 consultations also appear in the exploratory pass with extraction caches reused, so it is a fully held-out test of the judging and only a partial one of the extraction. The pipeline tiers’ paired scores and the per-fact rule carry three runs each, with spreads a quarter to an eighth of the monolithic baseline’s (Section 7.2); the swept single-note figures and the per-trace splits remain single runs. The subset is held out with respect to optimisation, not to the number of analyses run over it - the budgeted re-runs, fact-list ablation and family transfer all read the same 151 pairs, with no multiplicity correction - and the per-fact rule itself was formulated post hoc, then checked on the earlier exploratory pass; the evolved prompt’s flag-below-10 threshold was likewise read off the first replicate’s scores and then held unchanged.

人类检测，来自文献而不是我们自己的测量。Human detection, from the literature rather than our own measurement.我们没有运行人类基线。已发布的比较器范围从 25% 到 92% 不等，具体取决于任务以及读者是否有源文档。我们最好的配置检测到 24.6% 到 36.9%（分别为 2.7% 和 6.2% 的误报），与医生在没有源文档的情况下进行审查的一个比较器的范围相同 - 他们发现了大约四分之一到三分之一的故意遗漏 - 而更高的人类数字来自于更简单的任务。这些都不能解决问题。附录一收集了我们能找到的所有数据，但没有一个涉及重述情况。We did not run a human baseline. The published comparators run from about 25% to 92%, depending on the task and on whether the reader had the source document alongside. Our best configurations detect 24.6 to 36.9% (at 2.7% and 6.2% false alarms respectively), the same range as the one comparator in which physicians reviewed without the source document - they caught about a quarter to a third of planted omissions - while the higher human figures come from easier tasks. None of this settles the question. Appendix I collects every figure we could find, and none of them covers the restatement case.

语料库限制。Corpus limits.仅提供英国和美国英语初级和门诊护理，并且没有注释包含 EHR 结构化字段，因此我们根本无法谈论结构化字段遗漏。第 7 节中指定的两个成本杠杆已确定但未经测试，并且未测量延迟（附录 C），因此第 7 节的价格阶梯只是一个成本阶梯。English-language UK and US primary and ambulatory care only, and no note carries an EHR structured field, so we cannot speak to structured-field omissions at all. The two cost levers named in Section 7 are identified but not tested, and latency was not measured (Appendix C), so Section 7’s price ladder is a cost ladder only.

9 结论与发布Conclusion and release

法官核实的是在场，而不是缺席。我们尝试过的任何补救措施都没有创建可用的检测：措辞、标准范围、投票和提示搜索都会沿着同一条弱曲线移动操作点，并且更大的推理预算可以在不消除不对称性的情况下提高歧视性。有效的方法是将缺勤问题转化为在场检查，并且大部分恢复来自封闭的事实判决和对它们的决策规则，而不是仅来自事实列表。这项研究的两种最强大的方法独立地实现了转换：一个管道，枚举记录的事实并返回每个事实的判决，其每个标志都命名了缺失的事实；以及一个单一的 GEPA 演进调用，可以以每次咨询一个注释的每条记录测量成本的大约十分之一的价格检测更多注释（三分之一摊销）。根据事实判断而不是分数来使管道在部署中可用；每次部署时重新建立的干净音符校准是进化提示的原因。注释中其他地方保留的重述的遗漏仍然无法使这两种方法失效，这是该领域的一个悬而未决的问题。我们释放了攻击它的工具。阅读本记录时应对照四个问题，以及我们自己对这些问题的回答，请参阅附录 J。Judges verify presence, not absence. No remedy we tried creates usable detection in place: wording, criterion scope, voting and prompt search all move the operating point along the same weak curve, and a larger reasoning budget lifts discrimination without closing the asymmetry. What works is converting the absence question into presence checks, and most of the recovery comes from the closed per-fact verdicts and the decision rule over them rather than from the fact list alone. This study’s two strongest methods implement the conversion independently: a pipeline that enumerates the transcript’s facts and returns a verdict on each, whose every flag names the missing fact, and a single GEPA-evolved call that detects more notes at roughly a tenth of the measured cost per note at one note per consultation (a third amortised). Acting on per-fact verdicts rather than a score is what makes the pipeline usable in deployment; a clean-note calibration, re-established per deployment, is what makes the evolved prompt so. An omission whose restatement survives elsewhere in the note still defeats both methods, and that is an open problem for the field. We release the instrument for attacking it. The four questions this record should be read against, and our own answers to them, are Appendix J.

接下来直接说。What follows directly.最便宜的下一个实验在存储的判决中可见：同时运行两种方法，并在对已记录的判决重新评分之前根据临床医生等级重新设置审核阶段的关键阈值。第 6 节的直接后续内容是在推理预算下进行快速搜索，因为优化器不断提出的策略无法在其候选者评分的预算内执行。重述案例指向每个部分的覆盖率评分，已发布的站点地图提供了标签。除此之外，省略的一半仍然需要外部锚杆第8节打开。The cheapest next experiments are visible in the stored verdicts: running both methods together, and re-setting the audit stage’s critical threshold from clinician grades before re-scoring the verdicts already recorded. The direct sequel to Section 6 is a prompt search run at a reasoning budget, since the strategy the optimiser kept proposing could not execute inside the budget its candidates were scored under. The restatement case points at per-section coverage scoring, for which the released site map supplies the labels. Beyond those, the omission half still needs the external anchor Section 8 opens with.
