Every judge evaluated here, including the deployed faithfulness judge from the authors’ production evaluation, is fully specified in the release: prompts, model pins and judgements. The pipeline this paper recommends is the authors’ own design, and the reference set includes a judge from the authors’ production evaluation; both are released in full.

道德和数据。Ethics and data.该语料库不包含真实的患者数据：PriMock57 的咨询是在临床医生和演员患者之间进行的（CC BY 4.0），ACI-Bench 的遭遇是为研究而发布的模拟医患对话（CC BY 4.0），其余层是编写的场景；没有涉及患者，也没有使用临床记录。其注释出现在配套普查和第 7.7 节的真实错误运行中的三种商业抄写员产品在整个过程中均匿名为抄写员 A、B 和 C。这里没有对任何指定产品进行临床安全性评估，也不应使用任何结果来选择或拒绝临床使用的抄写员。The corpus contains no real patient data: PriMock57’s consultations are between clinicians and actor patients (CC BY 4.0), ACI-Bench’s encounters are simulated doctor-patient conversations released for research (CC BY 4.0), and the remaining strata are authored scenarios; no patients were involved and no clinical records were used. The three commercial scribe products whose notes appear in the companion census and in Section 7.7’s real-error run are anonymised throughout as Scribe A, B and C. Nothing here is a clinical-safety evaluation of any named product, and no result should be used to select or reject a scribe for clinical use.

What we release.其中一包与配套的人口普查文件共享，并引用了相同的数据集 DOI：500 个已评分的配对及其干净的笔记、错误的双胞胎、删除的事实和成绩；事实站点地图和两名评分者的严重程度判决；成绩单和概况介绍；每一项经过验证的人口普查结果、产品都是匿名的；每个基准判断运行对原始完成的判断（真实供应商注释运行的记录是对保留注释文本的判断，并与其一起保留）；临床医生验证记录，如密钥、答案和评分结果（打印供应商备注文本的项目包被保留；两个不携带的项目包 - 逐字标注的严重程度项目，以及施工裁决队列 - 发货）；和完整的安全带。附录F为发布索引。One bundle, shared with the companion census paper and citing the same dataset DOI: the 500 graded pairs with their clean notes, errored twins, removed facts and grades; the fact-site map and both graders’ severity verdicts; the transcripts and fact sheets; every verified census finding, products anonymised; every benchmark judge run’s judgements with the raw completions (the real-vendor-note run’s records are judgements of withheld note text and are withheld with it); the clinician-validation records, as keys, answers and scored results (the item packs that print vendor note text are withheld with it; the two that carry none - the severity items with the rubric verbatim, and the construction-adjudication queue - ship); and the full harness. Appendix F is the release index.

我们保留什么。What we withhold.三个抄写员产品所写的笔记文本尚未发布。这些产品的服务条款在重新发布时有所不同，我们对所有三个产品一视同仁，而不是不对称地发布，这将使产品因不存在而被识别（附录 F）。公布的调查结果带有文字记录证据，而不是纸条本身的文字；具有供应商帐户的复制器可以使用已发布的工具重新生成等效的注释。The text of the notes the three scribe products wrote is not released. The products’ terms of service differ on republication, and we withhold all three alike rather than release asymmetrically, which would make products identifiable by their absence (Appendix F). Released findings carry the transcript-side evidence and never the note’s own words; a replicator with vendor accounts can regenerate equivalent notes with the released harness.

数据和代码可用性Data and code availability

基准和所有研究数据发布为The benchmark and all study data are released as遗漏基准OmissionBench at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ComposoAI/OmissionBench根据 CC BY 4.0，在发布时根据已发布的修订版创建 DataCite DOI。该工具 - 捕获脚本、每个提示（包括被取代的版本）、判断配置和模型引脚 - 位于under CC BY 4.0, with a DataCite DOI minted at publication against the released revision. The harness - capture scripts, every prompt including superseded versions, judge configurations and model pins - is athttps://github.com/composo-ai/omission-bench根据 MIT 许可，存档于 Zenodo 的 DOI 标记版本中under the MIT licence, archived to Zenodo at its tagged releases under DOI10.5281/zenodo.22160954。发布的数据包括 500 个分级对（评估集中有 495 个），每个都有其干净的音符、错误的双胞胎、注入或删除的事实及其严重性和痕迹等级；事实站点地图和基于两位评分者的裁决的事实严重性评分；所编写的场景记录，以及两个公共阶层在其自己的上游 CC BY 4.0 许可证下以派生形式生成的记录，并注明出处；每次咨询情况说明书；人口普查的每项经过验证的结果均采用匿名产品，并引用了文字记录证据；每个基准评委运行的判断及其运行清单和原始完成情况（真实供应商注释运行的记录除外，因为它们判断保留的注释文本）；返回的四位临床医生的评分结果、每个项目的关键字和答案；和注释级结构元数据。出于许可原因，供应商注释文本被保留（附录 F）：已发布的调查结果引用了抄本部分，而不是注释本身的文字，并且拥有自己产品帐户的复制者可以使用已发布的工具重新生成等效注释。合成的咨询音频不会重新分发，并且可以使用线束的文本到语音配方及其语音和模型引脚从发布的转录本中重新生成。. The released data comprise the 500 graded pairs (495 in the evaluation set), each with its clean note, errored twin, injected or removed fact and its severity and trace grades; the fact-site map and the per-fact severity grades with both graders’ verdicts; the authored scenario transcripts, and the two public strata’s transcripts in derived form under their own upstream CC BY 4.0 licences with attribution; the per-consultation fact sheets; every verified finding of the census with products anonymised, and the transcript-side evidence quoted; every benchmark judge run’s judgements with its run manifest and the raw completions alongside (the real-vendor-note run’s records excepted, since they judge withheld note text); the four clinician sittings’ scored results, per-item keys and answers as returned; and note-level structural metadata. Vendor note text is withheld for licence reasons (Appendix F): released findings quote the transcript side and never the note’s own words, and a replicator with their own product accounts can regenerate equivalent notes with the released harness. The synthesised consultation audio is not redistributed and is regenerable from the released transcripts with the harness’s text-to-speech recipe and its voice and model pins.

附录指南A guide to the appendices

十一个附录分为四组，大多数读者只需要其中一组。The eleven appendices fall into four groups, and most readers will want only one of them.

Two that answer a question the paper raises about itself.附录 J 询问了四个问题 questions that separate a scribe evaluation that means something from one that does not, and 根据本研究自己的记录回答这些问题。附录 F 是发布索引：发布了什么，根据 哪个许可证，以及任何给定数字背后的工件所在的位置。Appendix J asks the four questions that separate a scribe evaluation that means something from one that does not, and answers them against this study’s own record. Appendix F is the release index: what ships, under which licence, and where the artefact behind any given number lives.

仪器是如何构建和运行的。How the instruments were built and run.附录 A 是完整的基本事实 - 施工方案、提取仪器的轨迹以及打印的严重性标准 verbatim - and is where to go with any question about how absence was made certain. 附录 C 包含管道的诊断信息和部署将设置的参数； Appendix D the model pins, settings, spend and reproducibility record.Appendix A is the ground truth in full - the construction protocol, the extraction instrument’s trajectory, and the severity rubric printed verbatim - and is where to go with any question about how absence was made certain. Appendix C carries the pipeline’s diagnostics and the parameters a deployment would set; Appendix D the model pins, settings, spend and reproducibility record.

The objects the argument is about, printed rather than described.Appendix B holds the 第 6 节无效后的三个提示优化活动，有两个提示 verbatim: the confirmatory campaign’s winner, which is careful, clinically sensible and bought nothing held out, and the exploratory campaign’s winner, which is the prompt 第 7 节作为演变后的提示进行部署。附录 H 打印部署的忠诚度法官 其措辞第 6 节进行编辑。Appendix B holds the three prompt-optimisation campaigns behind Section 6’s null, with two prompts verbatim: the confirmatory campaign’s winner, which is careful, clinically sensible and bought nothing held out, and the exploratory campaign’s winner, which is the prompt Section 7 deploys as the evolved prompt. Appendix H prints the deployed faithfulness judge whose wording Section 6 edits.

证据完全解析。The evidence at full resolution.附录 E 是临床医生的验证，两次会议， 逐步进行，每个阶段都有其样本大小的作用，并且不排除。 Appendix G is the 第二法官家庭。附录 K 是针对真实供应商注释的运行。附录一收集了 比较文献和我们能找到的所有已发表的人体检测数据。Appendix E is the clinician validation, both sittings, stage by stage, each with what its sample size does and does not rule out. A.1 情况说明书和三位批评者The fact sheet and the three critics

A.1.1 架构The schema

对于每次咨询，我们在一次通话中仅从记录中提取一份情况说明书，提示中没有任何注释。该表正好有三个键。For each consultation we extract a fact sheet from the transcript alone, in one call, with no note of any kind in the prompt. The sheet has exactly three keys.

The extraction prompt directs coverage at the clinically decisive content of a consultation: presenting complaint, key positives and pertinent negatives, examination findings or the explicit absence of an examination on a remote consultation, the working impression with any hedging preserved, the plan with drug names, doses, frequencies and durations as actually said, safety-netting, and material social or risk history.三个规则使该表可用作答案键：每个项目一个事实，没有化合物；没有任何东西进入The extraction prompt directs coverage at the clinically decisive content of a consultation: presenting complaint, key positives and pertinent negatives, examination findings or the explicit absence of an examination on a remote consultation, the working impression with any hedging preserved, the plan with drug names, doses, frequencies and durations as actually said, safety-netting, and material social or risk history. Three rules do the work that makes the sheet usable as an answer key: one fact per item with no compounds; nothing enters必须包含must_contain没有可引用的支撑跨度；如果文字记录含糊不清，工作表会保留歧义而不是解决它。的without a quotable supporting span; and where the transcript is ambiguous the sheet preserves the ambiguity rather than resolving it. The证据evidence和and承重load_bearing字段的存在使得支持审计可以机械地运行，而不是通过重新阅读每个项目的记录。两个提示版本都在代码存储库中发布为fields exist so that a support audit can be run mechanically rather than by re-reading the transcript for every item. Both prompt versions are released in the code repository as提示/extraction_prompt_v1.txtprompts/extraction_prompt_v1.txt和and提示/extraction_prompt_v2.txtprompts/extraction_prompt_v2.txt.

A.1.2 三位批评家The three critics

每张提取的表格在用于任何用途之前都会经过三个独立的评论家电话审核。文字记录是一成不变的，因此专家组只询问该表是否忠实地阅读了它。Every extracted sheet is audited by three separate critic calls before it is used for anything. The transcript is immutable, so the panel asks only whether the sheet is a faithful reading of it.

  • •

    支持Support检查成绩单和工作表之间的内部一致性：每个checks internal consistency between transcript and sheet: every必须包含must_contain项目真诚地说，每个陷阱都是对话中的真实时刻，每个item genuinely said, every trap a real moment in the dialogue, every不得包含must_not_contain本次咨询确实有误，并不自相矛盾。item really an error for this consultation, no self-contradiction.

  • •

    实质性Materiality judges clinical importance rather than support: it flags trivia in the required facts (padding raises the completeness bar and penalises good notes), clinically important transcript content missing from 必须包含must_contain（工作诊断、危险信号安全网、药物剂量、明确的过敏、决定性的阴性），以及(a working diagnosis, a red-flag safety net, a drug dose, a stated allergy, a decisive negative), and承重：高load_bearing: high两个方向的成绩显然都是错误的。grades clearly wrong in either direction.

  • •

    漏电Leakage guards the one contamination channel a blind extraction has: any item resting on information not in the transcript - outside clinical knowledge asserted as fact, content that could only come from a reference note or from knowing how scribes typically fail, meta language, and paraphrase drift where the 证据evidence引文未出现在文字记录中或不支持quote does not appear in the transcript or does not support the事实fact.

A.2 真实录音提取仪器：33.3%~22.8%~19.3%~7.0%The extraction instrument on real recordings: 33.3% to 22.8% to 19.3% to 7.0%

提取提示的第一个版本适用于编写的成绩单，但不适用于真实的成绩单。在 PriMock57 上，它生成了包含材料问题的工作表，这些问题在修订周期中幸存下来The first version of the extraction prompt worked on authored transcripts and did not work on real ones. On PriMock57 it produced sheets carrying material issues that survived the revision cycle in57 次咨询中有 19 次 (33.3%)19 of 57 consultations (33.3%)，而 ACI-Bench 为 6%，两个作者的分层为 10%。 The critic reports root-caused it, and the causes are systematic rather than random: PriMock’s transcripts are real recordings carrying speech-recognition corruption and conversational filler, and the first prompt mishandled that in four specific ways., against 6% on ACI-Bench and 10% on the two authored strata. The critic reports root-caused it, and the causes are systematic rather than random: PriMock’s transcripts are real recordings carrying speech-recognition corruption and conversational filler, and the first prompt mishandled that in four specific ways.

这四个原因分别在评论家报告和实际案例中得到了证实：将混乱的音频解析为可信的事实；将正确的渲染与一个被禁止的项目中的真实错误捆绑在一起；在所需事实列表中填充临床医生不会期望在注释中出现的对话细节；在抄写员元框架中编写陷阱，编码抄写员通常如何失败的知识，而不是从抄本中得出陷阱。这一切都不是批评小组的失败，他们抓住了每一个案例；工作记录在版本中发布（The four causes, each verified in the critic reports with worked cases, were: resolving garbled audio into confident fact; bundling a correct rendering with a genuine error inside one forbidden item; padding the required-fact list with conversational detail no clinician would expect in a note; and writing traps in scribe-meta framing that encodes knowledge of how scribes typically fail rather than deriving the trap from the transcript. None of this was a failure of the critic panel, which caught every case; the worked record ships in the release (出处/primock_instrument_trajectory.jsonprovenance/primock_instrument_trajectory.json在代码存储库中）。in the code repository).

The four fixes went into a second version of the extraction prompt, derived from the first by addressing exactly those four causes and making no other edits: (1) an uncertainty rule, so that a garbled, ambiguous or contradicted turn can never become a confident fact, and required facts may rest only on clean evidence; (2) 等效保护，使得The four fixes went into a second version of the extraction prompt, derived from the first by addressing exactly those four causes and making no other edits: (1) an uncertainty rule, so that a garbled, ambiguous or contradicted turn can never become a confident fact, and required facts may rest only on clean evidence; (2) an equivalence protection, so that不得包含must_not_contain可以仅禁止在任何读数下出现临床错误的效果图，并明确保护正确的单位、剂量和频率转换； (3) 注释内容规则，从所需事实中排除对话结束、保证样板和患者教育措辞，除非临床上具有决定性； （4）仅记录的陷阱，源自记录所显示的内容，而不是来自抄写员如何失败的元知识。所有 57 次咨询均根据新提示重新进行，而不仅仅是已删除的 19 次，因为阶层必须是一种工具，而不是两种工具的混合。may forbid only renderings that are clinically wrong under any reading, with correct unit, dose and frequency conversions explicitly protected; (3) a note-content rule, excluding conversational closure, reassurance boilerplate and patient-education phrasing from required facts unless clinically decisive; and (4) transcript-only traps, derived from what the transcript shows and never from meta-knowledge of how scribes fail. All 57 consultations were re-run on the new prompt rather than only the 19 that had dropped, because a stratum has to be one instrument rather than a mixture of two.

还需要进行两次更正，并且提示也不需要更改。Two further corrections were needed, and neither is a change to the prompt.输入视图校正The input-view correction：解析的PriMock57版本带有: the parsed PriMock57 release carries a提出投诉presenting_complaint标题是演员的案例卡提示，而不是有关所发生的咨询的事实，并且它正在达到提取和评论家的观点，无法修复地杀死床单。它是从每个输入视图中敲击出来的，并且在相同的提示文本上重新运行了完整的 57 次。header that is the actor’s case-card prompt rather than a fact about the consultation that happened, and it was reaching the extraction and critic views, killing sheets unfixably. It was struck from every input view and the full 57 re-run on the same prompt text.切除规则The excision rule: 删除有争议的: deleting a contested不得包含must_not_contain项目永远不会使工作表出错，只会不太严格，因此最终通过规则会删除带有每个项目日志的此类项目，其中它们是工作表中唯一剩余的实质性问题 - 7 张工作表中的 9 个项目被删除，3 个工作表被拒绝删除，因为它们的残差触及所需的事实或陷阱。item can never make a sheet wrong, only less strict, so a final-pass rule deletes such items with a per-item log where they are a sheet’s only remaining material issues - 9 items across 7 sheets were excised, and 3 sheets were refused excision because their residuals touched required facts or traps.

保留的纸张构图随之移动：38，然后 44，然后 46，然后Kept-sheet composition moves with it: 38, then 44, then 46, then57 个中的 53 个已保留53 of 57 kept。全部或部分由标头导致掉线的 5 个咨询均已解决。的. The剩余 4 滴4 remaining drops根据已发布的咨询标识符进行记录are documented per consultation identifier in the released出处/primock_instrument_trajectory.jsonprovenance/primock_instrument_trajectory.json：三个是修订周期无法解决的真正内部矛盾，每个矛盾都带有触及所需事实或陷阱的残余，因此删除规则无法适用，一个是修订调用根本没有返回表格的协商。: three are genuine internal contradictions the revision cycle could not fix, each with a residual touching a required fact or a trap so that the excision rule could not apply, and one is a consultation where the revision call never returned a sheet at all.

关于这条轨迹的三件事值得复制者注意。在运行之前已修复，无论结果如何，都会报告最终速率，并且在第二个版本之后不会再次迭代提取提示，这就是为什么最后两次更正是输入更正和删除规则而不是第三次提示。其他三个层保持在第一个提示上，因为它们的掉落率已经达到或接近最终水平，并且修复特定于语音识别工件，因此语料库带有每个层的工具差异，我们在此披露。两个提示版本都随版本一起发布，因此轨迹是可检查的而不是断言的：真实记录的咨询需要更正，而创作的咨询则不需要。Three things about this trajectory are worth a replicator’s attention. It was fixed before the run that the final rate would be reported whatever it turned out to be and that the extraction prompt would not be iterated again after the second version, which is why the last two corrections are an input correction and a deletion rule rather than a third prompt. The other three strata stayed on the first prompt, because their drop rates were already at or near the final level and the fixes are specific to speech-recognition artefacts, so the corpus carries a per-stratum instrument difference and we disclose it here. And both prompt versions ship with the release, so the trajectory is checkable rather than asserted: real recorded consultations needed corrections that authored ones did not.

A.3 盲目恢复创作的地面事实和纸张尺寸不对称Blind recovery of authored ground truth, and the sheet-size asymmetry

编写答案的工具需要测量其自身的准确性，而我们自己编写的 30 次咨询使这成为可能：每一次咨询都已经附带了其作者制作的情况说明书，因此仅从抄本中盲目地重新提取一张表格并将其与所编写的表格进行比较就是一项直接测试。The instrument that writes the answer key needs its own accuracy measured, and the 30 consultations we wrote ourselves make that possible: each already carries the fact sheet its authors produced alongside it, so re-extracting a sheet blind from the transcript alone and comparing it against that authored sheet is a direct test.

恢复率为 650 个所需事实中的 646 个，99.4%Recovery is 646 of 650 authored required facts, 99.4%（95% bootstrap 间隔 [98.8%, 99.9%]，通过对整个咨询重新采样计算，以便每次咨询算作一次观察），(95% bootstrap interval [98.8%, 99.9%], computed by resampling whole consultations so that each consultation counts as one observation), with a每次咨询最低 93.8%per-consultation minimum of 93.8%- 所以恢复并不是平均隐藏一次糟糕的咨询。这 650 个事实是盲目重新提取通过了批评小组的 27 个咨询中的事实（重新提取的 30 个；A.1 表中的 3 个下降）。解读是，盲目提取是编写工作表的忠实替代品，提取的地层并不系统地比编写的地层薄，并且在主要分析中合并地层是经过许可的。- so the recovery is not an average hiding one bad consultation. The 650 facts are those of the 27 consultations whose blind re-extractions passed the critic panel (of the 30 re-extracted; the three drops are in A.1’s table). The reading is that blind extraction is a faithful substitute for an authored sheet, that the extracted strata are not systematically thinner than the authored one, and that pooling the strata in the main analysis is licensed.

尺寸比较却是相反的，这是我们没有预料到的。The size comparison went the other way, and we did not anticipate it.

提取的纸张在所需事实上增加了 1.8 倍，在陷阱上增加了 2.5 倍。这是各层之间的大小差异，它违背了我们自己的假设，而不是支持它：提取的层的完整性标准越高，意味着法官可能会漏掉更多的遗漏，其原因与法官是否可以看到缺席无关。我们按原样报告。Extracted sheets are 1.8 times fatter on required facts and 2.5 times fatter on traps. That is a size difference between strata, and it cuts against our own hypothesis rather than for it: a higher completeness bar on the extracted strata means a judge could appear to miss more omissions there for reasons that have nothing to do with whether judges can see absence. We report it as it stands.

A.5 参考注释修复循环The reference-note repair loop

每对构建的干净笔记都是语料库自己的临床医生参考笔记的修复版本。每次咨询都会进行修复，在咨询的情况说明书通过批评小组之后，它会看到三件事：文字记录、经过审计的情况说明书和原始临床医生说明。The clean note that every pair is built from is a repaired version of the corpus’s own clinician reference note. The repair runs per consultation, after that consultation’s fact sheet has passed the critic panel, and it sees three things: the transcript, the audited fact sheet, and the original clinician note.

它分两步进行。It works in two steps.审核The audit列出笔记和抄本之间的所有差异，分类为lists every discrepancy between note and transcript, classified as缺失事实missing_fact, 包含错误contains_error, 不支持的unsupported or 硬化的不确定性hardened_uncertainty（成绩单对冲，注释明确），每个评分(the transcript hedged, the note is definite), each graded材料material- 可能改变患者的理解或管理 - 或- could change patient understanding or management - or未成年人minor. 修复The repair通过最少的编辑修复所有材料差异，保留笔记的结构和风格，因此结果读起来就像是同一临床医生的笔记经过更正而不是重写；两个版本都保留在已发布的记录中。验证通过会重新检查已修复的笔记，失败的笔记会再次修复并重新检查。fixes every material discrepancy with minimal edits, preserving the note’s structure and style so the result reads as the same clinician’s note corrected rather than a rewrite; both versions stay in the released record. A verification pass re-checks the repaired note, and notes that fail are fixed once more and re-checked.

三个取景点属于这些数字。 100% 是按照我们的审计工具的标准，即采用严格的标准的单一模型审计师，因此我们报告差异密度及其逐字证据引用及其严重程度划分，而不是依赖于饱和比例。 PriMock 的参考笔记经过精心设计，是简洁的案例摘要，这特别夸大了缺失事实的数量。进行审计的工具与 A.3 中的人工事实盲恢复率为 99.4% 相同的提取机器，因此检查器本身已被检查。Three framing points belong with these numbers. The 100% is by our audit instrument’s standard, a single-model auditor applying a strict rubric, so we report the discrepancy density with its verbatim evidence quotes and its severity split rather than resting on the saturated proportion. PriMock’s reference notes are terse case summaries by design, which inflates the missing-fact counts specifically. And the instrument doing the auditing is the same extraction machinery whose blind recovery of human-authored facts is 99.4% in A.3, so the checker has itself been checked.

A.6 结对构建、单次编辑不变量以及验证被拒绝的内容Pair construction, the single-edit invariant, and what verification rejected

A.6.1 四个类别以及一次编辑对每个类别的意义Four classes and what a single edit means for each

该语料库包含四个配对类。较旧的三值The corpus carries four pair classes. The older three-value类型type场（field (添加add / 改变change / 省略omit）为了兼容性而保留不变，并且) is retained unchanged for compatibility, and类class是区分两种省略的字段。is the field that distinguishes the two kinds of omission.

保持一对可解释的不变量是，只有一件事发生了变化。 “一件事”的含义取决于类，而正确地理解它是构建中最难的定义问题。对于The invariant that keeps a pair interpretable is that exactly one thing changed. What “one thing” means depends on the class, and getting that right was the hardest definitional problem in the build. For添加add和and改变change该单位是the unit is a跨度span：差异中的一个不相等的块，具有爆炸半径上限。对于: one non-equal block in the diff, with a blast-radius cap. For省略-完成omit-complete该单位是the unit is a事实fact：删除存在于三个部分中的事实是临床医生认可的任何标准的一次编辑和差异的三次编辑，因此单块规则被两个条件取代 - 每个不相等的块都是删除，或者修复的伤口不长于它所替换的内容，并且每个删除的跨度都是目标事实的映射语句。对于: removing a fact that lives in three sections is one edit by any standard a clinician would recognise and three edits by the diff, so the one-block rule is replaced by two conditions - every non-equal block is a deletion, or a repaired wound no longer than what it replaced, and every deleted span is a mapped statement of the target fact. For省略部分omit-partial该单元又是一个跨度，即主站点，算法上与the unit is a span again, the primary site, algorithmically identical to添加add和and改变change在语义上它是相反的，因为这里需要残差而不是禁止残差。and semantically its opposite, because here a residual is required rather than forbidden.

的The主站点primary site这是该注释对这一事实的主要陈述：最完整、最具体地载有该注释的网站，也是读者会引用的网站。它由跨家族验证者提名，并记录映射者提名的回退，然后是确定性顺序规则；哪个规则被触发是根据事实记录的。每个is the note’s home statement of the fact: the site carrying it most completely and specifically, the one a reader would cite. It is nominated by the cross-family verifier, with recorded fallbacks to the mapper’s nomination and then a deterministic order rule; which rule fired is recorded per fact. Every省略部分omit-partial对携带剩余元数据 - 幸存提及的数量，每个提及都有其跨度、部分和强度，加上最强的幸存强度和涉及的部分。实力分三级，最强第一：pair carries residual metadata - the number of surviving mentions, each with its span, section and strength, plus the strongest surviving strength and the sections involved. Strength has three grades, strongest first:明确的explicit（用注释本身的临床术语清楚地说明事实），(states the fact plainly in the note’s own clinical terms),释义paraphrase（用不同的词语陈述同一事实）和(states the same fact in different words) and部分的partial（仅陈述其中的一部分，丢失了定义细节，例如价值、偏向性、对冲或驱动行动的一半）。故意没有“暗示”等级，因为读者只能从中推断出事实，而不是对事实的陈述，并且将其视为网站会删除不相关的临床内容。(states only part of it, losing a defining detail such as a value, a laterality, a hedge, or the half that drives action). There is deliberately no “implied” grade, because a span a reader could only infer the fact from is not a statement of it, and treating one as a site would delete unrelated clinical content.

A.6.2 允许修改编辑常量的一项The one permitted revision of the edit constants

算法单一编辑常量采用了一个允许的修订版，在运行任何语义编辑检查之前执行，并且该修订版在此完整公开，因为它改变了构建可以生成的对。第一个版本的常量被拒绝The algorithmic single-edit constants took their one permitted revision, exercised before any semantic edit check ran, and the revision is disclosed here in full because it changed which pairs the build could produce. The first version of the constants rejected411 对中的 210 对已建成 (51%)210 of 411 pairs as built (51%)，包括, including90 个保存的作者对中的 20 个，其中 13 个被遗漏20 of the 90 preserved authored pairs, 13 of them omissions- 该研究的标题错误类别。主要的错误故障类别是三到五个单元的单块连续部分删除，以及作为自然的一对一线路替换而实现的添加或省略，这两者都是根据规则自己声明的意图进行的单位置编辑。第二个版本将纯插入或删除上限从 2 个单位提高到 6 个单位，将替换上限从每侧 2 个单位提高到 3 个单位，并删除了两个代理、字操作纯度和最大区域计数，因为编辑方向和原子性现在是在语义上进行验证的。三件事保持冻结：本地化编辑的单个非等块不变量、30 个更改单词的爆炸半径上限以及再生后缀的两个单位限制。第二个版本的构建失败计数为- the study’s headline error class. The dominant false-failure classes were one-block contiguous section deletes of three to five units and adds or omissions realised as natural one-to-one line replacements, both of which are single-location edits under the rule’s own stated intent. The second version raised the pure insert or delete cap from 2 to 6 units and the replace cap from 2 to 3 units a side, and dropped two proxies, word-operation purity and a maximum-regions count, because edit direction and atomicity are now verified semantically instead. Three things stayed frozen: the single non-equal block invariant that localises the edit, the 30-changed-word blast-radius cap, and the regeneration suffix’s two-unit limit. The second version’s fail count as built is97。不允许进一步修改，也没有采取任何修改。. No further revision is permitted, and none was taken.

A.6.3 站点地图The site map

如果不知道注释中声明事实的位置，则无法构建两个省略类，因此映射阶段在任何注入之前运行。每次咨询的候选事实首先是配对资格省略模式陷阱，然后是核心所需事实Neither omission class can be built without knowing where in the note a fact is stated, so a mapping stage runs before any injection. Candidate facts per consultation are the pair-eligible omission-mode traps first, then core required facts with承重：高load_bearing: high，每次咨询时加盖并播种在研究种子上。对于每个候选者，映射器都会在清晰的注释中找到说明它的每个位置 - 最小的逐字跨度、它的部分、它的强度、它的字符偏移 - 并且地图由一个模型系列构建并由另一个模型系列检查，询问每个列出的跨度是否真正说明了事实，是否遗漏了任何位置，以及主要提名是否正确。, capped per consultation and seeded on the study seed. For each candidate the mapper locates every place in the clean note that states it - the smallest verbatim span, its section, its strength, its character offset - and the map is built by one model family and checked by another, asking whether each listed span really states the fact, whether any site was missed, and whether the primary nomination is right.

A.8.2 来自同一运行的方法测量Method measurements from the same run

该运行自己的质量保证记录（按层划分的首次通过缺陷率和失败率、种子之间的审核可重复性、已验证遗漏的清单覆盖范围以及审核员在三种子确认时的错误标记衰减）随发布一起发布，但有一个长期警告：没有人裁定本次运行的标记，因此其缺陷率是审核员多数的上限。这些注释被修复直到它们通过，而不是重写生成器，并且这是公开的而不是隐含的。附录 F 中的数据表引用了基准用户所需的速率。The run’s own QA record - first-pass defect and failure rates by stratum, audit reproducibility across seeds, checklist coverage of verified omissions, and the auditor’s false-flag decay at three-seed confirmation - ships with the release, under one standing caveat: no human adjudicated this run’s flags, so its defect rates are auditor-majority upper bounds. The notes were repaired until they passed rather than the generator being rewritten, and that is disclosed rather than left implicit. The datasheet in Appendix F quotes the rates a user of the benchmark needs.

A.8.3 缺席从句更正，以及 34 个部分种子是如何产生的The absence-clause correction, and how the 34 partial seeds arose

一份冻结决定文件认为，36 个被排除的遗漏对在簿记上失败了，而不是在实质上失败：编辑检查的缺席条款将真正的缺席与“对应于至少一个必需事实项目”结合起来，而针对陷阱的遗漏通常没有这样的索引。该条款被拆分，以便索引仍然被记录，但没有任何门控，并且 40 对在同一审计员、种子和杠杆处重新验证。预测不成立。A freeze-decision document argued that 36 excluded omission pairs had failed on bookkeeping rather than on substance: the edit check’s absence clause conjoined genuine absence with “corresponds to at least one required-fact item”, and trap-targeted omissions often have no such index. The clause was split so that the index is still recorded but gates nothing, and 40 pairs were re-verified at the same auditor, seeds and lever. The projection did not hold.2对已恢复，38对仍失败。2 pairs were restored and 38 still failed.事实上，在 36 个索引中的大多数中都找到了索引，但对第一个子句的检查仍然失败：已删除事实的部分或解释残差仍然存在于错误注释中。审计员自己的话，该文件对成对的人来说显然是好的：In most of the 36 the index was in fact found, and the check still failed on the first clause: a partial or paraphrased residual of the removed fact survives in the errored note. The auditor’s own words, on pairs the document had held up as demonstrably good:“印象中仍然部分反映了‘今天没有肺水肿的临床症状’”“still partially reflected by ‘No clinical signs of pulmonary oedema today’ in the Impression”; “错误的印象中仍然有部分残留的提及：它仍然说研究结果指向胸壁起源”“a partial residual mention remains in the errored Impression: it still says findings point to a chest-wall origin”.

重新运行是稳定的，这就是使任一判决值得信赖的原因：36 个中的 31 个返回了逐个字符相同的失败集，并且仅在单编辑子句中排除的 4 个控制对中，有 3 个得到了The re-run was stable, which is what makes either verdict trustworthy: 31 of the 36 returned a character-for-character identical failure set, and of the 4 control pairs excluded on the single-edit clause alone, 3 got更严格stricter- 删除所需事实锚点使审核员更愿意发现残差，而不是更少。更改后的提示会在其前身旁边的版本中进行哈希记录。- removing the required-fact anchor made the auditor more willing to find residuals, not less. The changed prompt is hash-logged in the release beside its predecessor.

有两个后果继续存在。冻结集仅测试仅存在于一个地方的事实的遗漏。而单点遗漏在真实的临床记录中往往是不可行的，因为同一事实被记录在多个部分中——这与 A.6 的 44% 拒绝率从另一端得出的结论相同。 34对没有破损；它们是经过验证的部分遗漏，并且它们作为 A.7 的重新标记的部分种子队列进入发布的集合。Two consequences carry forward. The frozen set tests only omissions of facts that lived in exactly one place. And single-point omission is often infeasible on a real clinical note, because the same fact is recorded in more than one section - which is the same conclusion the 44% rejection rate of A.6 reaches from the other end. The 34 pairs are not broken; they are verified partial omissions, and they enter the released set as the relabelled partial-seed cohort of A.7.

A.8.4 限制冻结集测量范围的一项属性One property that constrained what the frozen set could measure

优化器是反射式即时进化，发布为GEPAThe optimiser is reflective prompt evolution, published as GEPA(Agrawal et al., 2026)。它以循环方式工作：在训练示例样本上运行法官提示，向第二个模型提供法官错误的自然语言痕迹，让该模型提出重写的提示，对重写进行评分，如果得分更好则保留它。被重写的提示属于. It works in a loop: run the judge prompt over a sample of training examples, hand a second model natural-language traces of what the judge got wrong, let that model propose a rewritten prompt, score the rewrite, and keep it if it scores better. The prompt being rewritten belongs to the学生student，这里始终是被测试的判断者；读取失败并写入重写的模型是, which here is always the judge under test; the model that reads the failures and writes the rewrite is the反射器reflector。两者都固定在附录 D 中。学生在温度 1.0 下运行，没有任何推理努力，并且自始至终都有 1,024 个标记的答案上限，与第 4 部分的法官设计所使用的设置相匹配；反射器在第一个活动中以高推理力运行，在第三个活动中以中等推理速度运行，预算为 16,000 代币。这种划分具有解释性的意义，因为学生的预算是每次竞选活动中每位候选人评分的一个背景，而获胜者之一在该预算之外的表现也有所不同。 B.7 记录重新运行。. Both are pinned in Appendix D. The student ran at temperature 1.0, no reasoning effort and the 1,024-token answer cap throughout, matching the settings the judge designs of Section 4 used; the reflector ran at high reasoning effort in the first campaign and medium in the third, with a 16,000-token budget. That split carries interpretive weight, because the student’s budget is the one setting under which every candidate of every campaign was scored, and one of the winners behaves differently outside it. B.7 records the re-run.

B.1 什么是发展的，什么是固定的What evolves, and what stays fixed

只有一块文本发生变化。围绕它的一切 - 文字记录和注释如何放入提示中，以及答案必须采用的格式 - 都是由安全带固定的，并且对于竞选中的每个候选人都是相同的，因此两个候选人之间的比较只是两个指令块之间的比较，而不是其他。 B.5的提示就是那些指令块。三个包装器在三个活动中发挥作用；所有三个都作为 B.5 中命名的发布文件提供，因此读者可以准确地重建任何判断调用。Only one block of text changes. Everything around it - how the transcript and the note are laid into the prompt, and the format the answer must come back in - is fixed by the harness and identical for every candidate within a campaign, so a comparison between two candidates is a comparison between two instruction blocks and nothing else. The prompts of B.5 are those instruction blocks. Three wrappers are in play across the three campaigns; all three ship as release files named in B.5, so a reader can reconstruct any judge call exactly.

B.3 第二次活动The second campaign

第二次活动直接针对八个设计中最强的一个 - 完整性评分的八个样本评判 - 在重建的池上The second campaign aimed directly at the strongest of the eight designs - the completeness-scored eight-sample judge - on a rebuilt pool of22次咨询得出176项判断176 judgements over the same 22 consultations, 97 of them graded omission pairs. It ran 11 iterations and accepted one mutation, which at the design’s own eight samples reads 0.418 paired on omissions against the baseline seed’s 0.685 - below a coin flip, and below its own parent - and nothing in the campaign separates from the baseline (the widest gap in its tables is 3.45 points at p=0.45, and it belongs to a seed rather than to anything the search found). No prompt file was written, because writing one would have recorded a discovery that did not happen. The pool’s 22 clean twins bound what the campaign can say: every false-alarm rate moves in steps of one twenty-second, so the supported claim is that prompt optimisation of this design did not beat the design’s own baseline prompt here, not that prompt optimisation cannot help. Both comparison tables, the trajectory and the stall-rule extension are in the released record (gepa/v2_results.json).

B.4 The confirmatory campaign

Both earlier campaigns drew the reflection traces and the acceptance decision from a single small pool, which is the overspecialisation the optimiser’s own documentation warns about, and B.2 is what it cost. The third campaign fixes that at full scale, runs the published mechanics rather than an approximation of them, and points the search at a compound system - the setting the optimiser’s authors report it is strongest on - as well as at a whole-note judge. It is the campaign Section 6 rests on. It ran on 2026-08-14 in a single session, with zero unparseable judgements and no killed runs.

B.4.1 The partition is the experiment

The split was built and committed before any optimisation, and disjointness was asserted at every load: against the held-out subset, and against the 154 pair ids and 22 consultations the earlier campaigns had trained on, at both pair and consultation level. Everything is split at consultation level, because two pairs from one consultation share a transcript, a clean twin and a fact list, so a pair-level split would leak all three.

The held-out baselines were already on disk before the campaign began, bought in the runs of Sections 5 and 7, so the final comparison cost one run of the candidate and nothing else. The analysis path here recomputes the two-stage pipeline’s held-out figures from those stored records and reproduces them exactly. Those figures are replicate one throughout, which is the baseline run the campaign’s winners were measured against: 0.801 paired on omissions (Section 7.2’s published 0.786 is the mean of three primary-family runs spanning 0.771 to 0.801), 0.935 on complete removals, 0.792 on a fragment trace, 0.561 on a restatement, and 16.0% detection (21/131) at 8.5% false alarms (4/47).

B.4.2 The mechanics that were run

The published procedure was followed on the points that matter to whether a search can overfit its own validator: candidates are kept on a per-example Pareto frontier rather than by a single aggregate score, parents are sampled in proportion to the examples on which they lead, acceptance is promiscuous (a child enters on a minibatch improvement and the frontier prunes afterwards), merge is enabled once six candidates exist, feedback to the reflector is textual and per-failure, and minibatches are drawn consultation-first so every flawed note’s own clean twin sits in the same batch. The acceptance objective’s primary term is paired discrimination on omissions, with detection at a false-alarm rate of 10% or below as secondary - paired is primary because the acceptance split holds 20 clean twins, so its false-alarm axis moves in five-point steps, too coarse to steer a search with.

B.4.3 Target one: the per-fact checker inside the two-stage pipeline

This is the one place a gain looked most plausible, because the pipeline of Section 7 is where the study’s strongest omission signal sits and its check stage asks a small, well-posed question. The student was that pipeline with exactly one paragraph mutable. Extraction stayed frozen and cached, so the held-out run scored against the identical fact lists the baseline had been scored on, and the check stage ran at no reasoning effort through the pipeline’s own code path. The search ran 15 iterations: 8 candidates accepted (7 mutations and 1 merge), 7 rejected at the minibatch, 3 merge invocations. The winner, v3p-01，出现在, appeared at迭代1iteration 1，后来没有什么能打败它。, and nothing later beat it.

B.4.5 搜索写了什么What the search wrote

两个目标都产生了更长、更具体、完全合理的提示。第一个目标的种子为 564 个字符，获胜者为 3,183 个字符，其中最精心设计的候选字符为 15,117 个字符；获胜者指出事实的临床决定性部分、极性、确定性、剂量和归因，并告诉检查者保留对冲。这是个好建议。它所购买的内容在保留的分数分布中可见：干净音符的平均分数为 0.9587，基线为 0.9612，有遗漏音符的平均分数为 0.9315，而有缺陷的音符为 0.9323，因此干净音符和有缺陷音符之间的差距为Both targets produced longer, more specific, entirely sensible prompts. The first target’s seed is 564 characters and its winner 3,183, with the most elaborate candidate in the population at 15,117; the winner names the clinically decisive part of a fact, polarity, certainty, dose and attribution, and tells the checker to preserve hedging. It is good advice. What it bought is visible in the held-out score distributions: mean score on clean notes 0.9587 against the baseline’s 0.9612, mean score on notes with omissions 0.9315 against 0.9323, so the gap between a clean note and a flawed one is0.0272 对比 0.02890.0272 against 0.0289。提示将整个分布向下移动了大约四分之一个百分点，并将分离保留在它发现的地方——相同的操作点将第 6 节产生的杠杆向下移动一个级别，在逐事实查找而不是音符级别判断上。. The prompt moved the whole distribution down about a quarter of a percentage point and left the separation where it found it - the same operating-point shift the levers of Section 6 produce, one level down, at the per-fact lookup rather than the note-level judgement.

顺便说一句：第一个目标的获胜者比基线有更好的佣金校准（在 10 个加法对中，0.725 对 0.650，0.700 对 0.600）——这不是 n=20 时的发现，但它指出了第 7 节的捏造诊断所指出的地方，即枚举法官的捏造盲目性可以通过其遗漏盲目性所不能的措辞来达到。One aside: the first target’s winner has better commission calibration held out than the baseline (0.725 against 0.650, and 0.700 against 0.600 on the 10 addition pairs) - not a finding at n=20, but it points where Section 7’s fabrication diagnostic pointed, at an enumerating judge’s fabrication blindness being reachable by wording in a way its omission blindness is not.

B.4.6 偏离优化器已发布的程序Departures from the optimiser’s published procedure

第四，一切都是经过深思熟虑的，都记录在跑步的文物中。Four, all deliberate and all recorded in the run’s artefacts.

  1. 1.

    合并是作为反射器介导的交叉来实现的Merge is implemented as a reflector-mediated crossover两个前沿候选者导致不同的例子，而不是发布的模块交换。两个目标都只演化出一个模块 - 第一个目标故意冻结提取 - 因此模块交换之间没有任何可交换的内容。of two frontier candidates that lead on different examples, rather than the published module swap. Both targets evolve exactly one module - the first freezes extraction on purpose - so a module swap has nothing to swap between.

  2. 2.

    第二个目标的手写种子字符不完全相同The second target’s hand-written seed is not character-for-character identical对于分享其内容的第 4 部分的工程评委：这是在八个设计使用的框架中重新表达的提示内容，并将文字记录和注释移到了前面。完整性评分种子to the engineered judge of Section 4 that shares its content: it is that prompt’s content re-expressed in the frame the eight designs use, with the transcript and note moved to the front. The completeness-scored seedis与该设计本身的提示完全相同。identical, character for character, to that design’s own prompt.

  3. 3.

    接受目标的主要术语是配对辨别而不是单音符检测The acceptance objective’s primary term is paired discrimination rather than single-note detection，出于上述机制中所述的样本大小原因。, for the sample-size reason stated with the mechanics above.

  4. 4.

    搜索针对两个目标的每个判断运行一个样本The search ran at one sample per judgement on both targets;只有第二个目标的确认结果为八。; only the second target’s held-out confirmation ran at eight.

早期的两个活动进一步偏离，第三个活动在某种程度上是为了解决这个问题而建立的：两者都从一个池中提取反射痕迹和接受决定，第一个在 8 个示例的未分层小批量而不是全池分数上接受候选者，第二个在四个样本中进行搜索，其中一个种子在 8 时未确认，并在运行中扩展了自己的摊位规则。每次离开都记录在已发布的竞选记录中。The two earlier campaigns departed further, and in ways the third was built to fix: both drew reflection traces and acceptance decisions from one pool, the first accepted candidates on an 8-example unstratified minibatch rather than full-pool scores, and the second searched at four samples with one seed left unconfirmed at eight and extended its own stall rule mid-run. Every departure is recorded in the released campaign records.

B.6 便携式课程和三个推论The portable lesson, and three corollaries

在两个目标、30 次迭代和 15 个接受的候选者中，确认活动将保留的估计值移动了 -2.3 和 +0.4 点的配对歧视，与零相比，基线的运行间差异在相同的配对上为 0.531 至 0.649。狭隘的主张是第 6 节所做的：提示优化，正确运行，没有击败我们已经拥有的提示，无论是在整个注释判断器还是管道内的事实检查器上。Across two targets, 30 iterations and 15 accepted candidates, the confirmatory campaign moved the held-out estimate by -2.3 and +0.4 points of paired discrimination, neither distinguishable from zero, against a baseline whose own run-to-run spread on the same pairs is 0.531 to 0.649. The narrow claim is the one Section 6 makes: prompt optimisation, run properly, did not beat the prompts we already had, on either a whole-note judge or the per-fact checker inside the pipeline.

该方法的结果更便于移植，这就是本附录将接受表打印在保留表旁边的原因。The methods result is more portable, and it is the reason this appendix prints the acceptance tables next to the held-out ones.接受 20 次咨询的情况下，您将获得 5 到 7 分的改进，这是 47 次咨询保留组所看不到的。A 20-consultation acceptance split will hand you a five-to-seven-point improvement that a 47-consultation held-out set does not see.第一个和第三个活动都发现了这一点；第一个只有在发出提示文件后才发现它，然后该提示继续读取它从未见过的数据的 21.9% 误报。接下来是三个推论，而且它们的应用成本很低。Both the first and the third campaign found that; the first found it only after emitting a prompt file, and that prompt then went on to read 21.9% false alarms on data it had never seen. Three corollaries follow, and they are cheap to apply.

在共享结构的单元处拆分，而不是在行处拆分。Split at the unit that shares structure, not at the row.一次咨询中的两对共享一份记录、一份干净的双胞胎和一份事实列表，因此对级别的拆分会泄漏所有三者，并且验证器不再独立于训练信号。Two pairs from one consultation share a transcript, a clean twin and a fact list, so a pair-level split leaks all three and the validator stops being independent of the training signal.

在搜索开始之前测量保留的基线。Measure the held-out baseline before the search starts.这里两个基线的保留数据在活动开始之前就已经购买并存储在磁盘上，因此最终的比较花费了候选者的一轮运行，而保留的集合在最后只被触及一次。The held-out figures for both baselines here were already bought and on disk before the campaign began, so the final comparison cost one run of the candidate and the held-out set was touched exactly once, at the end.

仅根据保留的结果发出伪影。Emit the artefact only on the held-out result.第三个活动的第一个目标是在 5.2 点的接受分割增益上选择的，而它自己的样本无法解决这个问题 - 8 胜 3，p=0.23 - 因此，以接受分割为关键的规则将已经发货，而保留的集合则表示没有什么可发货的。相反，所使用的规则 - 仅当获胜者在保留数据的主要度量上超过其基线时才会写入提示文件 - 意味着不会为任何一个目标写入文件。三个活动中发出的唯一提示文件是第一个活动的，根据宽松规则编写，B.2 是它发生的情况。The third campaign’s first target was chosen on a 5.2-point acceptance-split gain that its own sample could not resolve - 8 wins against 3, p=0.23 - so a rule keyed to the acceptance split would have shipped it, and the held-out set says there was nothing to ship. The rule used instead - a prompt file is written only when the winner beats its baseline on the primary measure on held-out data - meant no file was written for either target. The only prompt file any of the three campaigns emitted is the first campaign’s, written under the loose rule, and B.2 is what happened to it.

B.7 每个候选人的预算，以及取消后会发生什么The budget every candidate was scored in, and what happens when it is lifted

一项设置对于所有三个营销活动都是通用的，并且不会出现在它们的任何结果表中。每个候选提示均由学生执行，无需在第 4 节的 1,024 个标记答案上限内进行推理 -One setting is common to all three campaigns and appears in none of their result tables. Every candidate prompt was executed by the student with no reasoning effort inside the 1,024-token answer cap of Section 4 -gepa_optimize.py, gepa_v2.py和andgepa_v3.py每一次通过each passReasoning_effort=“无”reasoning_effort="none"在他们的评审中，只有读取故障痕迹并进行重写的反射器才有考虑的空间。因此，可以向候选人提出一项没有预算可执行的指令，然后对该指令进行评分，就像该指令已被尝试过一样。at their judging call - while only the reflector, which reads the failure traces and writes the rewrite, was given room to deliberate. A candidate could therefore be proposed with an instruction it had no budget to carry out, and then be scored as though the instruction had been tried.

这就是探索性竞选获胜者的遭遇。That is what happened to the exploratory campaign’s winner.gepa-04的指令块以枚举然后检查程序开头，B.2 记录它读取了 23.0% 的遗漏，标记为对它从未见过的数据的 21.9% 误报，配对为 0.549。重新运行不变，逐个字符 - 相同的已发布的提示文件，’s instruction block leads with an enumerate-then-check procedure, and B.2 records it reading 23.0% of omissions flagged at 21.9% false alarms on data it had never seen, paired 0.549. Re-run unchanged, character for character - the same released prompt file,gepa/judge_prompt.txt, SHA-256 前缀, SHA-256 prefixbb47c133- 在高推理努力下的 151 对保留子集上，上限为 12,000 个代币，三个种子，它写道- on the 151-pair held-out subset at high reasoning effort with a 12,000-token cap, three seeds, it reads0.669 与 0.546 配对，以实现其自身的努力 - 对同一子集没有控制0.669 paired against 0.546 for its own effort-none control on that same subset（变化 +0.123，95% 间隔 [+0.059，+0.189]，通过对整个咨询重新采样计算，以便每次咨询都算作一次观察）。该预算配置是第 7.6 节的演变提示。它的干净音符分数分布也改变了形状，47 个干净音符双胞胎中的 45、46 和 45 正好落在 10 分中的 10 分，这是操作点第 7 部分报告的 32.1% 检测率和 2.1% 误报率背后的校准。两次运行中的提示文本都是相同的，只是执​​行的推理预算不同。(change +0.123, 95% interval [+0.059, +0.189], computed by resampling whole consultations so that each consultation counts as one observation). That budgeted configuration is the evolved prompt of Section 7.6. Its clean-note score distribution changes shape too, with 45, 46 and 45 of the 47 clean twins landing on exactly 10 out of 10, which is the calibration behind the operating point Section 7 reports at 32.1% detection and 2.1% false alarms. The prompt text is identical character for character across the two runs, and only the reasoning budget it executed under differs.

同样的重新运行带有控制权，可以防止这成为一般计算的主张。第 4 节的设计法官，我们可以手写的最强单提示法官，获得了The same re-run carries the control that keeps this from being a claim about compute in general. The engineered judge of Section 4, the strongest single-prompt judge we could write by hand, gains+0.013 [-0.047, +0.071]当以同样的方式重新运行时，提示上的跨零区间已经达到 0.635，而简单的完整性评分标准则获得when re-run the same way, an interval straddling zero on a prompt already at 0.635, while the plain completeness-scored criterion gains+0.101 [+0.048, +0.153]。对于某些提示，推理预算只值十分之一的辨别点，而对于其他提示，则毫无意义。表. A reasoning budget is worth about a tenth of a point of discrimination to some prompts and nothing to others. Table7带有与管道进行计算匹配比较的完整梯子，以及第 7 节的读数。涉及的每个提示文本与 B.5 和已发布的清单相比没有变化，并且重新运行的记录、每次重复表和集群间隔在数据存储库中提供carries the full ladder with the compute-matched comparison against the pipeline, and Section 7 the reading. Every prompt text involved is unchanged from B.5 and the released inventory, and the re-run’s records, per-replicate tables and clustered intervals ship in the data repository under判决/法官/w2-power/judgements/judges/w2-power/，以及该研究的其他法官家庭。, beside the study’s other judge families.

有两件事这是不成立的。这是一个在给定预算的情况下已经选择的提示，而不是一次进行的搜索：学生预算较大的搜索将对不同的候选人群体做出不同的接受决定，但它没有运行。干净笔记校准是在该语料库上的三个种子上观察到的行为，而不是提示保证的属性，因此部署必须在其自己的干净笔记上重新建立阈值（第 8 节）。Two things this does not establish. It is one already-selected prompt given a budget, not a search conducted at one: a search with a larger student budget would make different acceptance decisions over a different candidate population, and it was not run. And the clean-note calibration is a behaviour observed on three seeds on this corpus, not a property the prompt guarantees, so a deployment would have to re-establish the threshold on its own clean notes (Section 8).

B.8 探索性的胜利者，逐字逐句The exploratory winner, verbatim

Those codes are the released data’s names for the two tiers, and the pipeline as a whole is route one in the released data and the figures.

C.1 各个阶段以及每个人可以看到的内容The stages, and what each one is allowed to see

该管道在推理时分四个阶段运行基准构建所使用的相同操作 - 其中三个阶段称为三阶段层，再加上仅在标记缺席时触发的第二个外观。The pipeline runs the same operations the benchmark’s construction used, at inference time, in four stages - the three that name the three-stage tier, plus a second look that fires only on flagged absences.萃取Extraction阅读笔录并写下临床重要事实的编号列表，每个事实都有一个 ID 及其支持证据；它每次咨询运行一次并缓存到磁盘。reads the transcript and writes a numbered list of clinically material facts, each with an id and its supporting evidence; it runs once per consultation and is cached to disk.审核The audit（仅限三阶段管道）读取笔录和候选者列表，删除不支持的、重复的或不希望记录的事实，并根据第 3 节的书面标题（打印在附录 A 中）对每个幸存者的严重程度进行评分；它也每次咨询运行一次并被缓存。(three-stage pipeline only) reads the transcript and that candidate list, drops facts that are unsupported, duplicated or not something a note would be expected to record, and grades each survivor’s severity against the written rubric of Section 3 (printed in Appendix A); it also runs once per consultation and is cached.支票The check是唯一看到正在判断的注释的阶段：它接收注释和编号的事实列表，并为每个事实 id 返回一个判决，在两级管道上存在或不存在，在三阶段管道上返回全部/部分/不存在。is the only stage that sees the note under judgement: it receives the note and the numbered fact list and returns one verdict per fact id, present-or-absent on the two-stage pipeline and full/partial/absent on the three-stage pipeline.第二次看The second look（仅限三级管道）接收注释和仅检查判断不存在的那些事实，并且可以通过在注释中查找事实来挽救事实。(three-stage pipeline only) receives the note and only those facts the check judged absent, and may rescue a fact by finding it in the note.

对于任何复制此内容的人来说，三个合同细节都很重要。判决以事实 ID 为关键，而不是作为列表返回，因此错误计数是一组差异，而不是无声的错位。未答复的 ID 会触发一次有针对性的重试，仅询问它们，而任何仍未答复的内容都会导致记录解析失败，而不是未知分母上的分数。在确认中，两层都不需要重试其 198 个音符判断中的任何一个，也不会产生解析失败。第二次查看必须返回逐字注释文本，其中包含其声称检查遗漏的任何事实，并且仅当该引用在空格和大小写规范化后实际出现在注释中（八个或更多字符）时才被接受。无法验证的报价将被计算在内，缺席仍然有效。向检查阶段显示的事实列表仅包含 ID 和事实文本：故意隐瞒严重性，因为检查员告诉检查员某个事实很关键，这是在督促检查员查看有多难。Three contract details matter for anyone reproducing this. Verdicts are keyed to fact ids rather than returned as a list, so a mis-count is a set difference rather than a silent misalignment. Ids that come back unanswered trigger one targeted retry asking only about them, and anything still unanswered makes the record a parse failure rather than a fraction over an unknown denominator. In the confirmation neither tier needed that retry on any of its 198 note-judgements, and neither produced a parse failure. The second look must return the verbatim note text carrying any fact it claims the check missed, and a rescue is accepted only if that quote actually occurs in the note after whitespace and case normalisation, at eight characters or more. An unverifiable quote is counted and the absence stands. And the fact list shown to the check stage carries ids and fact text only: severity is withheld deliberately, because a checker told that a fact is critical is a checker being nudged about how hard to look.

评分和阈值。两阶段总计是存在的事实的份额。三阶段汇总是严重性加权捕获，记入全部 1.0、部分 0.5 和缺席 0.0，权重为关键 4、支持 2 和外围 1。这些权重是对相对临床成本的指示性猜测，而不是测量的数量，并且未加权的变体记录在每个注释旁边，因此没有任何内容。两个层都故意将其标志字段写为空：在运行之前没有固定标志阈值，第 7 节及以下部分中的每个操作点都会在分析中进行扫描，并用同一阈值下的误报率引用。Scoring and thresholds. The two-stage aggregate is the share of facts present. The three-stage aggregate is severity-weighted capture, crediting full 1.0, partial 0.5 and absent 0.0, with weights critical 4, supporting 2 and peripheral 1. Those weights are an indicative guess at relative clinical cost rather than a measured quantity, and the unweighted variant is recorded beside every note so nothing rests on them. Both tiers write their flag field as null on purpose: no flag threshold was fixed before the run, and every operating point in Section 7 and below is swept in analysis and quoted with the false-alarm rate at that same threshold.

在确认的 47 次咨询中，这些阶段产生的结果是：每条记录提取出 39.2 个事实，审计将其削减至 37.6 个。因此，三阶段管道的 198 个注释判断基于 7,443 个事实判断、6,548 个完整判断、675 个部分判断和 220 个缺席判断。两阶段管道依赖于 7,762 个二元判决，其中 7,291 个存在，471 个缺席。What the stages produce, on the confirmation’s 47 consultations: extraction yields 39.2 facts per note, and the audit cuts that to 37.6. The three-stage pipeline’s 198 note-judgements therefore rest on 7,443 per-fact verdicts, 6,548 full, 675 partial and 220 absent after the second look; the two-stage pipeline’s rest on 7,762 binary verdicts, 7,291 present and 471 absent.

C.2 盲目性是一种结构性断言，而不是一种惯例Blindness is a structural assertion, not a convention

提取和审计绝不能看到正在判断的注释，因为被注释污染的事实列表是根据用于评分的事物构建的事实列表。有两种机制可以强制执行这一点。这两个阶段的提示构建者都会记录一份成绩单，并为审核提供候选人事实清单，仅此而已；任何一个函数内的范围内都没有注释文本。在拨打任何电话之前，Extraction and audit must never see the note under judgement, because a fact list contaminated by the note is a fact list built from the thing it is used to score. Two mechanisms enforce that. The prompt builders for both stages take a transcript, and for the audit a candidate fact list, and nothing else; no note text is in scope inside either function. Before either call is made,断言盲assert_blind将构建的提示与该咨询的每个注释进行比较：它标准化空格和大小写，从每个注释中获取三个 120 个字符的探测（开始、中间、结束），并且如果提示中出现任何探测，则引发而不是运行。注释是生成的结构化文档，而不是抄本的跨度，因此命中将是真正的泄漏，而不是偶然的重叠。因为断言是提升而不是降级，所以完成的运行本身就是它从未触发的记录：确认的所有 37 次提取和 37 次审计调用均已完成。compares the built prompt against every note of that consultation: it normalises whitespace and case, takes three 120-character probes from each note (start, middle, end), and raises rather than running if any probe occurs in the prompt. A note is a generated structured document rather than a span of the transcript, so a hit would be a real leak instead of incidental overlap. Because the assertion raises rather than degrading, a completed run is itself the record that it never fired: all 37 extraction and 37 audit calls of the confirmation completed.

进一步的分离来自固定角色而不是断言：编写事实列表的模型与检查事实列表的模型来自不同的系列（附录 D），因此枚举的事实不是检查系列自己的。One further separation follows from the pinned roles rather than from an assertion: the model that writes the fact list is from a different family from the model that checks the note against it (Appendix D), so the enumerated facts are not the checking family’s own.

C.3 推理努力的混淆，以及消除它的实验The reasoning-effort confound, and the experiment that removed it

八个单一的法官设计无需推理就可以运行他们的法官。 pipeline的检查阶段没有，原因记录在runner中。两次咨询连线试点（每层 4 个笔记判断）发现，在没有推理的情况下，检查器在大约 190 个输出标记中回答了 36 个事实键控问题，推理标记为零，每个判决大约有 5 个标记，并且在试点的 4 个三阶段笔记判断中，它从未使用过三分法的中间标签：147 个完整，3 个缺席，没有部分。对那个试播集的两个干净笔记进行了四次中等努力的重新探测，成本为 0.06 美元，并且没有存储在任何地方，产生了 1,100 到 1,200 个推理标记，并且确实使用了“部分”。因此，检查阶段被转移到中等努力，这使得混乱显而易见：任何对整体设计的胜利都可能是深思熟虑，而不是任务重组。The eight monolithic judge designs ran their judge at no reasoning effort. The pipeline’s check stage did not, and the reason is recorded in the runner. A two-consultation wiring pilot (4 note-judgements per tier) found that at no reasoning effort the checker answered a 36-fact keyed question in about 190 output tokens with zero reasoning tokens, roughly five tokens per verdict, and that across the pilot’s four three-stage note-judgements it never once used the trichotomy’s middle label: 147 full and 3 absent, no partials. A four-call re-probe at medium effort on the two clean notes of that pilot, costing $0.06 and stored nowhere, produced 1,100 to 1,200 reasoning tokens and did use “partial”. The check stage was therefore moved to medium effort, which left the confound plainly on the table: any win over the monolithic designs might be deliberation rather than task restructuring.

我们通过在相同的 38 对探索子集上重新运行两级管道来直接对其进行测试，无需任何推理工作，也无需更改任何其他内容。努力并不是收获的源泉。该层毫不费力地在遗漏方面得分为 0.828 配对歧视，其中 0.5 相当于抛硬币，扫描检测率为 31.2%，误报率为 9.4%；在相同对上的中等努力下，它的配对得分为 0.813，检测率为 25.0%，误报率为 9.4%。它也更便宜，每个音符判断为 0.0074 美元，而每个音符判断为 0.0346 美元，系数为 4.65。因此，确认无需推理就运行了两级管道，与使用的整体设计相同的设置，这彻底消除了该层的混乱。三级管道保持中等工作量，因为它的三分法显然需要它。记录一致：所有 198 个两阶段确认笔记判断都带有零推理标记，而三阶段管道在其检查和第二次查看调用中平均每个笔记判断有 1,834 个推理标记。We tested it directly by re-running the two-stage pipeline on the identical 38-pair exploratory subset at no reasoning effort, changing nothing else. Effort was not the source of the gain. At no effort the tier scores 0.828 paired discrimination on omissions, where 0.5 is a coin flip, with swept detection of 31.2% at a 9.4% false-alarm rate; at medium effort on the same pairs it scores 0.813 paired and 25.0% detection at the same 9.4% false alarms. It is also cheaper, $0.0074 against $0.0346 per note-judgement, a factor of 4.65. The confirmation therefore ran the two-stage pipeline at no reasoning effort, the same setting the monolithic designs used, which removes the confound for that tier outright. The three-stage pipeline kept medium effort because its trichotomy demonstrably needs it. The records agree: all 198 two-stage confirmation note-judgements carry zero reasoning tokens, while the three-stage pipeline averages 1,834 reasoning tokens per note-judgement across its check and second-look calls combined.

C.4 三分法诊断没有重复The trichotomy diagnostic did not replicate

分析脚本会根据变体对相同的购买判决进行重新评分。其中信息最丰富的“宽大”，认为部分判决是完整的，因此只有彻底缺席才算作记录；这是关于三分法的中间标签是否有效的最清晰的解读。在探索山口时，它到达了The analysis script re-scores the same purchased verdicts under variants. The most informative of them, “lenient”, credits a partial verdict as full, so only an outright absent counts against a note; it is the cleanest read available on whether the trichotomy’s middle label is doing work. On the exploratory pass it reached检测率为 46.9%，误报率为 6.2%46.9% detection at 6.2% false alarms（32 个省略对，32 个干净音符），通过的最强数字。在 131 个保留的遗漏对与 47 个干净的双胞胎中，它达到了(32 omission pairs, 32 clean notes), the strongest number that pass produced. On the 131 held-out omission pairs against 47 clean twins it reaches22.9% 至 8.5%22.9% at 8.5%。减少了一半以上。这些变体是根据已购买的判决计算的归因诊断，而不是可供选择的配置菜单，并且选择其中最好的将在探索性过程中进行调整，这正是减半的惩罚。. It more than halved. These variants are attribution diagnostics computed on verdicts already bought, not a menu of configurations to choose from, and picking the best of them would have been tuning on the exploratory pass, which is exactly what the halving punishes.

三分法也未能实现其预期的另一半效果。它的设计基于这样的预期：最大的收益将落在部分遗漏上，即被删除的事实会留下一些痕迹。在误报率等于或低于 10% 的扫描阈值下，三级管道检测到 62 个完全遗漏中的 19.4%、69 个部分遗漏（弱和强合并）中的 17.4% 以及 33 个部分强遗漏中的 12.1%。在配对测量中，排序相同且更宽：对于部分集合，完成 0.863 对 0.652，并且在部分中 0.819 弱对 0.470 强。审计阶段实际购买的是严重性等级，这是第 7 节的事实规则所需的成分，而更便宜的层无法提供：两阶段管道的所有 471 个缺失事实条目根本没有严重性。The trichotomy also failed the other half of what it was expected to do. It was designed on the expectation that the largest gain would fall on partial omissions, where the removed fact leaves some trace behind. At a swept threshold holding false alarms at or below 10%, the three-stage pipeline detects 19.4% of the 62 complete omissions, 17.4% of the 69 partial omissions (weak and strong pooled) and 12.1% of the 33 partial-strong ones. On the paired measure the ordering is the same and wider: complete 0.863 against 0.652 for partials pooled, and within partials 0.819 weak against 0.470 strong. What the audit stage actually bought was the severity grades, which are the ingredient the per-fact rule of Section 7 needs and the cheaper tier cannot supply: all 471 of the two-stage pipeline’s missing-fact entries carry no severity at all.

C.5 经过引用验证的第二次观察：对事实的真正研究，注释级别没有变化The quote-verified second look: real work on facts, no change at note level

确认后，进行第二次检查On the confirmation, the second look examined299 人举报缺勤并获救其中 79 人，占 26.4%299 flagged absences and rescued 79 of them, 26.4%, 与, with零zero因无法核实的报价而被拒绝；报价验证铁路自始至终都是实时运行的，从来不需要触发，并且没有第二次查看呼叫出错。它对标题的影响是一洗。在没有该阶段的情况下重新对相同的判决进行评分，得出 0.752 对遗漏的配对歧视，而没有该阶段的为 0.763，并且在 131 个保留的遗漏对上，扫描检测率为 18.3%，而扫描检测率为 17.6%。rejections for an unverifiable quote; the quote-verification rail was live throughout and never had to fire, and no second-look call errored. Its effect on the headline is a wash. Re-scoring the same verdicts without it gives 0.752 paired discrimination on omissions with the stage against 0.763 without, and swept detection of 18.3% against 17.6% on the 131 held-out omission pairs.

它不是免费的。该阶段仅在音符判断至少有一个标记缺席时触发，这是确认的 198 个缺席中的 124 个，因此它为每个音符判断添加了 0.63 个调用，而不是一个。这 124 次调用花费了 2.77 美元，而三级管道在确认的 198 个音符判断中的音符级调用上花费了 8.71 美元，其中 2.77 美元是It is not free. The stage fires only on note-judgements carrying at least one flagged absence, which was 124 of the confirmation’s 198, so it adds 0.63 calls per note-judgement rather than one. Those 124 calls cost $2.77 of the $8.71 the three-stage pipeline spent on note-level calls across the confirmation’s 198 note-judgements, which is该管道的每张票据边际成本为 0.044 美元，其中 0.014 美元，即 32%$0.014 of that pipeline’s $0.044 marginal cost per note, or 32%，在任一方向上都没有可测量的变化。 26.4% 的翻转率表明第二次考察是在对个别事实进行真正的研究；纸币级别的数字表明工作被抵消了。该阶段保留在三阶段管道内，第 7 节报告和价格，因此附录 D 单独记录了其在该管道的每音符成本中所占的份额。, for no measurable change in either direction. The 26.4% flip rate says the second look is doing real work on individual facts; the note-level figures say that work cancels out. The stage stays inside the three-stage pipeline Section 7 reports and prices, and Appendix D records its share of that pipeline’s per-note cost separately for this reason.

C.6 n=10 时加法对的制造反相关Fabrication anti-correlation on the addition pairs, at n=10

确认的 10 个加法对（插入到原本干净的注释中的捏造事实）为三级管道提供了配对分数The confirmation’s 10 addition pairs - a fabricated fact inserted into an otherwise clean note - give the three-stage pipeline a paired score of0.300，低于抛硬币的 0.5，这意味着它的得分通常高于其自己的干净双胞胎。相同 10 对的两级管道得分为 0.600，10 个变化对的三级管道得分为 0.700，探索性通道的 3 个加法对得分为三级管道 0.833。从表面上看，该机制似乎很合理：覆盖分数会奖励说明更多内容的注释，并且两层都不会询问该注释是否包含记录不支持的内容，这就是第 7 节描述的委员会方面的盲目性。 10 对时，这是一个适当调整尺寸的信号，而不是一个发现，这里就是这样报告的。, below the 0.5 of a coin flip, which means it scores the note containing the fabrication above its own clean twin more often than not. The two-stage pipeline on the same 10 pairs scores 0.600, the three-stage pipeline on the 10 change pairs 0.700, and the exploratory pass’s 3 addition pairs gave the three-stage pipeline 0.833. The mechanism is plausible enough on its face: a coverage score rewards a note that says more, and neither tier ever asks whether the note contains content the transcript does not support, which is the commission-side blindness Section 7 describes. At 10 pairs this is a signal to size properly rather than a finding, and it is reported that way here.

C.7 部署参数Deployment parameters

完整的部署参数化随版本一起提供，而不是在这里：每个阶段的模型角色、推理工作设置、每个阶段接收的内容、调用计划、缓存密钥以及两个框架中测量的每个音符的成本。管道运行者（The full deployment parameterisation ships with the release rather than here: per-stage model roles, reasoning-effort settings, what each stage receives, call schedules, caching keys, and the measured per-note costs in both framings. The pipeline runner (w2_pipeline.py），其提示文件（), its prompt files (w2_提示/w2_prompts/），运行清单包含所有设置，附录 D 记录每张票据的价格及其测量日期。该记录中的三个事实留在报纸上，因为结果取决于它们。按照每个咨询一个注释的价格，审计阶段是三阶段管道每条注释 0.45 美元的 71%，这就是为什么第 7 节将严重程度分级折叠到提取调用中，以及更便宜的提取模型作为两个未经测试的成本杠杆。该确认为其 47 次咨询购买了 37 次提取和 37 次审计，因为其中 10 次咨询也出现在探索性通行证中，并且它们的缓存阶段被重用 - 因此，正如第 8 节所述，确认是对判断的完全保留测试，而只是部分提取。并且没有测量延迟：该工具记录了每个调用的令牌接收、成本和完成时间戳，但没有每个调用的挂钟持续时间，因此不存在延迟数据，也不应该从时间戳中推断出任何延迟数据。) and the run manifests carry every setting, and Appendix D records the per-note prices with their measurement dates. Three facts from that record stay in the paper because results rest on them. At the one-note-per-consultation price, the audit stage is 71% of the three-stage pipeline’s $0.45 per note, which is why Section 7 names folding severity grading into the extraction call, and a cheaper extraction model, as the two untested cost levers. The confirmation bought 37 extractions and 37 audits for its 47 consultations, because 10 of those consultations also appear in the exploratory pass and their cached stages were reused - so the confirmation is a fully held-out test of the judging and only a partial one of the extraction, as Section 8 states. And latency was not measured: the harness records token receipts, cost and a completion timestamp per call, but no per-call wall-clock duration, so no latency figure exists and none should be inferred from the timestamps.

本附录记录了复制器需要什么才能重新生成研究：哪个模型以哪个角色运行，在什么传输上和在哪些设置上运行，以及如何对运行进行播种、散列和识别。第 9 节列出了已发布工件中的工具、提示、判断配置、模型引脚和运行清单，本附录是对这些对象的描述。从业者将支付的每张票据的价格在第 7 节中，并与下面 D.3 中的测量日期进行了调整。This appendix records what a replicator needs in order to regenerate the study: which model ran in which role, on what transport and at which settings, and how runs were seeded, hashed and identified. Two conventions travel with those numbers.每次咨询一注框架和摊销框架都必须在引用的任何地方都进行标记：提取和审计阶段每次咨询运行一次并被缓存，因此两个框架在两层上的差异超过三倍，并描述不同的部署。每次咨询评估一个笔记的从业者支付第一个费用，而根据一份笔录评估多个笔记的服务则支付第二个费用。在三阶段层中，第二次检查占每音符边际成本 0.044 美元的 0.014 美元，占该层每音符支出的 32%，因为任一方向的检测都没有可测量的变化（附录 C）。Two conventions travel with those numbers. The one-note-per-consultation framing and the amortised framing must both be labelled wherever either is quoted: the extraction and audit stages run once per consultation and are cached, so the two framings differ by more than a factor of three on both tiers and describe different deployments. A practitioner evaluating one note per consultation pays the first, and a service evaluating several notes against one transcript pays the second. And within the three-stage tier the second look accounts for $0.014 of the $0.044 marginal per-note cost, 32% of that tier’s per-note spend, for no measurable change in detection in either direction (Appendix C).

RAGAS 式配方的 0.03 美元到 0.07 美元范围涵盖了两个测量价格：每条记录 0.0305 美元，每次咨询提取缓存在咨询记录中；0.069 美元，用密钥合约和完整代币预算测量（来自基线运行自己的收据，在数据存储库中的清单旁边发布）。The $0.03 to $0.07 range for the RAGAS-style recipe spans its two measured prices: $0.0305 per note with the per-consultation extraction cached across a consultation’s notes, and $0.069 measured with the keyed contract and full token budgets (from the baselines runs’ own receipts, released beside their manifests in the data repository).

This is the endorsement that props up a headline directly: the 44% rejection rate on the complete-removal class (Section 3) is a finding about clinical notes only if the panel’s standard is right, and a clinician reading one pair per failure mode agreed with it every time. The lower bound is 61%, which excludes a panel that is wrong more than a third of the time and nothing finer.

而且误报也不是误报。And the false alarm is not a false alarm.项目 F6 是第 7 节的按事实规则下确认运行的单个误报，此处根据三阶段管道的确认记录重新计算（Item F6 is the confirmation run’s single false positive under Section 7’s per-fact rule, recomputed here from the three-stage pipeline’s confirmation records (确认-B3.jsonlconfirm-B3.jsonl）作为 131 次检测中的 27 次检测和 47 次清洁纸币检测中的 1 次，正是第 7 节报告的数字，关于清洁参考纸币) as 27 of 131 detection and 1 of 47 on clean notes, exactly the figures Section 7 reports, on the clean reference note foraci|D2N199。标记的事实是“患者年龄 74 岁”。抄本上是这么说的。修复后的参考笔记根本没有注明年龄。临床医生的结论是，事实并未被捕捉到——真正的遗漏。但该规则的触发因素是一个被评为关键的事实，并且该事实在两次临床医生的通过中都被评为支持（第二次会议的协调，见下文），因此根据所述规则，该标志是一个误报，与身体计数的情况完全相同。这是一个案例而不是一个比率。它还说明了 B 部分中的 8 部分没有提到的内容：修复后的参考注释是完整地对照其情况说明书，而不是对照笔录包含的所有内容，并且从笔录中列举的法官会发现差异。. The flagged fact is “patient is aged 74”. The transcript says it. The repaired reference note never states an age at all. The clinician’s verdict is that the fact is not captured - a real omission of the note. But the rule’s trigger is a fact graded critical, and this fact graded supporting in both of the clinician’s passes (the second sitting’s reconciliation, below), so under the rule as stated the flag stands as a false alarm, exactly as the body counts it. This is one case rather than a rate. It also says something section B’s 8 of 8 does not: the repaired reference notes are complete against their fact sheets, not against everything the transcript contains, and a judge that enumerates from the transcript will find the difference.

E.1.8 G：现实主义和保真度G: realism and fidelity

两项评价真实性，一项评价保真度。现实主义项目是陷阱盲咨询——由模型编写的包含特定文档困难的笔录，作者没有被告知该困难是什么——问题是每个项目是否都能作为真正的英国初级保健咨询的笔录，其中 5 意味着“你不会知道”。两人均被评为Two items rated realism and one rated fidelity. The realism items are trap-blind consultations - transcripts written by a model to contain a specific documentation difficulty, with the writer not told what that difficulty was - and the question was whether each would pass as a transcript of a real UK primary care consultation, where 5 means “you would not know”. Both were rated5。保真度项目是真实的 PriMock57 咨询，在情况说明书旁边显示了从中提取的模型，询问该表格是否公平地描述了所说的内容，其中 5 表示“没有遗漏或发明任何重要内容”。还被评为. The fidelity item is a real PriMock57 consultation shown beside the fact sheet a model extracted from it, asking whether the sheet is a fair account of what was said, where 5 means “nothing important missed or invented”. It was also rated5。这是作者冲突最严重的地方，因为它们是根据自己的设计生成的评级材料，因此报告为一位感兴趣的评级者的三个评级，仅此而已。动起来没有结果。对陷阱膨胀的单独测试发现，在间隔为零的情况下没有可检测到的膨胀，这才是该问题的实际答案（配套的人口普查文件的方法附录）。. This is where the author conflict bites hardest, because they are rating material generated to their own design, so it is reported as three ratings by one interested rater and nothing more. It moves no result. The separate test for trap inflation, which found no detectable inflation with an interval spanning zero, is where that question is actually answered (the companion census paper’s method appendix).

E.1.9 三个位置逐字回答The three position answers, verbatim

Q1、关于国旗规则Q1, on the flag rule（“你希望抄写员监控员遵守‘缺席任何一个关键事实’的规则吗？”）：(“is ‘any single critical fact absent’ the rule you would want a scribe monitor to fire on?”):

“我认为关键等级遗漏非常重要，所以是的，即使只有 1 个缺失也是值得注意的。但如果缺失 5 个，那么显然情况也会更糟”“i think the critical grade omissions are pretty important so yeah it is noteworthy if even just 1 is missing. but if 5 are missing then obviously that is also way worse”

他们赞同现有的事实规则，并希望在其旁边附带规模。规则不变；在每张标记的注释旁边报告缺失的关键事实的数量，比已购买的判决多了一行。They endorse the per-fact rule as it stands and want magnitude carried beside it. The rule is unchanged; reporting the count of absent critical facts alongside each flagged note is one line over verdicts already purchased.

Q2，关于注释中其他地方强烈提及的情况Q2, on the case where a strong mention survives elsewhere in the note（“将其作为命名的开放问题发布，还是您最希望发现的情况？”）：(“publish it as a named open problem, or is it the case you would most want caught?”):

“是的，这是正确的选择”“yeah that’s the right call”

建议是：报告班级，而不是将其作为一个开放问题集中起来（第 7 节）。The proposal stands: report the class rather than pooling it away, as an open problem (Section 7).

Q3、关于评分标准撕破取低等级的规则Q3, on the rubric’s rule of taking the lower grade when torn（“这符合你在实践中的评分方式吗？”）：(“does that match how you would grade in practice?”):

“是的，我认为这是对的”“yeah i think that is right”

与他们在 E 部分中的评分一致，其中将四个机器关键事实向下移动，仅向上移动了两个。Consistent with their own grading in section E, which moved four machine-critical facts down and only two up.

E.1.10 此验证不能做什么What this validation cannot do

  1. 1.

    一位评估者，一次坐着，无需重新测试。One rater, one sitting, no re-test.没有评估者内部的可靠性数据，也没有办法将他们的标准与仪器的标准分开。 E 阶段的 kappa 是一个两位评估者的数字，其中一位评估者撰写了标题。There is no within-rater reliability figure and no way to separate their standard from the instrument’s. Stage E’s kappa is a two-rater figure in which one of the raters wrote the rubric.

  2. 2.

    他们是一位作家。They are an author.A、B、C 和 G 阶段是对项目必须陈述的负责立场的认可。 D、E 和 F 是盲法是结构性的部分，并且是唯一应该被描述为独立测量的部分。Stages A, B, C and G are endorsements of positions the items had to state to be answerable. D, E and F are the sections where blinding was structural and are the only ones that should be described as independent measurements.

  3. 3.

    每个阶段有 6 到 20 个项目。Every stage holds 6 to 20 items.四个阶段读数为 100%，下限为 61% 至 72%：这排除了严重故障，仅此而已。间隔就是结果；点估计则不然。Four stages read 100% with lower bounds of 61 to 72%: that rules out gross failure and nothing finer. The intervals are the result; the point estimates are not.

  4. 4.

    抽样是为了覆盖范围而进行的播种和分层，而不是对抗性的。The sampling is seeded and stratified for coverage, not adversarial.A 阶段每次咨询都得出一个事实，没有过滤兴趣，也没有审计阶段拒绝的事实。 F阶段在每次咨询中根据阶层和事实的保留程度进行分层，而不是根据哪位法官可能是正确的。Stage A drew one fact per consultation with no filtering for interestingness and no fact the audit stage had rejected. Stage F drew one note per consultation stratified by stratum and by how much of the fact survived, not by which judge was likely to be right.

  5. 5.

    该包本身需要两个答案。The pack itself cost two answers.D 部分的 10 项中的 8 项在纸币上打印了一个窗口，而不是整个纸币，两次弃权都来自于此。打印完整笔记的重建 D 部分将是测试Eight of the ten section D items printed a window on the note rather than the whole note, and both abstentions came from that. A rebuilt D section printing the full note would be the way to test the存在于其他地方present_elsewhere正确查找。finding properly.

  6. 6.

    的The存在于其他地方present_elsewhere存储桶未经验证。bucket is unvalidated.三个项目中有一个答案，两个弃权，因此本次会议中没有任何内容支持或破坏该分类法所占的 25% 份额，并且不得以任何方式引用它。One answer and two abstentions across its three items, so nothing in this sitting supports or undermines the taxonomy’s 25% share for it, and it must not be cited either way.

  7. 7.

    E 阶段未达到按事实规则触发的等级。Stage E does not reach the grades the per-fact rule fires on.它验证基准的严重性轴，而不是管道审计阶段自己提取的事实的等级。这就是 E.2 所弥补的差距。It validates the benchmark’s severity axis, not the pipeline audit stage’s own grades of its own extracted facts. That is the gap E.2 closes.

  8. 8.

    这里没有任何内容可以验证遗漏检测数字本身。Nothing here validates the omission-detection numbers themselves.它验证了测量所依据的材料（A、B、C）、产生分类率的小组（D）、所依据的严重性轴（E）以及法官设计比较（F）。检测率和误报率仍然是第 5 节至第 7 节测量的内容。It validates the material they are measured on (A, B, C), the panel that produced the taxonomy rates (D), the severity axis they are conditioned on (E) and the judge design comparison (F). Detection and false-alarm rates remain what Sections 5 to 7 measured.

E.2 24 项审核阶段严重性会议，2026 年 8 月 17 日The 24-item audit-stage severity sitting, 17 August 2026

E.2.1 为什么要第二次坐Why a second sitting

第 7 节的逐事实规则针对审计阶段自身提取的事实的严重性等级进行触发。第一次考试从未获得这些成绩：它验证了基准的成绩，这是对不同材料的相同书面评分的单独运行。第二次盲通直接涵盖审核阶段的成绩。这两次会议是不同的工具，其人数永远不会合并。The per-fact rule of Section 7 fires on the audit stage’s own severity grade of its own extracted fact. The first sitting never scored those grades: it validated the benchmark’s grades, which are a separate run of the same written rubric over different material. A second blinded pass covers the audit stage’s grades directly. The two sittings are separate instruments and their numbers are never pooled.

E.2.5 两张通行证说了什么What the two passes say

盲目地，审计阶段的关键类别看起来非常慷慨Blind, the audit stage’s critical class looked substantially generous：已确认 10 个被规则解雇的批评者中的 1 个。: 1 of 10 rule-fired criticals confirmed.与审计阶段自己的推理相一致，一半的差距是咨询背景，快速盲通过没有权衡Reconciled against the audit stage’s own reasoning, half that gap was consultation context the fast blind pass had not weighed，最终的位置是 10 个被规则解雇的批评者中的 6 个得到确认，剩余的慷慨程度是常规内容的一级 - 赤裸裸的年龄、正常的检查结果、家庭筛查。两次传球均已报告，先盲传。, and the final position is 6 of 10 rule-fired criticals confirmed, with the residual generosity being one grade on routine content - a bare age, normal examination findings, family screening. Both passes are reported, blind first.

这些标志具有临床意义。The flags are clinically material.10 个规则触发的事实中的所有 10 个都是关键或支持和解的，因此即使“关键”标签高一级，标志也会在注释中列出临床医生想要的内容。All 10 of 10 rule-fired facts are critical or supporting on reconciliation, so a flag names something a clinician would want in the note even where the “critical” label is one grade high.

检测率和误报率不受影响。Detection and false-alarm rates are unaffected.它们是根据构建的缺席来衡量的，而不是根据严重的事实来衡量的。改变的是标志的含义：一个重要的缺失事实，即审核阶段的等级为关键，该等级比该临床医生的常规内容等级高出大约一个等级。将审核阶段的关键阈值与临床医生等级相匹配并对已购买的事实判决重新评分是一种廉价的手段，第 9 节中对此进行了命名。They are measured against constructed absence, not against severity truth. What changes is what a flag means: a material missing fact that the audit stage grades critical, with that grade sitting about one grade above this clinician’s on routine content. Aligning the audit stage’s critical threshold with clinician grades and re-scoring the already-purchased per-fact verdicts is a cheap lever, and it is named as such in Section 9.

方向既是评估者的方向，也是仪器的方向。The direction is the rater’s as much as the instrument’s.此后，一位独立的临床医生（不是本研究的作者，也没有参与该研究）根据同伴人口普查的最新调查结果样本，对同一份书面评分表进行了盲分级：12 个等级中的 9 个等级准确，3 个等级相差 1 级。在两次人口普查中，32 个等级中有 25 个是准确的，任何地方的分歧都不会超过一个等级，因此，在两位对不相交材料进行评分的临床医生的指导下，该标题会复制到一个等级之内。两人没有确定的是一个方向，因为两位临床医生倾向于相反的方向（第 3 节）。因此，上面记录的一级倾斜与审计阶段一样被视为该评估者的一种属性，并且本文中的任何主张均不基于单向倾斜的标题。The same written rubric has since been graded blind by an independent clinician - not an author of this study and with no involvement in it - on a fresh sample of findings in the companion census: 9 of 12 grades exact and 3 one grade apart. Across the two census sittings 25 of 32 grades are exact and no disagreement anywhere exceeds a single grade, so the rubric reproduces to within a grade under two clinicians who graded disjoint material. What the pair does not establish is a direction, because the two clinicians lean opposite ways against it (Section 3). The one-grade lean recorded above is therefore read as a property of this rater as much as of the audit stage, and no claim in this paper rests on the rubric leaning one way.

E.2.6 注意事项Caveats

一名评估者、一名作者、一次 8 分钟的盲审加上当天的非盲核对，并且无需重新测试。携带读数的行包含 10 和 15 项，因此间隔很宽，间隔就是结果。和解是通过构造打开的，并且在盲通旁边报告，而不是代替它。 “患者年龄 74 岁”这一事实（此处为 S13，第一次庭审中的 F6 项）在两次审查中都得到了支持，因此第一次庭审的观察立场 - 该注释确实缺乏转录事实 - 虽然该标志在规则的仅限关键触发器下仍然是误报，但支持等级现在已确认两次。One rater, an author, one 8-minute blind sitting plus a same-day unblinded reconciliation, and no re-test. The rows that carry the reading hold 10 and 15 items, so the intervals are wide and the intervals are the result. The reconciliation is unblinded by construction and is reported beside the blind pass, never instead of it. And the “patient is aged 74” fact (S13 here, item F6 in the first sitting) drew supporting in both passes, so the first sitting’s observation stands - the note really does lack a transcript fact - while the flag remains a false alarm under the rule’s critical-only trigger, the supporting grade now confirmed twice.
