F.1 捆绑包包含什么What the bundle holds

安全带本身的匿名化。Anonymisation of the harness itself.该研究不是匿名进行的，因此它的一些文件名和配置密钥带有产品名称。打包步骤将它们重写为字母，然后在捆绑包中任何不区分大小写的产品名称匹配上构建失败。因此，发布的捕获脚本命名其驱动模式 - 记录的 API，或实时播放到产品的音频 - 而不是产品；字母到产品的映射保留在私有存储库中，不会以任何形式发布。The study was not run anonymously, so some of its file names and configuration keys carry product names. The packaging step rewrites them to the letters and then fails the build on any case-insensitive product-name match anywhere in the bundle. A released capture script therefore names its driving mode - a documented API, or audio played to the product in real time - and never the product; the letter-to-product mapping stays in the private repository and is not released in any form.

F.2 我们保留什么What we withhold

我们保留的是这三个产品所写的注释文本。原因是合同而非临床：语料库根本不包含患者数据（第 9 节），并且产品的服务条款彼此不同，决定了它们的输出是否可以重新发布。我们以相同的方式对待这三种产品，而不是不对称地发布，部分原因是发布时带有一种产品的注释而不是另一种产品的注释，会使产品因缺少而被识别。What we withhold is the note text the three products wrote. The reason is contractual rather than clinical: the corpus contains no patient data at all (Section 9), and it is the products’ terms of service, which differ from one another, that decide whether their output can be republished. We treat all three the same way rather than release asymmetrically, partly because a release carrying one product’s notes and not another’s would make products identifiable by their absence.

三件事可以让隐瞒者保持半诚实。已发布的调查结果包含每项声明的文字记录端证据，而不是注释本身的文字，并且打包步骤无法在任何再现一系列保留注释文本的已发布内容、携带注释正文的任何模式字段以及捆绑包中任何位置的任何产品名称上进行构建 - 检查本身在已发布的注释中进行了描述。Three things keep the withheld half honest. Released findings carry the transcript-side evidence for every claim and never the note’s own words, and the packaging step fails the build on any released content that reproduces a run of withheld note text, on any schema field carrying a note body, and on any product name anywhere in the bundle - the checks themselves are described in the released验证.mdVERIFICATION.md。拥有自己的产品帐户的复制器可以使用已发布的工具重新生成端到端的等效注释。需要比释放内容更多的研究人员可以联系作者。. A replicator with their own product accounts can regenerate equivalent notes end to end with the released harness. And researchers who need more than the release carries can contact the authors.

F.3 基准数据表，压缩The benchmark datasheet, compressed

完整的数据表是捆绑包的数据集卡；这一部分包含了本文读者所需要的内容——组成、验证和限制。预期用途是评估法学硕士法官和环境抄写员系统；它明确不用于任何类型的临床用途或作为临床系统的训练数据，并且其中没有真实的患者遭遇或临床记录。The full datasheet is the bundle’s dataset card; this section carries what a reader of the paper needs - composition, verification and limitations. Intended use is evaluating LLM judges and ambient scribe systems; it is explicitly not for clinical use of any kind or as training data for clinical systems, and nothing in it is a real patient encounter or a clinical record.

F.3.1 组成和结构Composition and construction

成分是表Composition is Table10的工作在 A.7 中，构造在附录 A 中；本数据表不再重复它们。每个句子中：语料库包含 4 个层次的 145 次咨询（30 个作者，10 个 trap-blind，9 个保留，57 个 PriMock57，53 个保留，48 个 ACI-Bench，45 个保留），其中 134 个带有经过验证的干净注释 - 112 个评估，22 个在单独的法官优化拆分中 - 发布的集合是 500 对，495 个在评估集 - 293 个遗漏（150 个完整、86 个片段痕迹、57 个重述痕迹）和 202 个委托 - 加上他们评分的 112 个干净的双胞胎音符。构建通过九个步骤运行转录优先 - 确定性子样本（种子 20260728，排除了先前使用的 67 个 ACI-Bench 遭遇）、盲提取、三批评者审核、合并、参考注释修复、站点映射、单错误注入、优化分割雕刻和排除而不是修补故障的跨系列验证 - 其计数如图所示’s job, in A.7, and construction is Appendix A’s; this datasheet does not repeat them. In one sentence each: the corpus is 145 consultations over four strata (30 authored, 10 trap-blind with 9 kept, 57 PriMock57 with 53 kept, 48 ACI-Bench with 45 kept), of which 134 carry a verified clean note - 112 evaluation, 22 in a separate judge-optimisation split - and the released set is 500 pairs, 495 in the evaluation set - 293 omissions (150 complete, 86 fragment trace, 57 restatement trace) and 202 commissions - plus the 112 clean twin notes they are scored against. Construction runs transcript-first through nine steps - deterministic subsample (seed 20260728, the 67 previously-used ACI-Bench encounters excluded), blind extraction, three-critic audit, consolidation, reference-note repair, site mapping, single-error injection, the optimisation-split carve, and cross-family verification with failures excluded rather than patched - shown with its counts in Figure2。修复后的参考音符作为干净音符装在每对记录中；原件属于上游语料库自己发布的； 27 次盲重提取的作者转录本是一种仪器比较人工制品，无法从中建立配对。. The repaired reference note ships inside each pair record as the clean note; the originals belong to the upstream corpora’s own releases; the 27 blind re-extractions of authored transcripts are an instrument-comparison artefact from which no pair is built.

F.3.2 验证标准Verification standards

数据集中没有任何内容被描述为干净的构造。每层都有一个仪器、指定分母上的测量速率以及已发布的故障列表。Nothing in the dataset is described as clean by construction. Each layer has an instrument, a measured rate on a stated denominator, and a published failure list.

这些数字涉及两项披露。审核率是审核员多数率，循环中没有人工裁决，因此缺陷率是人工确认率的上限；对审核员严格性的实证检查表明，15.3% 的一种子筛选标志在三种子多数确认时死亡（373 个中的 57 个），上升到开放式部分 98 个标志的 29.6%。升级检查表部分的审核重现性为 0.794，包括开放式审核的审核重现性为 0.725，两者的条件都是屏幕上已标记某些内容（1,024 个部分审核中的 222 个升级），因此是有争议部分的下限，而不是整个语料库的数字。Two disclosures belong with these numbers. The audit rates are auditor-majority rates with no human adjudication in the loop, so a defect rate is an upper bound on a human-confirmed one; the empirical check on auditor strictness is that 15.3% of one-seed screen flags die at three-seed majority confirmation (57 of 373), rising to 29.6% of the 98 flags in the open-ended section. And audit reproducibility is 0.794 over the escalated checklist sections and 0.725 including the open-ended one, both conditional on the screen having flagged something at all (222 of 1,024 section-audits escalated), and therefore a lower bound over disputed sections rather than a whole-corpus figure.

F.3.3 已知的偏见、差距和排除Known biases, gaps and exclusions

人口和环境。Population and setting.仅英语英国初级护理和美国门诊护理。四个层次中的两个是我们写的咨询；最大的公共阶层是英国演员患者的初级保健。没有二级护理，没有一般实践之外的专业，并且语料库中没有注释带有电子记录结构化字段，因此基准根本不能说明结构化字段遗漏。English-language UK primary care and US ambulatory care only. Two of four strata are consultations we wrote; the largest public stratum is UK primary care with actor patients. No secondary care, no specialty outside general practice, and no note in the corpus carries an electronic-record structured field, so the benchmark cannot speak to structured-field omissions at all.

任何地方都没有真正的病人。No real patients anywhere.演员、模拟和虚构贯穿始终。这既是一种道德力量，也是一种生态限制：表演和模拟的协商比真实的协商更干净、更有目的。Actors, simulation and fiction throughout. That is an ethical strength and an ecological limitation at once: acted and simulated consultations are cleaner and more purposeful than real ones.

音频来源参差不齐。Audio provenance is mixed.一层是真实录音，三层是合成语音，这些录音比产品早了几年。当静音修剪产生关键的药物替代时，加速测试被拒绝后，所有捕获都以未修改的音频的原始速度运行。音频本身可以通过线束的文本转语音配方和引脚从发布的转录本中重新生成。One stratum is genuine recordings, three are synthesised speech, and the recordings predate the products by several years. All capture ran at native speed on unmodified audio, after a speed-up test was rejected when silence-trimming produced a critical medication substitution. The audio itself is regenerable from the released transcripts with the harness’s text-to-speech recipe and pins.

层间选择不对称。Selection asymmetry between strata.所编写的层的首次通过对失败率为 18.9%，而 PriMock57 上的首次通过对失败率为 52.9%，ACI-Bench 上的首次通过对失败率为 52.3%，因为所编写的层是逐字保留的，并且其失败的对被排除而不是重新生成，而公共层注释被修复并且对重新生成了多达 3 次。幸存的公共阶层对已经通过了更严格的过滤，因此法官和抄写员的分数不应该跨阶层进行比较。First-pass pair failure was 18.9% on the authored stratum against 52.9% on PriMock57 and 52.3% on ACI-Bench, because the authored stratum is preserved verbatim and its failing pairs are excluded rather than regenerated, while public-stratum notes were repaired and pairs regenerated up to three times. A surviving public-stratum pair has passed a harsher filter, so judge and scribe scores should not be compared across strata.

两个构建队列被合并，并每行记录。Two construction cohorts are pooled, and recorded per row.202 个委员会控制和 79 个完全遗漏的结转是通过模型重写而不是通过从站点地图上删除跨度来构建的，并且 79 个带有旧单臂分级的严重性等级； 34 个重新标记的部分种子的剩余数量从 1 到 9 不等，因为它们早于站点地图。每对记录它来自哪个队列，因此用户可以限制到内部统一列 - 请注意，所有佣金控件都位于结转队列中，因此统一列没有佣金臂。The 202 commission controls and 79 complete omissions carried over were built by model rewrite rather than by span deletion off the site map, and the 79 carry severity grades from an older single-arm grading; the 34 relabelled partial seeds vary in residual count from 1 to 9 because they predate the site map. Every pair records which cohort it came from, so a user can restrict to the internally uniform column - noting that all commission controls sit in the carried-over cohort, so the uniform column has no commission arm.

剩余计数是地图的属性，而不是注释的属性。Residual count is a property of the map, not of the note.施工在所有 151 个部分对上留下了一个映射的残留位点，但验证小组自己的读数发现其中 71 对中不止一个幸存的提及。这两个计数都在每个记录中，因此分析可以对其进行控制；发布的跟踪标签使用地图的计数。Construction left exactly one mapped residual site on all 151 partial pairs, but the verification panel’s own reading found more than one surviving mention in 71 of them. Both counts are in each record, so an analysis can control for it; the released trace labels use the map’s count.

薄且无人居住的细胞。Thin and unpopulated cells.重述跟踪外围单元包含 2 对，应被视为未填充，而片段跟踪外围单元很薄，为 8。重述跟踪需要第二次提及的事实是明确的或完整的释义，外围事实是语料库中最稀有的，也是最少冗余的。The restatement-trace peripheral cell holds 2 pairs and should be treated as unpopulated, and the fragment-trace peripheral cell is thin at 8. A restatement trace needs a fact whose second mention is explicit or a full paraphrase, and peripheral facts are both the rarest in the corpus and the least redundant.

排除的内容，带有计数。Excluded content, with counts.

除了文字记录外，一切都是模型制作的。Everything is model-produced except the transcripts.情况说明书、干净记录、注入、维修、站点地图和审计都是模型输出，由不同系列的模型进行检查。人体临床审查由作者兼临床医生进行，并按此披露；其范围和限制见附录 E。Fact sheets, clean notes, injections, repairs, site maps and audits are all model outputs, checked by models from a different family. Human clinical review is by an author-clinician and is disclosed as such; its scope and its limits are in Appendix E.

匿名化和安全、许可证、版本控制和引用是 F.2 的内容，也是本附录工作的重点，在数据集卡中完整重申：这三个系统到处都是 Scribe A、B 和 C，发布的集包含Anonymisation and safety, licences, versioning and citation are F.2’s and the head of this appendix’s job, restated in full in the dataset card: the three systems are Scribe A, B and C everywhere, the released set carries数据集版本：阶乘-v1dataset_version: factorial-v1（于 2026 年 8 月 12 日构建，取代了早期的 281 对冻结，其摘要识别了结转队列的来源），提示优化器的保留在构建时在结构上断言，并且在基准上计算的数字应与数据集版本一起引用，因为后来的修订版创建了自己的 DOI，并且两者不可互换。(built 2026-08-12, superseding the earlier 281-pair freeze whose digests identify the carried-over cohorts’ source), the holdout from the prompt optimiser is asserted structurally at build time, and a number computed over the benchmark should be quoted with the dataset version, because a later revision mints its own DOI and the two are not interchangeable.

F.4 每个语料库的归因Per-corpus attribution

两个公共语料库均根据 CC BY 4.0 发布，并且均以派生形式在此处重新分发。转录本已标准化，并且针对 ACI-Bench 进行了二次采样。这两个层的干净笔记是语料库自己的参考笔记，根据其成绩单进行审核和修复，因此建立在它们之上的每一对都是上游材料的改编，而不仅仅是我们的材料。来自这些阶层的情况说明书也是改编版。Both public corpora are published under CC BY 4.0, and both are redistributed here in derived form. The transcripts are normalised, and for ACI-Bench subsampled. The clean notes for those two strata are the corpora’s own reference notes audited against their transcripts and repaired, so every pair built on them is an adaptation of upstream material, not only of ours. The fact sheets derived from those strata are adaptations too.

CC BY 4.0 需要派生版本的四件事：命名创建者、携带许可证及其链接、说明所做的更改及其内容，以及不对下游用户施加进一步的限制。该版本的每个语料库都有一个固定的归属字符串 - 命名创建者、许可证、源记录和所做的更改（标准化的转录本；对于 ACI-Bench，在种子 20260728 处绘制了 48 次接触的子样本；临床医生参考笔记根据自己的转录本进行了审核并进行了修复；从修复的笔记中生成了单错误变体） - 在捆绑包的文件中逐字复制CC BY 4.0 requires four things of a derived release: name the creator, carry the licence with a link to it, state that changes were made and what they were, and impose no further restriction on downstream users. The release carries one fixed attribution string per corpus - naming the creator, the licence, the source record, and the changes made (transcripts normalised; for ACI-Bench a 48-encounter subsample drawn at seed 20260728; the clinician reference notes audited against their own transcripts and repaired; single-error variants generated from the repaired notes) - reproduced verbatim in the bundle’s归因.mdATTRIBUTION.md在许可证文件旁边、数据集卡和beside the licence file, in the dataset card, and in the_归因_attribution每个派生 JSON 工件的标头。对于 ACI-Bench，CC BY 4.0 授权保存在字符串引用的语料库的Figshare 记录中；对于PriMock57，它是存储库自己的许可证文件。捆绑包中的其他所有内容都是我们自己在 CC BY 4.0 下发布的作品，因此下游用户在整个捆绑包和两条归属线中携带一个许可证。header of every derived JSON artefact. For ACI-Bench the CC BY 4.0 grant is carried on the corpus’s figshare record, which the string cites; for PriMock57 it is the repository’s own licence file. Everything else in the bundle is our own work released under CC BY 4.0, so a downstream user carries one licence across the whole bundle and two attribution lines.

两个上游许可证都在打包时根据其发布的来源进行了验证，并且 CC BY 4.0 明确允许重新分发带有归属的改编材料，这就是该捆绑包。Both upstream licences were verified against their published sources at packaging time, and CC BY 4.0 expressly permits redistribution of adapted material with attribution, which is what this bundle is.

The exception among the monolithic rows is the restatement-trace case, G.2’s residual table; G.3’s pipeline transfer has several figures that move the other way. Each row is a complete independent pass over the full set of pairs; nothing is pooled inside a row. Detection is the flag rate on the 293 omission-errored notes under the score threshold fixed before the run (a score of 7 or below), and the false-alarm rate is the same design’s flag rate on the 112 clean twins.

在三个重复中：配对遗漏为 0.674 至 0.700，配对佣金为 0.958 至 0.965，检测率为 19.1% 至 20.5%，误报率为 0.9% 至 3.6%，检测与误报分离在每个重复中都很显着，z 4.17 至 4.72。在这个系列中，完整性评分的单样本法官在所有三个重复中清除了单个音符上的噪音，而主要系列中的设计没有这样做。Across the three replicates: paired omissions 0.674 to 0.700, paired commissions 0.958 to 0.965, detection 19.1 to 20.5% against a false-alarm rate of 0.9 to 3.6%, and a detection-versus-false-alarm separation that is significant in every one, z 4.17 to 4.72. On this family the completeness-scored single-sample judge clears its own noise on single notes in all three replicates, which no design in the primary family did.

条件是事实的存活率也会重现，包括临床上重要的部分。重述痕迹意味着事实的主要陈述已经消失，而明确或密切释义的提及在注释中的其他地方仍然存在。Conditioning on how much of the fact survives reproduces as well, including the part that matters clinically. A restatement trace means the fact’s main statement is gone while an explicit or closely paraphrased mention survives elsewhere in the note.

重述跟踪案例在每个重复中都有机会出现，从 0.500 到 0.518，与主要系列中的情况完全相同，其中八个设计中最好的读数为 0.526。该系列的严重性细分以相同的顺序运行：对于三个重复的完整性评分设计，关键 0.754、支持 0.614、外围 0.590，而主要系列的最佳设计为 0.683、0.586 和 0.568。仅忠实度设计在其单次重复中，残差读数为 0.567、0.558 和 0.500，严重性读数为 0.570、0.539 和 0.513。The restatement-trace case sits at chance in every replicate, 0.500 to 0.518, exactly as it does on the primary family, where the best of the eight designs reads 0.526. The severity breakdown runs in the same order on this family: critical 0.754, supporting 0.614, peripheral 0.590 for the completeness-scored design over three replicates, against the primary family’s 0.683, 0.586 and 0.568 on its best design. The faithfulness-only design, on its single replicate, reads 0.567, 0.558 and 0.500 by residual and 0.570, 0.539 and 0.513 by severity.

G.2.1 绝对检测，以及合并分离的可信度Absolute detection, and how far the pooled separation can be trusted

除了同一设计在相同阈值下的误报率之外，检测没有任何意义，因此两者都被打印在一起，并带有生成它们的标志规则。Detection means nothing except beside the same design’s false-alarm rate at the same threshold, so both are printed together, with the flag rule that produced them.

该表中两个系列的汇总 z 值将相同音符的三次传递计为三个独立观察值，这使它们膨胀。上面的每个重复 z 值（4.17 到 4.72）是第二个系列的真实数字，并且同样的警告适用于为主系列引用池行的任何地方。论文中没有任何内容依赖于集合 z。The pooled z values in that table, on both families, count three passes over the same notes as three independent observations, which inflates them. The per-replicate z values above (4.17 to 4.72) are the honest figures for the second family, and the same caveat applies wherever a pooled row is quoted for the primary family. Nothing in the paper rests on a pooled z.

另一个操作点需要说明其机制。扫至误报率保持在 10% 以内的最敏感阈值后，第二个系列的完整性评分设计在 9.6% 误报 (32/335) 下的检测率为 44.9% (394/878)，而第一系列的相同设计为 4.7% (41/879)，在 5.7% (19/336) 下检测到。这 44.9% 是在“任何低于完美 10 的分数都是一个标志”的阈值下购买的，它之所以有效，只是因为这位法官的得分正好是 10。这是一个语料库的一个操作点，没有证据表明它在分发后仍然存在，这就是为什么该论文的跨家庭声明是关于佣金和遗漏检测之间的差距，而不是关于绝对水平。扫描分母是 878 和 335，而不是 879 和 336，因为解析失败的两条记录（如下）从扫描曲线中掉出，一条遗漏记录和一条干净的孪生记录。One further operating point needs its mechanism stated with it. Swept to the most sensitive threshold whose false-alarm rate stays within 10%, the second family’s completeness-scored design reads 44.9% detection (394/878) at 9.6% false alarms (32/335), against 4.7% (41/879) at 5.7% (19/336) for the same design on the primary family. That 44.9% is bought at a threshold of “anything short of a perfect 10 is a flag”, and it works only because this judge scores clean notes at exactly 10. It is an operating point on one corpus with no evidence that it survives off-distribution, and it is why the paper’s cross-family claim is about the gap between commission and omission detection rather than about absolute levels. The swept denominators are 878 and 335 rather than 879 and 336 because the two records that failed to parse (below) drop out of the swept curve, one omission record and one clean twin.

G.2.2 解析失败Parse failures

2,428 中的两条记录未能解析，均来自同一次咨询，Two records failed to parse in 2,428, both on the same consultation,aci|D2N086：没有关于仅忠实性设计的设计，有两个关于完整性评分的设计。有 22 个样本命中了运行前修复的单次重试，其中 20 个样本恢复了。无法解析的输出被记录为解析失败并且永远不会停止运行。: none on the faithfulness-only design, two on the completeness-scored one. Twenty-two samples hit the single retry fixed before the run and twenty of those recovered. Unparseable output is recorded as a parse failure and never halts a run.

在重复 1 中，失败的是干净的双胞胎，因此该咨询的每一对都会失去其参考，并退出该重复的配对测量。在重复 2 中，这是一个错误的音符，因此一对掉落。绝对率不受影响，因为解析失败算作未针对完整分母进行标记。这些下降后的配对分母：仅忠实设计 293 项遗漏和 202 项委托记录；重复 1 中的完整性评分设计为 290 和 200，重复 2 中的完整性评分为 292 和 202，重复 3 中的完整性评分为 293 和 202，而重复 3 中的完整性评分设计为 293 和 202，没有任何下降。In replicate 1 the failure was the clean twin, so every pair of that consultation loses its reference and drops out of the paired measure for that replicate. In replicate 2 it was an errored note, so that one pair drops. Absolute rates are unaffected, because a parse failure counts as not-flagged against the full denominator. Paired denominators after those drops: the faithfulness-only design 293 omission and 202 commission records; the completeness-scored design 290 and 200 in replicate 1, 292 and 202 in replicate 2, and 293 and 202 in replicate 3, against 293 and 202 with nothing dropped.

G.3 管道传输：仅检查阶段发生变化The pipeline transfer: only the check stage changed

第二次运行将第 7 节管道的事实核查员更换为同一个第二家庭法官，没有任何其他改变。提取和批评者审核是从所有 47 次咨询的原始运行的缓存中读取的，因此事实列表和严重性等级在两个检查器中都是相同的；经过报价验证的第二次审查也停留在审计师模型上。提取在第三个模型家庭上进行，审计在主要家庭上进行，因此在这两种配置中，列举的事实都不是检查法官自己的。检查阶段运行于The second run swapped the per-fact checker of Section 7’s pipeline to the same second-family judge and changed nothing else. Extraction and the critic audit were read from the cache of the original run for all 47 consultations, so the fact lists and the severity grades are identical character for character across the two checkers; the quote-verified second look also stayed on the auditor model. Extraction runs on a third model family and the audit on the primary family, so in both configurations the enumerated facts are not the checking judge’s own. The check stage ran at推理努力reasoning_effort 最小的minimal，温度 1.0，重复 1 个，种子 11。, temperature 1.0, one replicate, seed 11.

该组对正好是第 7 节的确认集：47 次咨询中的 151 个保留对（10 个添加、10 个更改、62 个完全省略、69 个部分省略）加上 47 个干净的双胞胎，每层 198 个注释。主要系列列是通过相同的函数从原始确认存储中重新计算的，并且在整个过程中复制一个，以便以相同的方式读取两个检查器；第 7.2 和 7.5 节中的 0.786 和 0.762，以及表 8 旁边的配对佣金数字，是三个主要家庭运行的平均值。任一层上的解析失败均为零。The set of pairs is Section 7’s confirmation set exactly: 151 held-out pairs over 47 consultations (10 additions, 10 alterations, 62 complete omissions, 69 partial omissions) plus 47 clean twins, 198 notes per tier. The primary-family columns are recomputed from the original confirmation store by the same functions, and are replicate one throughout, so that both checkers are read at equal treatment; the 0.786 and 0.762 of Sections 7.2 and 7.5, and the paired commission figures Table 8 prints beside them, are means over three primary-family runs. There were zero parse failures on either tier.

以事实的存留量、成对的、仅遗漏的程度为条件：Conditioning by how much of the fact survives, paired, omissions only:

如果审计评级为关键的任何事实被判定不存在，第 7 节的按事实规则会标记一条注释。因为严重性等级是缓存的，所以两个检查器的规则触发类在结构上是相同的，变化的只是每个检查器判断哪些事实不存在。The per-fact rule of Section 7 flags a note if any fact the audit graded critical is judged absent. Because the severity grades are the cached ones, the rule’s trigger class is identical for the two checkers by construction, and what changes is only which facts each checker judges absent.

使该测试成为同类测试的比较器是同一个家庭自己的整体判断，仅限于 G.2 部分记录中的这 151 对和 47 个干净双胞胎。这些唱片已经被购买了，所以这一行不需要任何成本，并且是用相同的音符来衡量的。The comparator that makes this a like-for-like test is the same family’s own monolithic judge, restricted to exactly these 151 pairs and 47 clean twins from the records of Section G.2. Those records were already bought, so this row cost nothing and is measured on identical notes.

整体比较器在此子集上的三个重复读数为 0.688、0.658 和 0.660 配对的遗漏，1.000 的佣金，以及 2.1% (1/47) 的检测率为 16.0% (21/131)、16.8% (22/131) 和 16.8% (22/131)， 0.0% (0/47) 和 4.3% (2/47) 误报。管道行各有一个重复，因此整体平均值是同类数字。The monolithic comparator’s three replicates on this subset read 0.688, 0.658 and 0.660 paired on omissions, 1.000 on commissions in each, and 16.0% (21/131), 16.8% (22/131) and 16.8% (22/131) detection at 2.1% (1/47), 0.0% (0/47) and 4.3% (2/47) false alarms. The pipeline rows are one replicate each, so the monolithic mean is the like-for-like figure.

接下来是五个读物，第一个是第 7 节的基础。Five readings follow, and the first is the one Section 7 rests on.重组任务可以让更强大的法官保持领先地位。Restructuring the task keeps its lead on the stronger judge.在相同的情况下，管道读取 0.798 和 0.824，与该家族自己的整体判断的 0.668 配对，价值 +0.129 和 +0.156。On identical notes, the pipeline reads 0.798 and 0.824 paired against 0.668 for that family’s own monolithic judge, worth +0.129 and +0.156.

在本研究中，基于事实的规则是最接近非法官特定操作点的规则。The per-fact rule is the closest thing in this study to an operating point that is not judge-specific.这是一项针对个别事实判决的规则，并且没有任何调整，并且在检查器系列的变化中，它从 47 中一次误报的 20.6% (27/131) 检测到 47 中同一个误报的 22.1% (29/131)，这是 131 条记录中的另外两次真实检测。在 58 对存在严重缺失的情况下，这一比例从 32.8% (19/58) 上升到 36.2% (21/58)。在匹配的 2.1% 误报率下，该系列的整体判断读数为 16.5% (65/393)，因此该规则的边缘是 +5.6 个检测点，同时它的标志命名了缺失的事实及其严重性，其中整体标志是数字。It is a rule over the individual fact verdicts and was tuned on nothing, and across the change of checker family it moves from 20.6% (27/131) detection at one false alarm in 47 to 22.1% (29/131) at the same one false alarm in 47, which is two further true detections in 131 notes. On the 58 pairs carrying a critical-severity omission it goes from 32.8% (19/58) to 36.2% (21/58). At that matched 2.1% false-alarm rate this family’s monolithic judge reads 16.5% (65/393), so the rule’s edge here is +5.6 points of detection, alongside the fact that its flag names the missing fact and its severity where a monolithic flag is a number.

两层之间的排名取决于判断，尽管管道相对于整体式的排名并非如此。The ranking between the two tiers is judge-dependent even though the ranking of pipeline over monolithic is not.在这个检查器上，三阶段层超越了两阶段层（0.824 对 0.798），颠倒了主要家庭的排序，其原因在判决组合中可见：该检查器使用了三分法的中间标签，而初级检查器在没有推理的情况下没有使用三分法的中间标签。同样的行为也出现在下游，经过报价验证的第二次检查在该检查器上运行了 319 个标记缺席的项目，而在主要家庭上有 299 个标记缺席的项目。因此，级别比较必须与检查器一起进行。The three-stage tier overtakes the two-stage one on this checker (0.824 against 0.798), reversing the primary family’s ordering, and the reason is visible in the verdict mix: this checker uses the trichotomy’s middle label, which the primary checker at no reasoning effort did not. The same behaviour shows up downstream, where the quote-verified second look ran over 319 flagged absences on this checker against 299 on the primary family. Tier comparisons therefore have to travel with their checker.

重述追踪问题一分为二，这部分是新的而不是重复的。The restatement-trace problem splits in two, and this part is new rather than a replication.在配对测量中，第二系列三级管道在 0.636 处区分重述迹线，完全远离第 7 节中每种方法所在的 0.47 至 0.56 频带；在per-fact规则下，它的检测结果是33个中的0个，与主检查器的33个中的0个相同。信息存在于事实级别，决策层还不能对其采取行动，因此第7节的开放问题至少部分是一个决策规则问题，而不是纯粹的判别问题。On the paired measure the second-family three-stage pipeline discriminates restatement traces at 0.636, well clear of the 0.47 to 0.56 band every method in Section 7 sits in; under the per-fact rule its detection there is 0 of 33, identical to the primary checker’s 0 of 33. The information is present at the fact level and the decision layer cannot yet act on it, so the open problem of Section 7 is at least partly a decision-rule problem rather than purely a discrimination one.

佣金成本持续存在，而且对这个家庭来说更广泛。The cost on commissions persists, and it is wider on this family.整体法官在子集的 20 个佣金对上得分为 1.000，而管道层得分为 0.575 和 0.700，规则标记其中的 3 个：枚举应出现的内容的法官在缺席时获胜，在发明方面也失败。二十个佣金对使该规模具有指示性而非精确性。The monolithic judge scores 1.000 on the subset’s 20 commission pairs while the pipeline tiers score 0.575 and 0.700 and the rule flags 3 of them: a judge that enumerates what should be present wins on absence and loses on invention here too. Twenty commission pairs make that size indicative rather than precise.

G.4 两者混淆，以及这些运行无法解决的问题The two confounds, and what these runs cannot settle

推理设定随着家庭的变化而变化。The reasoning setting moves with the family.第二个系列的端点拒绝禁用推理，因此它在最小设置下运行，而八个设计都没有运行。法官家庭和推理设定都离不开这些跑动，上面每一个第二家庭人物都承载着这一点。The second family’s endpoint refuses to disable reasoning, so it ran at the minimal setting where the eight designs ran with none. Judge family and reasoning setting cannot be separated by these runs, and every second-family figure above carries that.

检查者的工作量与各层不匹配。Checker effort is not matched tier for tier.在主要系列中，二级管道的检查无需推理，而三级管道的检查则处于中等水平，如附录 C.3 所记录；第二家庭检查员在两层上都运行最少。因此，家庭对跨层行的两个方向的审议感到困惑，而上面的层反转是一个重要的地方。In the primary family the two-stage pipeline’s check ran at no reasoning effort and the three-stage pipeline’s at medium, as Appendix C.3 records; the second-family checker ran at minimal on both tiers. Family is therefore confounded with deliberation in both directions across the tier rows, and the tier reversal above is one place that matters.

数字还存在另外三个限制。管道行是针对三重复单片比较器的一次重复，仅忠实单片行是单次绘制，其增量是针对三轮平均值的一次运行。在 151 对中，残余子组很小（62 个完全去除、36 个碎片痕迹、33 个重述痕迹），并且它们的间隔相应地很宽；委托方持有20对。并且没有在系列之间进行显着性测试，因此本附录的诚实总结是，不对称性、其调节、重述轨迹崩溃以及管道对整体判断的领先都在第二个系列上重现，单音符检测水平随系列而变化，并且八个设计的完整跨系列比较仍有待未来的工作。Three further limits belong with the numbers. The pipeline rows are one replicate against a three-replicate monolithic comparator, and the faithfulness-only monolithic row is a single draw whose deltas are one run against a three-run mean. With 151 pairs the residual subgroups are small (62 complete removals, 36 fragment traces, 33 restatement traces) and their intervals are correspondingly wide; the commission side holds 20 pairs. And no significance test was run between the families, so the honest summary of this appendix is that the asymmetry, its conditioning, the restatement-trace collapse and the pipeline’s lead over monolithic judging all reproduce on a second family, that single-note detection levels move with the family, and that a full cross-family comparison of the eight designs remains future work.

附录一Appendix I比较文献全文The comparator literature in full

第 2 节列出了四种文献并说明了每种文献的贡献；本附录包含该节不再以全分辨率打印的段落，并收集了第 8 节的人类基线限制在句子中总结的已发布的人体检测数据。这里没有什么新的主张：每个数据都在 2026 年 8 月 17 日至 23 日期间根据其主要来源进行了验证，并在主要支持的决议中引用。Section 2 names four literatures and states what each contributes; this appendix carries the passages that section no longer prints at full resolution, and collects the published human-detection figures that Section 8’s human-baseline limitation summarises in a sentence. Nothing here is a new claim: every figure was verified against its primary source between 17 and 23 August 2026 and is quoted at the resolution the primary supports.

一、1I.1同时进行的和相邻的研究，完整The concurrent and adjacent studies, in full

非临床答案关键的审阅角色。The reviewing role, on non-clinical answer keys.并行工作在审稿角色本身中也发现了同样的不对称性。在该研究的单一审阅者条件下，被要求批评带有植入缺陷的密钥的模型捕获插入项的频率是遗漏项的六到七倍，作者认为原因是结构性的 - 审阅者只能询问它能命名的候选人，因此证明没有遗漏任何内容本身就是一项枚举任务Concurrent work locates the same asymmetry in the reviewing role itself. Models asked to critique a key with planted defects catch inserted items six to seven times more often than omitted ones in that study’s single-reviewer condition, and the authors argue the reason is structural - a reviewer can interrogate only candidates it can name, so certifying that nothing is missing is itself an enumeration task(Chen et al., 2026)。他们的可接受的集合是有限的和构造的，并且他们的省略是二进制的。我们的环境是他们未经测试的：免费的临床文本，没有可枚举的答案集，根据严重程度和残留痕迹对遗漏进行分级，以及手头的源文档来为审稿人所缺乏的候选人提供帮助。. Their acceptable sets are finite and constructed and their omissions binary. Ours is the setting they leave untested: free clinical text with no enumerable answer set, omissions graded by severity and by surviving trace, and a source document on hand to supply the candidates their reviewer lacks.

关于判断可靠性的另外三个角度，包括指向另一方向的角度。Three further angles on judge reliability, including the one that points the other way.扰动研究A perturbation study(Dahlberg et al., 2026)显示了临床法官在三种语言中对删除的反应大约是对修改的反应的一半，但没有对此做出评论。一项心理健康研究shows a clinical judge responding to deletions at roughly half its response to modifications, across three languages, without remarking on it. One mental-health study(Hussain et al., 2026)报告了对流行率敏感的 F1 的相反方向，这是任务和指标的差异而不是矛盾。供应商同时进行的两项研究从相邻角度提出了可靠性问题。在其中一项中，十名外部临床医生仅就自动法官的旗帜是否真实达成了公平的一致（Gwet 的 AC1 0.24，一致性系数），法官在信封内reports the opposite direction on prevalence-sensitive F1, a task and metric difference rather than a contradiction. Two concurrent vendor-authored studies pose the reliability question from adjacent angles. In one, ten external clinicians agreed with each other only fairly on whether an automated judge’s flag was genuine (Gwet’s AC1 0.24, an agreement coefficient), with the judge inside that envelope(Bergman et al., 2026a)。另一方面，在两个标准下对相同的 100 张 SOAP 票据重新运行一位幻觉法官，将测得的比率从 35.2% 提高到 9.1%. In the other, re-running one hallucination judge under two criteria on the same 100 SOAP notes moved the measured rate from 35.2% to 9.1%(Vachhani et al., 2026)，第 6 节对不作为方面的措施对委托方面的影响的标准。, a criterion effect on the commission side of the kind Section 6 measures on the omission side.

该工具自己在公布的利率中所占的份额。The instrument’s own share of a published rate.一项同时进行的五个国家配对研究使得该工具的份额可以从一个供应商内部进行衡量：在相同的人工智能生成的笔记上，临床医生的裁决发现错误率为 6.2%，而经过校准的自动审阅者发现错误率为 24.4%，作者发布了这两个数字，而不是选择一个A concurrent five-country paired study makes the instrument’s share measurable from inside one vendor: on the same AI-generated notes, clinician adjudication found errors in 6.2% where a calibrated automated reviewer found 24.4%, and the authors publish both figures rather than choosing one(Bergman et al., 2026b).

一、2I.2已发布的人类检测遗漏Published human detection of omissions

我们没有运行人类基线，发布的记录提供了比较器。在一项植入性错误研究中，审查医生发现遗漏的比率与客观错误大致相同，分别约为四分之一到三分之一。We did not run a human baseline, and the published record supplies the comparators. In a planted-error study, reviewing physicians caught omissions at roughly the same rate as objective errors, about a quarter to a third of each(Biro et al., 2025b)- 没有人类不对称性，尽管任务和语料库不同，但水平与我们最佳配置的 24.6% 至 36.9% 处于同一范围。 MEDEC 的两个医生基线在其 MS 测试子集的委托中达到 0.81 和 0.69 错误标记准确度（文档级标记，而不是每个错误捕获率）。临床医生在阅读源文件的同时回忆起一项综述研究中 50.4% 的遗漏- no human asymmetry, at levels in the same range as our best configurations’ 24.6 to 36.9%, though on a different task and corpus. MEDEC’s two physician baselines reach 0.81 and 0.69 error-flag accuracy on commissions on its MS-test subset (document-level flags, not a per-error catch rate). Clinicians reading with the source document alongside recall 50.4% of omissions in one review study(Bedi et al., 2026)，一个乐观的上限。放射科医生发现单词级、内部可检测的遗漏的比率为 42% 到 92%（他们的 12 名读者平均为 61.8%）, an optimistic upper bound. And radiologists catch word-level, internally detectable omissions at rates from 42% to 92% (mean 61.8% across their twelve readers)(Shen et al., 2026)，比语义缺失更容易的任务。没有公布的数据涵盖人类对遗漏的检测，而这些遗漏在其他地方仍然存在。如果人类也错过了这些，那么这种情况既是一个文档设计问题，也是一个判断问题。, an easier task than semantic absence. No published figure covers human detection of omissions whose restatement survives elsewhere. If humans also miss those, that case is a document-design problem as much as a judge problem.

附录JAppendix J对任何抄写员评估（包括本次评估）要问什么What to ask of any scribe evaluation, including this one

J.1 四个问题，以及我们自己的答案Four questions, and our own answers

有四个问题将有意义的评估与无意义的评估区分开来，我们根据自己的记录回答这些问题。Four questions separate an evaluation that means something from one that does not, and we answer them against our own record.

正在测量哪个错误类别？Which error class is being measured?现有的临床法官基准以佣金为中心，法官的能力很强——MEDEC的错误类型都是错误内容的替换，其中没有遗漏类别，因此在那里验证的法官不会告诉你有关主导生产的类别的任何信息。Existing clinical judge benchmarks centre on commissions, where judges are strong - MEDEC’s error types are all substitutions of incorrect content, with no omission class among them, so a judge validated there tells you nothing about the class that dominates production.我们的Ours：两个班级都是分开的，从来没有合并过。: both classes, separately, never pooled.

依据什么基本事实以及如何确定缺席？Against what ground truth, and how was absence established?根据我们审核工具的标准，我们审核的每份临床医生参考笔记都与其自己的成绩单存在重大差异（98 个笔记中的 100%，每个笔记有 7 到 11 个差异），因此根据参考笔记评估的抄写员是根据有损答案键进行评分的。建立某种缺失比听起来更难：我们的完全删除尝试中有 44% 未能通过验证。Every clinician reference note we audited was materially discrepant with its own transcript by our audit instrument’s standard (100% of 98 notes, 7 to 11 discrepancies each), so a scribe evaluated against reference notes is scored against a lossy answer key. And certain absence is harder to build than it sounds: 44% of our complete-removal attempts failed verification.我们的Ours：构建的缺席，由跨家庭小组验证，按幸存痕迹和严重程度分级，发布故障而不是修补。: constructed absence, verified by a cross-family panel, graded by surviving trace and severity, failures published rather than patched.

误报率是多少？At what false-alarm rate?一个没有误报率的检测数字是无法解释的，这是覆盖式评估中的一个常见缺陷：第 4 节的 RAGAS 式配方的自然标志一切规则在 98.7% 的干净音符上触发，而其分数带有我们测量的最佳遗漏信号。A detection number with no false-alarm rate beside it is uninterpretable, and this is a common defect in coverage-style evaluation: the natural flag-everything rule of the RAGAS-style recipe of Section 4 fires on 98.7% of clean notes while its score carries the best omission signal we measured.我们的Ours：每个工作点都引用了同一阈值下的误报率。: every operating point is quoted with the false-alarm rate at that same threshold.

用什么工具发表？With which instrument, and is it published?失败计数是抄写员和计数仪器的共同财产。配套的人口普查显示了该工具的份额有多大。早期版本的验证小组验证了 37.3% 的候选者，最终的跨家庭小组验证了 10.48%，是同三个产品的三倍半。这与人口普查自己的记录形成了不受控制的对比，因为两次调查之间发生的变化不仅仅是面板的变化。您看到的任何供应商费率都是仪器读数。A failure count is a joint property of the scribe and the instrument that counted it. The companion census shows how large the instrument’s share can be. An early version of its verification panel verified 37.3% of the candidates put to it and the final cross-family panel 10.48%, a factor of three and a half from the same three products. That is an uncontrolled contrast from the census’s own records, since more than the panel changed between the runs. Any vendor rate you are shown is an instrument reading.我们的Ours：仪器、它的提示、它的型号引脚和它的修正随速率一起提供，以及它自身的弱点是第 8 节的主题。: the instrument, its prompts, its model pins and its corrections ship with the rate, and its own weaknesses are Section 8’s subject.

附录KAppendix K三位评委根据真实的供应商笔记The three judges on real vendor notes

第 5 节到第 7 节中的所有内容都是根据构建的缺席来衡量的：其中一个事实被设计删除了。配套的人口普查提供了另一种证据——由三名部署的抄写员写的真实笔记，其中有一个独立小组发现并验证的遗漏——本附录报告了研究中的一个证据，该证据将报纸的评委指出。该语料库没有进行任何调整：每个法官按照基准部分为其发布的规则运行一次。第 8 节的注入错误限制总结了结​​果；这是完整的记录。Everything in Sections 5 to 7 is measured on constructed absence: pairs in which exactly one fact was removed by design. The companion census supplies the other kind of evidence - real notes written by three deployed scribes, with omissions found and verified by an independent panel - and this appendix reports the one run in the study that points the paper’s judges at them. Nothing was tuned on this corpus: each judge runs once, at the rule the benchmark sections publish for it. Section 8’s injected-errors limitation summarises the result; this is the full record.

K.1 设计Design

该组是人口普查的 565 个注释中的 261 个：所有 87 个注释都经过专家组验证的遗漏，以及 388 个注释中的 174 个，经过 12 次发现通过，两个家庭验证小组什么也没发现，按产品和语料库层进行分层（比例，最大剩余，种子 20260825，与 388 个注释池相比最差边际差距 0.32 个百分点）。唯一经过验证的发现是非遗漏类别的 90 个笔记被排除在外——它们既不是干净的，也不是遗漏阳性的——而 90 个笔记中的 3 个，其发现与已发布的类别根本不匹配，属于相同的规则，而不是悄悄地转移到干净类别。注释的类别是通过研究的分类代码根据其结果重新计算的，而不是读取存储的字段：人口普查的 618 个经过验证的结果中有 155 个没有存储的顶级类别，仅存储字段就会遗漏 87 个遗漏注释中的 14 个。The set is 261 of the census’s 565 notes: all 87 that carry a panel-verified omission, and 174 of the 388 on which twelve discovery passes and a two-family verification panel found nothing at all, drawn stratified by product and corpus stratum (proportional, largest remainder, seed 20260825, worst marginal gap against the 388-note pool 0.32 percentage points). The 90 notes whose only verified findings are non-omission classes are excluded - they are neither clean nor omission-positive - and three of the 90, whose findings match no published class at all, fall under the same rule rather than being moved quietly into the clean class. A note’s class is recomputed from its findings through the study’s taxonomy code rather than read off a stored field: 155 of the census’s 618 verified findings carry no stored top-tier class, and the stored field alone would miss 14 of the 87 omission notes.

三个法官按照自己发布的规则运行：最佳整体法官（经过缩尾处理的八个样本均值，标记低于 8.0），在其部署的标记低于 10 规则下的进化提示（已发布数据中的路线二），以及根据事实规则枚举然后检查管道的三阶段层（已发布数据中的路线一）。这里的管道必须是三级层。两阶段层对未经审计的事实列表进行判断，因此它的判断没有严重性等级，并且根本无法在其输出中说明事实规则（它可以表达的唯一规则，如果没有任何事实，则对基准自己的干净双胞胎的 72.3％ 起火）。人口普查的 142 项咨询是评估集 112 项的严格超集，因此无论存在哪里，提取和审计工件都会被重用：在这些注释所涵盖的 131 项咨询中，有 103 项已缓存，28 项是最新提取和审计的。运行产生了 783 个判断，解析失败为零。其记录对扣留的供应商票据进行判断，并按照与票据本身相同的条款进行处理（第 9 节）。Three judges run at their own published rules: the best monolithic judge (the winsorised eight-sample mean, flag below 8.0), the evolved prompt (route two in the released data) at its deployed flag-below-10 rule, and the enumerate-then-check pipeline’s three-stage tier (route one in the released data) under the per-fact rule. The pipeline must be the three-stage tier here. The two-stage tier judges the unaudited fact list, so its verdicts carry no severity grades and the per-fact rule cannot be stated on its output at all (the only rule it can express, any fact absent, fires on 72.3% of the benchmark’s own clean twins). The census’s 142 consultations are a strict superset of the evaluation set’s 112, so extraction and audit artefacts are reused wherever they exist: of the 131 consultations these notes span, 103 had both cached and 28 were extracted and audited fresh. The run produced 783 judgements with zero parse failures. Its records judge the withheld vendor notes and are handled under the same terms as the notes themselves (Section 9).

K.2 每个工作点都会移动，但没有一个占主导地位Every operating point moves, and none dominates

两种方法的检测率大约翻倍，整体判断器的检测量增加三倍以上，管道中的误报率上升 8.3 倍，进化提示上升 7.1 倍，整体判断器上升一半，因此这三种方法严格按照顺序排列，检测到的越多也标记出更干净的音符。在构建的干净双胞胎上建立的阈值并不适用于生产语料库——这是对部署的警告，而不是对法官的警告，这也是本附录中没有引用基准操作点作为对实际流量的期望的原因。Detection roughly doubles for both methods and more than triples for the monolithic judge, and false-alarm rates rise 8.3-fold on the pipeline, 7.1-fold on the evolved prompt and by half on the monolithic judge, so the three sit in a strict ordering in which whichever detects more also flags more clean notes. A threshold established on constructed clean twins does not carry to a production corpus - a caution about deployment rather than about the judges, and the reason the benchmark’s operating points are quoted nowhere in this appendix as expectations for real traffic.

该机制可以根据存储的事实判决来衡量。该管道在两个语料库上检查每个注释的审计事实数量相同 - 基准保留注释中为 37.6 个事实，而此处为 37.3 个 - 但它会判断每个真实注释中缺少 2.0 个事实，而基准上为 1.1 个，并且它的第二次检查称为超过 795 个标记事实与 299 个事实。构建的一对恰好删除了一个事实，而真实注释只是不太完整。这也是为什么该管道的检查和第二次审查阶段的真实票据成本为 0.0667 美元，而基准为 0.0440 美元。每次咨询提取和审计阶段保持不变，基准的全管道价格为 0.45 美元。阅读上面的“误报”专栏时应牢记这一点：174 条注释仅就人口普查的发现而言是干净的，而相同的结论表明它们并不完整。The mechanism is measurable from the stored per-fact verdicts. The pipeline checks the same number of audited facts per note on both corpora - 37.6 on the benchmark’s held-out notes against 37.3 here - but it judges 2.0 facts absent per real note against 1.1 on the benchmark, and its second look is called over 795 flagged facts against 299. A constructed pair has exactly one fact removed, and a real note is simply less complete. That is also why the pipeline’s check-and-second-look stage costs $0.0667 a real note against the benchmark’s $0.0440. The per-consultation extraction and audit stages are unchanged, and the benchmark’s full-pipeline price is $0.45. The “false alarm” column above should be read with that in mind: the 174 notes are clean only as far as the census’s discovery reached, and the same verdicts say they are not fact-complete.

K.3 改进提示的校准、测量失败并重新建立The evolved prompt’s calibration, measured failing and re-established

第 7 节指出，进化提示的阈值是一种校准，而不是设计保证：它之所以有效，是因为干净的音符得分恰好为 10，96% 到 98% 的保留双胞胎和 90% 到 94% 的评估集双胞胎都是如此。在真正的无发现笔记中，174 份笔记中有 97 份的得分恰好为 10 - 55.8%，还有 54 份的得分为 9，因此低于 10 的标记对其中 44.2% 的人产生了影响。这是预测的、测量的故障。信号在重新校准后仍然存在。在相同的记录上，进化后的提示显示，在低于 7 的误报率为 5.2% 时，检测率为 25.3%（在低于 8 的误报率为 5.2% 时，检测率为 32.2%），而整体判断没有可比较的阈值 - 在低于 7 的情况下，检测率为 1.1%，检测率为 9.2%；在低于 9 的情况下，误报率为 49.4%。因此，即使阈值不会，这两者之间的顺序也会在发生实际错误时继续存在。此处两者的误报率不同，因为整体判断阈值是两者中较安静的一个，并且在 5% 误报范围内，没有整体阈值达到进化提示的检测。 （事实上​​的规则没有扫描阈值，也没有重新建立。）校准也因产品而异，比此处测量的其他任何东西都大 - 进化提示的误报率在三个划线器中跨越 30% 至 71% - 因此，每次部署的清洁集对于此方法来说不是可选的，并且以这种方式测量的每个产品的速率是仪器的属性，就像任何产品的属性一样。Section 7 states that the evolved prompt’s threshold is a calibration, not a design guarantee: it works because clean notes score exactly 10, which 96 to 98% of held-out twins and 90 to 94% of evaluation-set twins do. On real no-finding notes 97 of 174 score exactly 10 - 55.8% - with 54 more at 9, so flag-below-10 fires on 44.2% of them. That is the predicted failure, measured. The signal survives re-calibration. Swept on the same records, the evolved prompt reads 25.3% detection at 5.2% false alarms at flag-below-7 (32.2% at 5.2% at flag-below-8), while the monolithic judge has no comparable threshold - 9.2% at 1.1% at its own below-7, and 49.4% false alarms by below-9. So the ordering between those two survives the move to real errors even though the thresholds do not. The two are not read at the same false-alarm rate here, since the monolithic judge’s threshold is the quieter of the pair, and no monolithic threshold reaches the evolved prompt’s detection inside the 5% false-alarm band. (The per-fact rule carries no swept threshold and was not re-established.) Calibration also varies by product more than anything else measured here - the evolved prompt’s false-alarm rate spans 30 to 71% across the three scribes - so a per-deployment clean set is not optional for this method, and per-product rates measured this way are properties of the instrument as much as of any product.

K.4 管道的标志命名了正确的事实The pipeline’s flags name the right fact

可以根据人口普查的独立验证结果来检查事实标志：同一缺席的两种言语，一种是法官根据笔录，一种是专家组。在 87 个经过验证的遗漏注释中，该规则对 45 个被触发，指出了 60 个事实，45 个标记注释中的 34 个（75.6% [61.3, 85.8]）命名了一个与专家组在词汇包含屏幕下以 0.3 阈值验证的遗漏相匹配的事实（68.9% 为 0.4，57.8% 为 0.5）。这些对是清晰的而不是边缘的——“据称存在尺骨茎突骨折”，而“注释中遗漏（和否定）记录的尺骨茎突骨折发现”。这是一个指示性屏幕，而不是裁决：将其理解为大约四个标志中的三个标志，命名了专家组独立验证的事实，而不是具有两位有效数字的精确估计。没有注入的基准可以产生这个数字，因为协议是通过构造实现的。A per-fact flag can be checked against the census’s independently verified finding: two verbalisations of the same absence, one by the judge from the transcript, one by the panel. On the 87 verified-omission notes the rule fired on 45, naming 60 facts, and 34 of the 45 flagged notes (75.6% [61.3, 85.8]) name a fact that matches the panel’s verified omission under a lexical-containment screen at a 0.3 threshold (68.9% at 0.4, 57.8% at 0.5). The pairs are legible rather than marginal - “ulnar styloid fracture was stated to be present” against “documented ulnar styloid fracture finding omitted (and negated) in the note”. This is an indicative screen, not an adjudication: read it as about three flags in four naming the fact the panel independently verified, not as a precision estimate with two significant figures. No injected benchmark can produce this number, because agreement there is true by construction.

K.5 这些费率是什么，不是什么What these rates are, and are not

  • •

    误报率是上限。The false-alarm rates are upper bounds.人口普查中的发现回忆是未经衡量的，经过小组审查的笔记并不完整（K.2），人口普查自己的标准实验将包含可报告内容的笔记比例从 27.8% 提高到 96.5%，具体取决于审查指令。因此，经过小组审查的纸币上的标志并不一定是错误的，上面的三个比率是三位法官错误的上限，而不是对错误的测量。Discovery recall on the census is unmeasured, panel-cleared notes are not fact-complete (K.2), and the census’s own standards experiment moves the share of notes carrying something reportable from 27.8% to 96.5% depending on the review instruction. A flag on a panel-cleared note is therefore not automatically wrong, and the three rates above are ceilings on the three judges’ error, not measurements of it.

  • •

    检测是保守的。Detection is conservative.基本事实是该小组的严格标准，因此 87 个音符的正类是带有遗漏的音符的下限。Ground truth is the panel’s strict standard, so the 87-note positive class is a floor on the notes that carry an omission.

Only the pipeline’s flag names a fact, which is why K.4 exists for it alone.

    进化的提示在这里运行一次，反对的是三多数的部署规则。The evolved prompt runs once here, against a deployed rule that is a majority of three.单次抽签检测和误报的次数比大多数抽签的次数多（第 7.7 节的估计器匹配读数），因此这里的数字比其部署的规则处于更嘈杂的点。A single draw detects and false-alarms more than the majority does (Section 7.7’s estimator-matched readings), so its figures here sit at a noisier point than its deployed rule would.

    两个“关键”分级是不同的乐器The two “critical” gradings are different instruments- 管道的审计等级采用基准的三值标准，人口普查采用二值等级 - 因此，这里没有严重性条件的比率可以与基准的评级进行比较，而无需指定评级者。- the pipeline’s audit grades on the benchmark’s three-value rubric, the census on a two-value scale - so no severity-conditioned rate here is comparable with the benchmark’s without naming the grader.

    一次运行，一位法官家族，一份语料库One run, one judge family, one corpus，任何手臂上都没有重复。这些利率与基准利率没有共同分母，因此它们报告在表格旁边，而不是在表格内。, with no replicates on any arm. These rates share no denominator with the benchmark’s, so they are reported beside its tables and never inside them.
